Singularity.Algebra.coeff_X_pow_mul_boxQ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : σ) (α : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) (MvPowerSeries.X s ^ (m + 1) * Singularity.Algebra.boxQuot m f s) =
    if h : ∃ t, m < α t then if m + 1 ≤ α s ∧ h.choose = s then (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) f else 0 else 0

Singularity.Algebra.coeff_boxQuot.type:

    if h : ∃ t, m < (β + fun₀ | s => m + 1) t then
      if h.choose = s then (MvPowerSeries.coeff (β + fun₀ | s => m + 1)) f else 0
    else 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {M : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {N P : Submodule R M},

∀ {S : Type u} [inst : CommRing S] {f : S} {I K : Ideal S},

Singularity.Algebra.length_quotient_pow_.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {a : R} {I : Ideal R},

          Module.length R (R ⧸ I ^ n) + Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a} ⊔ I ^ (n + 1))

Singularity.Algebra.length_quotient_span.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (a : R) (J : Ideal R),

Singularity.Algebra.length_succ_eq_add_c.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {S : Type w} [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {N : Type v}

  {𝒩 : ℕ → Submodule R N} {π : ℕ → N →ₗ[R] N} (μ : N →ₗ[S] N),

        Module.length R ↥(𝒩 (n + 1)) =
          Module.length R ↥(Singularity.Algebra.gradedMap μ hμ n).range +
            Module.length R ↥(Singularity.Algebra.cokerGrading μ 𝒩 (n + 1))

Singularity.Algebra.linearIndependent_bo.type:

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsRegularLocalRing R] {x : R} {y : Fin 1 → R}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsRegularLocalRing R] {x : R} {y : Fin 1 → R}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsRegularLocalRing R] {x : R} {y : Fin 1 → R},
  ringKrullDim R = ↑(1 + 1) →

      (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ a) {P : MvPolynomial (Fin (1 + 1)) R},
      P.IsHomogeneous a →
        (MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.cons x y)) P = f →
          Singularity.Algebra.quadraticStrictTransform x a hf =

∀ {A : ℕ → Type u_1} {B : ℕ → Type u_2} {C : ℕ → Type u_3} [inst : (n : ℕ) → AddCommGroup (A n)]
  [inst_1 : (n : ℕ) → AddCommGroup (B n)] [inst_2 : (n : ℕ) → AddCommGroup (C n)] {tA : (n : ℕ) → A (n + 1) →+ A n}
  {tB : (n : ℕ) → B (n + 1) →+ B n} {tC : (n : ℕ) → C (n + 1) →+ C n} {f : (n : ℕ) → A n →+ B n}
  {g : (n : ℕ) → B n →+ C n},
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A (n + 1)), (tB n) ((f (n + 1)) a) = (f n) ((tA n) a)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (b : B (n + 1)), (tC n) ((g (n + 1)) b) = (g n) ((tB n) b)) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (b : B n), (g n) b = 0 ↔ ∃ a, (f n) a = b) →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), Function.Surjective ⇑(g n)) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ), Function.Surjective ⇑(tA n)) →
            Set.SurjOn (Singularity.Algebra.invLimMap g) (Singularity.Algebra.invLim tB) (Singularity.Algebra.invLim tC)

Singularity.ContinuousFamily.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type u_2} →
      [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] →
        Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀ → (ι : Type u_3) → [LinearOrder ι] → Type (max (max u_1 u_2) u_3)

Singularity.ContinuousFamily.IsLimitKeyP.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type u_2} →
      [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] →
        {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} →
          {ι : Type u_3} → [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] → Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι → Polynomial K → Prop

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
    (∀ (i : ι), F.value i ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) →
      ∀ [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
        (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
          ∀ {φ : Polynomial K},
            F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
              ∀ {γ : Γ₀}, (∀ (i : ι), γ ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) φ) → γ = 0

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {φ : Polynomial K} [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
      (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) →
        (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
          ((∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.natDegree ≤ φ.natDegree → F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ (ν φ) f = ν f) ↔
            ∀ (ψ : Polynomial K), ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → ν φ ≤ ν ψ)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀} [inst_3 : Nonempty ι] [inst_4 : NoMaxOrder ι] (hφ : F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ)
  (hγ : ∀ (i : ι), γ ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) φ),
  Singularity.KeyPolynomial (F.limitAugmentedValuation φ γ hφ hγ) φ

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀} [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ {w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
      (∀ (f : Polynomial K), w f = F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ f) → Singularity.KeyPolynomial w φ

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  [Nonempty ι] {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ (f g : Polynomial K),
      F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ (f + g) ≤
        max (F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ f) (F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ g)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
    (∀ (i : ι), F.value i ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) →
      ∀ [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
        (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
          (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) →
            ∀ {φ : Polynomial K},
              F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ → ∀ (f : Polynomial K), F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ (ν φ) f = ν f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
    (∀ (i : ι), F.value i ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) →
      ∀ [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
        (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
          (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) →
            ∀ {φ : Polynomial K},
              F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
                ∀ {γ : Γ₀},
                  (∀ (i : ι), γ ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) φ) →
                    ∀ (f : Polynomial K), F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ f = ν f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {φ : Polynomial K} [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι],
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
      (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) →
        (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
          (∀ (ψ : Polynomial K), ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → ν φ ≤ ν ψ) →
            ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, f.natDegree ≤ φ.natDegree → F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ (ν φ) f = ν f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  [Nonempty ι] {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀} [NoMaxOrder ι],
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    (∀ (i : ι), γ ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) φ) →
      ∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K),
        F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  [Nonempty ι] {φ : Polynomial K} [NoMaxOrder ι],
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
      (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) →
        (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
          ∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K),
            ν f ≤ F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ (ν φ) f ∧
              F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ (ν φ) f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  [Nonempty ι] {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ →
    ∀ [NoMaxOrder ι],
      (∀ (i : ι), γ ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) φ) →
        ∀ (f g : Polynomial K),
          F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ (f * g) =
            F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ f * F.limitAugmentedValuationFun φ γ g

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) →
    (∀ (i : ι), F.value i ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) →
      ∀ [inst_3 : Nonempty ι] [inst_4 : NoMaxOrder ι],
        (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
          (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) →
            ∀ {φ : Polynomial K} (hφ : F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ) {γ : Γ₀}
              (hγ : ∀ (i : ι), γ ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) φ),
              F.limitAugmentedValuation φ γ hφ hγ = ν

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] {F : Singularity.ContinuousFamily μ ι}
  {φ : Polynomial K},
  F.IsLimitKeyPolynomial φ → ∀ [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι] {f : Polynomial K}, F.LimitDvd φ f ↔ ¬F.IsStable f

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ} (b c : ℕ) {S : Finset (Fin 3)},
  0 ∈ S →
    ∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobian {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c),
      ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ (a - 1),

            q

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRun_end.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    a < p →
      ∀ (b c : ℕ) {ch : ℕ → Bool},
        Singularity.CornerCurves.IsCurveRun p a b c ch →
          ∃ N ≤ (b + c) / (p - a),
            (∀ k < N,
                Singularity.CornerCurves.CenterRhoStep p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveCenter (ch k)) (a - 1)
                  (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k)
                  (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch (k + 1))) ∧
              a + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N).1 < p ∧
                a + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N).2 < p ∧
                  Singularity.ordAlong {0, 1} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 < ↑p ∧
                    Singularity.ordAlong {0, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 < ↑p ∧
                      (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 ∉
                          Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑{0, 1}) ^ p ∧
                        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 ∉
                            Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑{0, 2}) ^ p ∧
                          Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).1
                              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch N).2 =
                            ↑(a - 1)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRun_of_cha.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p < a →
      ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool),
        (∀ (k : ℕ),
            Singularity.CornerCurves.CenterRhoStep p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveCenter (ch k)) (a - 1)
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k)
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch (k + 1))) ∧
          (∀ (k : ℕ),
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k).1
                  (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k).2 =
                ↑(a - 1)) ∧
            Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRun_of_le.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool),
      (∀ (k : ℕ),
          Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k).1
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k).2 =
            ↑(a - 1)) ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k) →
            Singularity.CornerCurves.CenterRhoStep p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveCenter (ch k)) (a - 1)
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch k)
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveRunPoint p a b c ch (k + 1))

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq.type: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → ℕ × ℕ

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq.eq_def.type:
∀ (p a b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (x : ℕ),
  Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch x =
    match x with
    | 0 => (b, c)
    | k.succ => Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepData p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_length.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) {N : ℕ},
      (∀ k < N, Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)) →
        N ≤ (b + c) / (p - a)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_succ.type:
∀ (p a b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1) =
    Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepData p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_sum_ad.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (N : ℕ),
      (∀ k < N, Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)) →
        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N).1 + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N).2 +
            N * (p - a) =
          b + c

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_sum_lt.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  p < a →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
      (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).1 + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).2 <
        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).1 +
          (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).2

∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k) →
        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).1 +
            (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).2 <
          (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).1 + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).2

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq_sum_su.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k) →
        (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).1 +
              (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch (k + 1)).2 +
            (p - a) =
          (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).1 + (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k).2

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepData.type: ℕ → ℕ → Bool → ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK.type: ℕ → ℕ → Bool → ℕ × ℕ → Prop

Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStep_lt.type: ∀ {p a b : ℕ}, a < p → p ≤ a + b → a + b - p < b

Singularity.CornerCurves.curve_hG.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ℕ), ∀ i ∈ {1, 2}, ∃ d ∈ (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ a).support, d i = 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.divisorExponent.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ℕ),
  Singularity.divisorExponent {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = (fun₀ | 1 => b) + fun₀ | 2 => c

Singularity.CornerCurves.exists_curveSeq.type:
∀ {p a : ℕ},
  a < p →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) (ch : ℕ → Bool),
      ∃ N ≤ (b + c) / (p - a),
        (∀ k < N, Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch k) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch k)) ∧
          ¬Singularity.CornerCurves.curveStepOK p a (ch N) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curveSeq p a b c ch N)

Singularity.CornerCurves.isClean_curvePo.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a → ∀ (b c : ℕ), Singularity.IsClean p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c)

Singularity.CornerCurves.logJacobianOrde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {N : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, N i = 0) →
    (∀ β ∈ g'.support, N ≤ β) →
      ∀ {w : MvPolynomial σ k},
        (MvPolynomial.monomial N) 1 * w ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g' →
          MvPolynomial.constantCoeff w ≠ 0 → Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = 0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    ∀ (b c : ℕ) {S : Finset (Fin 3)},
      0 ∈ S →
        Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ p →
          ∀ {j : Fin 3},
            j ∈ S →
              ∀ (t : Fin 3 → ZMod p) {g' : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)},
                (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
                    MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
                  Singularity.cleanPart p g' ≠ 0 ∧
                    Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} S j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                      ↑(a - 1)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + b →
      ∀ (c : ℕ) {j : Fin 3},
        j ∈ {0, 1} →
          ∀ (t : Fin 3 → ZMod p) {g' : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)},
            (Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} j t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
                MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
              Singularity.cleanPart p g' ≠ 0 ∧
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 1} j t)
                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                  ↑(a - 1)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + c →
      ∀ (b : ℕ) {j : Fin 3},
        j ∈ {0, 2} →
          ∀ (t : Fin 3 → ZMod p) {g' : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)},
            (Singularity.centerChart {0, 2} j t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
                MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
              Singularity.cleanPart p g' ≠ 0 ∧
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 2} j t)
                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                  ↑(a - 1)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a → ∀ (b c : ℕ), Singularity.logJacobianOrder {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = ↑(a - 1)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + b →
      ∀ (c : ℕ),
        (Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} 0 0) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
            MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p * Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p (a + b - p) b c ∧
          Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 1} 0 0 = {0, 1, 2} ∧
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0, 1, 2}
                (Singularity.cleanPart p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p (a + b - p) b c)) =
              0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + b →
      ∀ (c : ℕ) {t : Fin 3 → ZMod p},
        t 1 ≠ 0 →
          (Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} 0 t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
              MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p *
                (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a + b - p) * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ c *
                  (MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.C (t 1)) ^ b) ∧
            Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 1} 0 t = {0, 2} ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0, 2}
                  (Singularity.cleanPart p
                    (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a + b - p) * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ c *
                      (MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.C (t 1)) ^ b)) =
                0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + c →
      ∀ (b : ℕ),
        (Singularity.centerChart {0, 2} 0 0) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
            MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p * Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p (a + c - p) b c ∧
          Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 2} 0 0 = {0, 1, 2} ∧
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0, 1, 2}
                (Singularity.cleanPart p (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p (a + c - p) b c)) =
              0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + c →
      ∀ (b : ℕ) {t : Fin 3 → ZMod p},
        t 2 ≠ 0 →
          (Singularity.centerChart {0, 2} 0 t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
              MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p *
                (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a + c - p) * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ b *
                  (MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.C (t 2)) ^ c) ∧
            Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 2} 0 t = {0, 1} ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0, 1}
                  (Singularity.cleanPart p
                    (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a + c - p) * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ b *
                      (MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.C (t 2)) ^ c)) =
                0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + b →
      ∀ (c : ℕ) {t : Fin 3 → ZMod p},
        t 0 ≠ 0 →
          (Singularity.centerChart {0, 1} 1 t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
              MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ p *
                (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ (a + b - p) * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ c *
                  (MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C (t 0)) ^ a) ∧
            Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 1} 1 t = {1, 2} ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder {1, 2}
                  (Singularity.cleanPart p
                    (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ (a + b - p) * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ c *
                      (MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C (t 0)) ^ a)) =
                0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a c : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a →
    p ≤ a + c →
      ∀ (b : ℕ) {t : Fin 3 → ZMod p},
        t 0 ≠ 0 →
          (Singularity.centerChart {0, 2} 2 t) (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) =
              MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ p *
                (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ b * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ (a + c - p) *
                  (MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C (t 0)) ^ a) ∧
            Singularity.centerDivisor {1, 2} {0, 2} 2 t = {1, 2} ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder {1, 2}
                  (Singularity.cleanPart p
                    (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ b * MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ (a + c - p) *
                      (MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C (t 0)) ^ a)) =
                0

Singularity.CornerCurves.monomial_le_of_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {N β : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ} {w : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)},
  β ∈ ((MvPolynomial.monomial N) 1 * w).support → N ≤ β

Singularity.CornerCurves.natCast_sub_ne_.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a b : ℕ}, ¬p ∣ a → p ≤ a + b → p ∣ b → ↑(a + b - p) ≠ 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.ordAlong_curveP.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ℕ),
  Singularity.ordAlong {0, 1} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = ↑(a + b)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ℕ),
  Singularity.ordAlong {0, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = ↑(a + c)

Singularity.CornerCurves.ord_eq_zero_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {w : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff w ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord w = 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.orderGAlong_cur.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a → ∀ (b c : ℕ), Singularity.orderGAlong p {1, 2} {0, 1} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = ↑a

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {a : ℕ},
  ¬p ∣ a → ∀ (b c : ℕ), Singularity.orderGAlong p {1, 2} {0, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = ↑a

Singularity.CornerCurves.pderiv_X_add_C_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (i : Fin 3) (s : ZMod p) (n : ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C s) ^ n) =
    ↑n * (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C s) ^ (n - 1)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {i j : Fin 3},
  i ≠ j → ∀ (s : ZMod p) (n : ℕ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C s) ^ n) = 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.pderiv_X_zero_p.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {i : Fin 3}, i ≠ 0 → ∀ (a : ℕ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ a) = 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.pderiv_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {N : σ →₀ ℕ} {i : σ},
  N i = 0 → ∀ (c : k), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial N) c) = 0

Singularity.CornerCurves.pderiv_zero_X_p.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a : ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv 0) (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ a) = ↑a * MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (a - 1)

Singularity.CornerCurves.residualFactor_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (a b c : ℕ),
  Singularity.residualFactor {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerCurves.curvePoly p a b c) = MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ a

Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData.mk.inj.type:
∀ {a b mu lam a_1 b_1 mu_1 lam_1 : ℕ},
  { a := a, b := b, mu := mu, lam := lam } = { a := a_1, b := b_1, mu := mu_1, lam := lam_1 } →
    a = a_1 ∧ b = b_1 ∧ mu = mu_1 ∧ lam = lam_1

∀ (a b mu lam a_1 b_1 mu_1 lam_1 : ℕ),
  ({ a := a, b := b, mu := mu, lam := lam } = { a := a_1, b := b_1, mu := mu_1, lam := lam_1 }) =
    (a = a_1 ∧ b = b_1 ∧ mu = mu_1 ∧ lam = lam_1)

Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData.mk.siz.type: ∀ (a b mu lam : ℕ), sizeOf { a := a, b := b, mu := mu, lam := lam } = 1 + sizeOf a + sizeOf b + sizeOf mu + sizeOf lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData.noConf.type: Sort u → Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData → Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData → Sort u

Singularity.CornerRuns.X_mul_pderiv_one_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 1 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 1) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam) =
    ↑(mu + p) * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.X_mul_pderiv_two_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 2 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 2) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam) =
    ↑(lam + p) * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE2_ne_corne.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE2 p D ≠ Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE1 p D

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → ℕ → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG_eq.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p mu lam =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial fun₀ | 0 => p) 1 + (MvPolynomial.monomial ((fun₀ | 1 => mu + p) + fun₀ | 2 => lam + p)) 1

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → ℕ → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint.type:
(p : ℕ) →
  [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData → Finset (Fin 3) × MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly_eq_mon.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE1 p D)) 1 +
      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerE2 p D)) 1

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly_eq_mul.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial ((fun₀ | 1 => D.a) + fun₀ | 2 => D.b)) 1 * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p D.mu D.lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly_ne_zer.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData), Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D ≠ 0

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRun.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k)
        (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate (k + 1))) ∧
    (∀ (k : ℕ),
        Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k).1
            (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k).2 =
          ↑p) ∧
      Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint.type: (p : ℕ) → [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → Finset (Fin 3) × MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint_in.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool), Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRun_of_char.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool),
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k)
        (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c (k + 1))) ∧
    (∀ (k : ℕ),
        Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k).1
            (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k).2 =
          ↑p) ∧
      Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRun_orderGA.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin 3)),
  ¬(0 ∈ S ∧ (1 ∈ S ∨ 2 ∈ S)) →
    Singularity.orderGAlong p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k).1 S
        (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k).2 <
      ↑p

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRun_two.type:
(∀ (k : ℕ),
    Singularity.RhoStep 2 2 (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k)
      (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate (k + 1))) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k).1
          (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate k).2 =
        2) ∧
    Function.Injective (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint 2 Singularity.SurfaceRuns.alternate)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_modEq.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  ↑(Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a * (↑(Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).lam + ↑p) -
      ↑(Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b * (↑(Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).mu + ↑p) ≡
    -1 [ZMOD ↑p]

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_not_dvd.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  ¬(p ∣ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a ∧ p ∣ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b) ∧
    ¬(p ∣ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a + (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).mu + p ∧
        p ∣ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b + (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).lam + p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_spec.type:
∀ (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).IsGood ∧
    1 ≤ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a ∧ 1 ≤ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_succ.type:
∀ (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c (k + 1) =
    if c k = true then (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).y else (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).z

Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq_sum_lt.type:
∀ (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).a + (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c k).b <
    (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c (k + 1)).a + (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerSeq c (k + 1)).b

Singularity.CornerRuns.corner_hG.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  ∀ i ∈ {1, 2}, ∃ d ∈ (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p mu lam).support, d i = 0

Singularity.CornerRuns.divisorExponent_c.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.divisorExponent {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) = (fun₀ | 1 => D.a) + fun₀ | 2 => D.b

Singularity.CornerRuns.isClean_cornerPol.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → Singularity.IsClean p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D)

Singularity.CornerRuns.le_ord_cornerM.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ), ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam)

Singularity.CornerRuns.le_ord_cornerPoly.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D)

Singularity.CornerRuns.logJacobianOrder_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → Singularity.logJacobianOrder {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) = ↑p

Singularity.CornerRuns.lt_ord_cornerM.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ), ↑p < Singularity.ord (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam)

Singularity.CornerRuns.not_X_dvd_cornerP.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → ∀ (h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) (ZMod p)), ¬MvPolynomial.X 0 ∣ Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D + h ^ p

Singularity.CornerRuns.not_dvd_and_dvd_a.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData}, D.IsGood → ¬(p ∣ D.a ∧ p ∣ D.b)

∀ {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → ¬(p ∣ D.a + D.mu + p ∧ p ∣ D.b + D.lam + p)

Singularity.CornerRuns.ord_residualFacto.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D)) = ↑p

Singularity.CornerRuns.orderGAlong_corne.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood →
    ∀ (S : Finset (Fin 3)),
      ¬(0 ∈ S ∧ (1 ∈ S ∨ 2 ∈ S)) → Singularity.orderGAlong p {1, 2} S (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) ≤ 1

Singularity.CornerRuns.pderiv_zero_corne.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (mu lam : ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv 0) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p mu lam) = 0

Singularity.CornerRuns.pointChart_corner.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  (Singularity.pointChart 1 0) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) =
    MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ p * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D.y

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  (Singularity.pointChart 2 0) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) =
    MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ p * Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D.z

Singularity.CornerRuns.residualFactor_co.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData),
  Singularity.residualFactor {1, 2} (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoly p D) =
    Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p D.mu D.lam

Singularity.CornerRuns.residualLogJacobi.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood →
    Singularity.residualLogJacobian {1, 2} ((fun₀ | 1 => D.a) + fun₀ | 2 => D.b)
        (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerG p D.mu D.lam) =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ p, Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerM p D.mu D.lam}

Singularity.CornerRuns.rhoStep_cornerPoi.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint p D) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint p D.y)

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {D : Singularity.CornerRuns.CornerData},
  D.IsGood → Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint p D) (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerPoint p D.z)

Singularity.CornerRuns.rhoStep_cornerRun.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (c : ℕ → Bool) (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c k)
    (Singularity.CornerRuns.cornerRunPoint p c (k + 1))

Singularity.CurveRuns.X_mul_pderiv_one_m.type:
∀ (a b c : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 1 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 1) (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c) =
    ↑b * Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c

Singularity.CurveRuns.X_mul_pderiv_two_m.type:
∀ (a b c : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 2 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 2) (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c) =
    ↑c * Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c

Singularity.CurveRuns.X_mul_pderiv_zero_.type:
∀ (a b c : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.X 0 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 0) (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c) =
    ↑a * Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c

Singularity.CurveRuns.coeff_mono_add_mon.type:
∀ {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ},
  ¬(a = a' ∧ b = b' ∧ c = c') →
    (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a' b' c').coeff
        (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.expo a b c) =
      1

Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG_support.type: ∀ {k : ℕ}, ∀ i ∈ {1}, ∃ d ∈ MvPolynomial.support (Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG k), d i = 0

Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoly_eq.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoly k =
    Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono 4 (2 * k + 1) 0 + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono 2 (3 * k + 1) 3

Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoly_eq_mul.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoly k =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.expo 0 (2 * k + 1) 0)) 1 * Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG k

Singularity.CurveRuns.curveRun.type:
(∀ (k : ℕ), Singularity.RhoStep 2 4 (Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint k) (Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint (k + 1))) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint k).1 (Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint k).2 = 4) ∧
    Function.Injective Singularity.CurveRuns.curvePoint

Singularity.CurveRuns.isClean_mono_add_m.type:
∀ {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ},
  ¬(2 ∣ a ∧ 2 ∣ b ∧ 2 ∣ c) →
    ¬(2 ∣ a' ∧ 2 ∣ b' ∧ 2 ∣ c') →
      Singularity.IsClean 2
        (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a' b' c')

Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedG_support.type: ∀ i ∈ {0, 2}, ∃ d ∈ MvPolynomial.support Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedG, d i = 0

Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoly_eq.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoly k =
    Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono (5 + 3 * k) 2 3 + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono (10 + 3 * k) 3 2

Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedRun.type:
(∀ (k : ℕ),
    Singularity.RhoStep 2 3 (Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint k) (Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint (k + 1))) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint k).1 (Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint k).2 =
        3) ∧
    Function.Injective Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedPoint

Singularity.CurveRuns.le_ord_mono.type: ∀ {n a b c : ℕ}, n ≤ a + b + c → ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c)

Singularity.CurveRuns.le_ord_natCast_mul.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {f : Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.Poly},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∀ (m : ℕ), ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord (↑m * f)

Singularity.CurveRuns.mono_add_mono_ne_z.type:
∀ {a b c a' b' c' : ℕ},
  ¬(a = a' ∧ b = b' ∧ c = c') →
    Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c + Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a' b' c' ≠ 0

Singularity.CurveRuns.ord_curve_ey.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.ord
      (↑((Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.expo 0 (2 * k + 1) 0) 1) • Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG k +
        MvPolynomial.X 1 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 1) (Singularity.CurveRuns.curveG k)) =
    ↑4

Singularity.CurveRuns.ord_isolated_ez.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  Singularity.ord
      (↑((Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.expo (5 + 3 * k) 0 2) 2) • Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedG +
        MvPolynomial.X 2 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv 2) Singularity.CurveRuns.isolatedG) =
    ↑3

Singularity.CurveRuns.ord_mono.type: ∀ (a b c : ℕ), Singularity.ord (Singularity.KangarooCounterexample.mono a b c) = ↑(a + b + c)

  Singularity.IsFunctionField k K →
    Singularity.IsAbhyankarValuation k V →
      ∀ {r : ℕ},
        Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive V.ValueGroupˣ)) = ↑r →
          Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin r) ℤ (Additive V.ValueGroupˣ))

  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K],
  Singularity.IsFunctionField k K →
    Singularity.IsAbhyankarValuation k V →
      ∃ r t x y,
        Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive V.ValueGroupˣ)) = ↑r ∧
          Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V) = ↑t ∧
            (∀ (i : Fin r), x i ≠ 0) ∧
              (∀ (a : Fin r → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0) ∧
                (AlgebraicIndependent k fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y j)) ∧
                  AlgebraicIndependent k (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j)) ∧
                    FiniteDimensional (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j))))) K ∧
                      (∀
                          c ∈
                            IntermediateField.adjoin k
                              (Set.range fun j =>
                                Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j)) (Sum.inr j)),
                          c ∈
                            V.comap
                              (algebraMap (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j))))) K)) ∧
                        Singularity.IsMonomialValuation
                          (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k
                              (Set.range fun j =>
                                Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j)) (Sum.inr j))))
                          (V.comap
                            (algebraMap (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j))))) K))
                          fun i => Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j)) (Sum.inl i)

{K : Type u_1} →

Singularity.KeyPolynomial.augmentedValua.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ →
    Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ ψ →
      ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree →
        γ ≤ μ φ →
          γ ≤ μ ψ →
            μ (ψ - φ) ≤ γ →
              ∀ (f : Polynomial K),
                Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f = Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ ψ γ f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ →
    γ ≤ μ φ →
      ∀ (f g : Polynomial K),
        Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ (f * g) =
          Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f * Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ g

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ →
    γ ≤ μ φ →
      ∀ {f : Polynomial K},
        Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f ≠ 0 →
          Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ
              (f -
                ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1) with
                  μ (Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j) * γ ^ j = Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f,
                  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j * φ ^ j) <
            Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀} (hφ : Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ) (hγ : γ ≤ μ φ)
  {c : ℕ → Polynomial K} {N : ℕ},
  (∀ j < N, (c j).degree < φ.degree) →
    (Singularity.augmentedValuation μ φ γ hφ hγ) (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, c j * φ ^ j) =
      (Finset.range N).sup fun j => μ (c j) * γ ^ j

    ∀ {z : K},
      z ≠ 0 →
        ∃ c a F G,
          c ≠ 0 ∧
            V.valuation F < 1 ∧
              V.valuation G < 1 ∧ z * (1 + G) = (algebraMap k K) c * Singularity.laurentMonomial x a * (1 + F)

            ∀ (S : Subalgebra k K),
              (∀ a ∈ E, Singularity.laurentMonomial x a ∈ S) → ∃ f g, f ∈ S ∧ g ∈ S ∧ V.valuation g = 1 ∧ z * g = f

          ∃ c α D F,
            c ≠ 0 ∧

                (∀ a ∈ D, V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial y a) < 1) ∧

Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor_hr.type: ∀ {v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ}, v 3 = 0 → ∀ i ∉ Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor, v i = 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.exG_eq.type:

  Singularity.OriginRuns.exG p =
    MvPolynomial.X 3 ^ p + MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 2 * MvPolynomial.X 3 ^ (p - 2)

Singularity.OriginRuns.exG_eq_exPoly.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], Singularity.OriginRuns.exG p = Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.exGen_eq.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {i : Fin 4},

      c • Singularity.OriginRuns.exG p + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.OriginRuns.exG p) =
        (MvPolynomial.monomial fun₀ | 3 => p) c +
          (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.OriginRuns.exOnes + fun₀ | 3 => p - 2)) (c + 1)

Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly_ne.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} (v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), (v + fun₀ | 3 => p) ≠ v + Singularity.OriginRuns.exOnes + fun₀ | 3 => p - 2

Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly_ne_zero.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v ≠ 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly_start.type:

      MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 2 * MvPolynomial.X 3 ^ (p - 2)

Singularity.OriginRuns.exStep_apply_thre.type: ∀ {j : Fin 4}, j ≠ 3 → ∀ (v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), (Singularity.OriginRuns.exStep j v) 3 = v 3

Singularity.OriginRuns.exSteps_apply_thr.type: ∀ {l : List (Fin 4)}, (∀ j ∈ l, j ≠ 3) → ∀ (v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), (Singularity.OriginRuns.exSteps l v) 3 = v 3

Singularity.OriginRuns.example_3_14_9.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {l : List (Fin 4)},
  (∀ j ∈ l, j ≠ 3) →
    have v := Singularity.OriginRuns.exSteps l fun₀ | 0 => 1;
    Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p fun₀ | 0 => 1) =
        Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v ∧
      Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p fun₀ | 0 => 1) ∧
        Singularity.IsClean p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) ∧
          Singularity.logJacobianOrder Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) = ↑p ∧
            Singularity.ord
                  (Singularity.residualFactor Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v)) =
                ↑p ∧
              (∀ (t : Fin 4),
                  t ≠ 3 →
                    Singularity.orderGAlong p Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor (Finset.univ.erase t)
                        (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
                      ↑p) ∧
                (∀ (s : Fin 4),
                    s ≠ 3 →
                      Singularity.orderGAlong p Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor {3, s}
                            (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
                          ↑(p - 1) ∧
                        ↑(p - 1) <
                          Singularity.logJacobianOrder Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor
                            (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v)) ∧
                  Singularity.orderGAlong p Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor {3} (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
                      ↑(p - 2) ∧
                    ∀ (j : Fin 4),
                      j ≠ 3 →
                        Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor, Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v)
                          (Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor,
                            Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exStep j v))

        (∀ s ∈ L, ∀ (N : ℕ), ∃ m, N ≤ m ∧ w m = s) →
          ∀ {S : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)},
            S.Nonempty →
              ∃ T ∈ S,
                ∃ m₀,

                    m₀ ≤ m →

    ∀ {w : ℕ → σ},
      (∀ (m : ℕ), w m ∈ L) →
        (∀ s ∈ L, ∀ (N : ℕ), ∃ m, N ≤ m ∧ w m = s) →
          ∀ {S : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)},
            S.Nonempty →
              ∃ T ∈ S,
                ∃ m₀,
                  ∀ (m : ℕ),
                    m₀ ≤ m →

                                  (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L (Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w 0 m) s)

Singularity.OriginRuns.le_ord_monomial_a.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ} {A B : σ →₀ ℕ},
  n ≤ Finsupp.degree A →
    n ≤ Finsupp.degree B → ∀ (a b : R), ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.monomial A) a + (MvPolynomial.monomial B) b)

Singularity.OriginRuns.le_ord_of_degreeG.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},

Singularity.OriginRuns.le_windowBound.type:

  {v v' : σ →₀ ℕ},
  v ∈ Singularity.OriginRuns.minimalSupport g →
    v' ∈ Singularity.OriginRuns.minimalSupport g →
      (Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ v - Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ v')).toNat - 1 ≤
        Singularity.OriginRuns.windowBound g

Singularity.OriginRuns.length_add_one_le.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {ws : List (List ι)},

Singularity.OriginRuns.logJacobianOrder_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p]
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.OriginRuns.HasLeastExponent g → Singularity.logJacobianOrder Finset.univ g = 0

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ},
  v 3 = 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) →
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) = ↑p

Singularity.OriginRuns.mem_minimalSuppor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {e : σ →₀ ℕ},
  e ∈ Singularity.OriginRuns.minimalSupport g ↔ e ∈ g.support ∧ ∀ e' ∈ g.support, e' ≤ e → e' = e

Singularity.OriginRuns.mem_runDivisor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (w : ℕ → σ) (Δ : Finset σ) {m n : ℕ},
  m < n → w m ∈ Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ n

Singularity.OriginRuns.mem_support_exPol.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {v d : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ},
  d ∈ (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v).support →
    (d = v + fun₀ | 3 => p) ∨ d = v + Singularity.OriginRuns.exOnes + fun₀ | 3 => p - 2

Singularity.OriginRuns.minimalSupport.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq σ] → [inst : Field k] → MvPolynomial σ k → Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)

Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum_diffStep.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (j : ι) (δ : ι → ℤ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ) =
    Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum δ - max (-δ j) 0 + max (-∑ i, δ i) 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum_diffStep_l.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (j : ι) (δ : ι → ℤ),
  0 ≤ ∑ i, δ i → Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ) ≤ Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.nonneg_diffStep.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {δ : ι → ℤ},
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ δ i) → ∀ (j i : ι), 0 ≤ Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ i

Singularity.OriginRuns.nonneg_diffSteps.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {δ : ι → ℤ},
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ δ i) → ∀ (l : List ι) (i : ι), 0 ≤ Singularity.OriginRuns.diffSteps l δ i

Singularity.OriginRuns.nonpos_diffStep.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {δ : ι → ℤ},
  (∀ (i : ι), δ i ≤ 0) → ∀ (j i : ι), Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ i ≤ 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.nonpos_diffSteps.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {δ : ι → ℤ},
  (∀ (i : ι), δ i ≤ 0) → ∀ (l : List ι) (i : ι), Singularity.OriginRuns.diffSteps l δ i ≤ 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.not_dvd_expStep.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {p : ℕ} (j : σ) {e : σ →₀ ℕ},
  p ≤ Finsupp.degree e → (¬∀ (i : σ), p ∣ e i) → ¬∀ (i : σ), p ∣ (Singularity.OriginRuns.expStep p j e) i

Singularity.OriginRuns.not_isMixed_iff.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] {δ : ι → ℤ}, ¬Singularity.OriginRuns.IsMixed δ ↔ (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ δ i) ∨ ∀ (i : ι), δ i ≤ 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.not_isMixed_of_ph.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {ws : List (List ι)},
  (∀ w ∈ ws, ∀ (i : ι), i ∈ w) →
    ∀ {δ : ι → ℤ},
      Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ ≤ ↑ws.length →
        ¬Singularity.OriginRuns.IsMixed (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffSteps ws.flatten δ)

Singularity.OriginRuns.one_le_phi.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {δ : ι → ℤ}, Singularity.OriginRuns.IsMixed δ → 1 ≤ Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.one_le_sum_of_non.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {δ : ι → ℤ}, (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ δ i) → δ ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ ∑ i, δ i

Singularity.OriginRuns.ord_eq_of_min.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {F : MvPolynomial σ k} {b : σ →₀ ℕ},
  b ∈ F.support → (∀ d ∈ F.support, Finsupp.degree b ≤ Finsupp.degree d) → Singularity.ord F = ↑(Finsupp.degree b)

Singularity.OriginRuns.ord_residualFacto.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.OriginRuns.HasLeastExponent g → Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Finset.univ g) = 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.orderGAlong_exPol.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ},

∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ},

      Singularity.orderGAlong p Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor {3} (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) = ↑(p - 2)

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_cornerC.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L Δ : Finset σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {T : σ →₀ ℕ} [CharP k p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      2 ≤ L.card →
        L ⊆ Δ →
          ∀ {w : ℕ → σ},
            (∀ (m : ℕ), w m ∈ L) →
              (∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) →
                T ∈ g.support →
                  ∀ (m : ℕ),
                    (∀ μ ∈ g.support,
                        Singularity.OriginRuns.CornerIneq p L
                          (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L (Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w 0 m)) T μ) →
                      Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m = Δ ∧
                        (∀ s ∈ L,
                            (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) s =
                              (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w 0 m) T) s) ∧
                          Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) =
                              ↑(Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum L T - ∑ u ∈ Lᶜ, (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) u) ∧
                            ∀ t ∈ L,
                              Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ (Finset.univ.erase t)
                                    (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m) =
                                  Singularity.ord
                                    (Singularity.residualFactor Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) ∧
                                Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m) ≤
                                  Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ (Finset.univ.erase t)
                                    (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L Δ : Finset σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k} [CharP k p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      g ≠ 0 →
        2 ≤ L.card →
          L ⊆ Δ →
            ∀ {w : ℕ → σ},
              (∀ (m : ℕ), w m ∈ L) →
                (∀ s ∈ L, ∀ (N : ℕ), ∃ m, N ≤ m ∧ w m = s) →
                  (∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) →
                    ∃ T ∈ g.support,
                      ∃ m₀,
                        ∀ (m : ℕ),
                          m₀ ≤ m →
                            Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m = Δ ∧
                              (∀ s ∈ L,
                                  (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) s =
                                    (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w 0 m) T) s) ∧
                                Singularity.ord
                                      (Singularity.residualFactor Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) =
                                    ↑(Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum L T - ∑ u ∈ Lᶜ, (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) u) ∧
                                  ∀ t ∈ L,
                                    Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ (Finset.univ.erase t)
                                          (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m) =
                                        Singularity.ord
                                          (Singularity.residualFactor Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) ∧
                                      Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m) ≤
                                        Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ (Finset.univ.erase t)
                                          (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_corner_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L : Finset σ}
  {l : List σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {T : σ →₀ ℕ},
  2 ≤ L.card →
    (∀ j ∈ l, j ∈ L) →
      Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →
        T ∈ g.support →
          ∀ {μ : σ →₀ ℕ},
            μ ∈ g.support →
              Singularity.OriginRuns.CornerIneq p L (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L l) T μ →
                ∀ {t : σ},
                  t ∈ L →
                    ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l T) i ≤
                      ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l μ) i

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_degree_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L : Finset σ}
  {l : List σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {T : σ →₀ ℕ},
  2 ≤ L.card →
    (∀ j ∈ l, j ∈ L) →
      Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →
        T ∈ g.support →
          ∀ {μ : σ →₀ ℕ},
            μ ∈ g.support →
              Singularity.OriginRuns.CornerIneq p L (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L l) T μ →
                Finsupp.degree (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l T) ≤
                  Finsupp.degree (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l μ)

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_divisor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L Δ : Finset σ}
  {l : List σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {T : σ →₀ ℕ},
  2 ≤ L.card →
    L ⊆ Δ →
      (∀ j ∈ l, j ∈ L) →
        Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →
          T ∈ g.support →
            (∀ μ ∈ g.support, Singularity.OriginRuns.CornerIneq p L (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L l) T μ) →
              ∀ s ∈ L,
                (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g)) s =
                  (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l T) s

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_exists_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p]
  {w : ℕ → σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} (Δ : Finset σ),
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      (∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) →
        (∀ (i : σ) (N : ℕ), ∃ m, N ≤ m ∧ w m = i) →
          ∃ m,
            Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m = Finset.univ ∧
              Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Finset.univ (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) = 0 ∧
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m)
                    (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m) =
                  0

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_exp_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L : Finset σ}
  {l : List σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {T : σ →₀ ℕ},
  2 ≤ L.card →
    (∀ j ∈ l, j ∈ L) →
      Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →
        T ∈ g.support →
          ∀ {μ : σ →₀ ℕ},
            μ ∈ g.support →
              Singularity.OriginRuns.CornerIneq p L (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L l) T μ →
                ∀ {s : σ}, s ∈ L → (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l T) s ≤ (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l μ) s

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_logJaco.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L Δ : Finset σ}
  {l : List σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {T : σ →₀ ℕ} [CharP k p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      2 ≤ L.card →
        L ⊆ Δ →
          (∀ j ∈ l, j ∈ L) →
            Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →
              T ∈ g.support →
                (∀ μ ∈ g.support, Singularity.OriginRuns.CornerIneq p L (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L l) T μ) →
                  ∀ {t : σ},
                    t ∈ L →
                      Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ (Finset.univ.erase t) (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g) =
                          Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g)) ∧
                        Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g) ≤
                          Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ (Finset.univ.erase t) (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g)

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_not_for.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p] {w : ℕ → σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k} (Δ : Finset σ),
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      (∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) →
        (∀ (m : ℕ),
            1 ≤
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m)
                (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) →
          ¬∀ (i : σ) (N : ℕ), ∃ m, N ≤ m ∧ w m = i

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_ord_res.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L Δ : Finset σ}
  {l : List σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {T : σ →₀ ℕ},
  2 ≤ L.card →
    L ⊆ Δ →
      (∀ j ∈ l, j ∈ L) →
        Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →
          T ∈ g.support →
            (∀ μ ∈ g.support, Singularity.OriginRuns.CornerIneq p L (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L l) T μ) →
              Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g)) =
                ↑(Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum L T - ∑ u ∈ Lᶜ, (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) u)

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_orderGA.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {L Δ : Finset σ}
  {l : List σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {T : σ →₀ ℕ} [CharP k p],

    Singularity.IsClean p g →

            Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →

                (∀ μ ∈ g.support, Singularity.OriginRuns.CornerIneq p L (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L l) T μ) →
                  ∀ {t : σ},
