                      Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ (Finset.univ.erase t) (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g) =
                        ↑(Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum L T - ∑ u ∈ Lᶜ, (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) u)

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_unit_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p]
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ∀ {ws : List (List σ)},
        (∀ w ∈ ws, ∀ (i : σ), i ∈ w) →
          Singularity.OriginRuns.windowBound g < ws.length →
            Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p ws.flatten g →
              Singularity.ord
                    (Singularity.residualFactor Finset.univ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p ws.flatten g)) =
                  0 ∧
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder Finset.univ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p ws.flatten g) = 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.originRun_unit_st.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p]
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    Singularity.OriginRuns.HasLeastExponent g →
      ∀ {l : List σ},
        Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →
          Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Finset.univ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g)) = 0 ∧
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Finset.univ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g) = 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.originStep.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p g →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      (Singularity.pointChart j 0) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g ∧
        (insert j Δ, Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g) =
          (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j 0, Singularity.cleanPart p (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g))

Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → σ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform_e.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {j : Fin 4},
  j ≠ 3 →
    ∀ (v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ),
      Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
        Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exStep j v)

Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform_n.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ} (j : σ) {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p g → g ≠ 0 → Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g ≠ 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.pderiv_three_exG.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv 3) (Singularity.OriginRuns.exG p) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial ((Singularity.OriginRuns.exOnes + fun₀ | 3 => p - 2) - fun₀ | 3 => 1)) ↑(p - 2)

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_diffStep_le.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (j : ι) (δ : ι → ℤ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ) ≤ Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_diffStep_lt_o.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {j : ι} {δ : ι → ℤ},
  0 ≤ ∑ i, δ i →
    δ j < 0 → Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ) < Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {j : ι} {δ : ι → ℤ},
  ∑ i, δ i ≤ 0 →
    0 < δ j → Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ) < Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {j : ι} {δ : ι → ℤ},
  0 ≤ ∑ i, δ i →
    ∑ i, Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ i < 0 →
      Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ) < Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_diffSteps_le.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (l : List ι) (δ : ι → ℤ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffSteps l δ) ≤ Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_diffSteps_lt.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {l : List ι} {δ : ι → ℤ},
  Singularity.OriginRuns.IsMixed δ →
    (∀ (i : ι), i ∈ l) →
      Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffSteps l δ) < Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_diffSteps_lt_.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {l : List ι} {δ : ι → ℤ},
  0 ≤ ∑ i, δ i →
    ∀ {j : ι},
      j ∈ l → δ j < 0 → Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffSteps l δ) < Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_eq_negSum.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (δ : ι → ℤ),
  0 ≤ ∑ i, δ i → Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ = Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_le_negSum.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (δ : ι → ℤ), Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ ≤ Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_le_posSum.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (δ : ι → ℤ), Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ ≤ Singularity.OriginRuns.posSum δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.phi_neg.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (δ : ι → ℤ), Singularity.OriginRuns.phi (-δ) = Singularity.OriginRuns.phi δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.pointChart_eq_X_p.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {p : ℕ} (j : σ)
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p g →
    (Singularity.pointChart j 0) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g

Singularity.OriginRuns.pointChart_monomi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] (p : ℕ) (j : σ) {e : σ →₀ ℕ},
  p ≤ Finsupp.degree e →
    ∀ (c : k),
      (Singularity.pointChart j 0) ((MvPolynomial.monomial e) c) =
        MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.OriginRuns.expStep p j e)) c

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] (j : σ) (e : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.pointChart j 0) ((MvPolynomial.monomial e) 1) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (e + fun₀ | j => Finsupp.degree e - e j)) 1

Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → List σ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps_append.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) (l₁ l₂ : List σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p (l₁ ++ l₂) g =
    Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l₂ (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l₁ g)

Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps_cons.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) (j : σ) (l : List σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p (j :: l) g =
    Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g)

Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps_exPoly.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {l : List (Fin 4)},
  (∀ j ∈ l, j ≠ 3) →
    ∀ (v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ),
      Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
          Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exSteps l v) ∧
        Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v)

Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps_ne_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ} {l : List σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k}, Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g → g ≠ 0 → Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g ≠ 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps_nil.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p [] g = g

Singularity.OriginRuns.posSum_diffStep.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (j : ι) (δ : ι → ℤ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.posSum (Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ) =
    Singularity.OriginRuns.posSum δ - max (δ j) 0 + max (∑ i, δ i) 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.posSum_sub_negSum.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (δ : ι → ℤ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.posSum δ - Singularity.OriginRuns.negSum δ = ∑ i, δ i

Singularity.OriginRuns.qDiff.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → (L : Finset σ) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → ↥L → ℤ

Singularity.OriginRuns.qDot.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → Finset σ → (σ →₀ ℕ) → (σ → ℤ) → ℤ

Singularity.OriginRuns.qDot_sub_cols.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {L : Finset σ} (p : ℕ) (μ ν : σ →₀ ℕ) (l : List ↥L)
  (s : ↥L),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.qDot p L μ (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L (List.map Subtype.val l) ↑s) -
      Singularity.OriginRuns.qDot p L ν (Singularity.OriginRuns.cols L (List.map Subtype.val l) ↑s) =
    Singularity.OriginRuns.diffSteps l (Singularity.OriginRuns.qDiff p L μ ν) s

Singularity.OriginRuns.qDot_sub_qDot.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {L : Finset σ} (p : ℕ) (μ ν : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : σ → σ → ℤ)
  (s : ↥L),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.qDot p L μ (c ↑s) - Singularity.OriginRuns.qDot p L ν (c ↑s) =
    Singularity.OriginRuns.colDot L (fun t => Singularity.OriginRuns.qVec p L μ t - Singularity.OriginRuns.qVec p L ν t)
      c s

Singularity.OriginRuns.qVec.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → Finset σ → (σ →₀ ℕ) → σ → ℤ

Singularity.OriginRuns.qVec.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {inst_1 : DecidableEq σ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (p p_1 : ℕ),
  p = p_1 →
    ∀ (L L_1 : Finset σ),
      L = L_1 →
        ∀ (e e_1 : σ →₀ ℕ),
          e = e_1 →
            ∀ (t t_1 : σ), t = t_1 → Singularity.OriginRuns.qVec p L e t = Singularity.OriginRuns.qVec p_1 L_1 e_1 t_1

Singularity.OriginRuns.residualFactor_ex.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ},
  v 3 = 0 →
    Singularity.residualFactor Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) =
      Singularity.OriginRuns.exG p

Singularity.OriginRuns.rhoStep_exPoly.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {j : Fin 4},
  j ≠ 3 →
    ∀ {v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ},
      v 3 = 0 →
        Singularity.IsClean p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v) →
          Singularity.RhoStep p p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor, Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p v)
            (Singularity.OriginRuns.exDivisor, Singularity.OriginRuns.exPoly p (Singularity.OriginRuns.exStep j v))

Singularity.OriginRuns.rhoStep_originSte.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {p m : ℕ}
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
          Singularity.logJacobianOrder (insert j Δ) (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g) = ↑m →
            Singularity.RhoStep p m (Δ, g) (insert j Δ, Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g)

Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq σ] → (ℕ → σ) → Finset σ → ℕ → Finset σ

Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor.eq_def.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (w : ℕ → σ) (Δ : Finset σ) (x : ℕ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ x =
    match x with
    | 0 => Δ
    | m.succ => insert (w m) (Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m)

Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor_eq_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {Δ : Finset σ} {w : ℕ → σ},
  (∀ (m : ℕ), w m ∈ Δ) → ∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m = Δ

Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor_mono.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (w : ℕ → σ) (Δ : Finset σ) {m m' : ℕ},
  m ≤ m' → Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m ⊆ Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m'

Singularity.OriginRuns.runList.type: {σ : Type u_1} → (ℕ → σ) → ℕ → ℕ → List σ

Singularity.OriginRuns.runList_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : ℕ → σ) (a n n' : ℕ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w a (n + n') =
    Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w a n ++ Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w (a + n) n'

Singularity.OriginRuns.runList_succ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} (w : ℕ → σ) (a n : ℕ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w a (n + 1) = Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w a n ++ [w (a + n)]

Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoint_step.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {p : ℕ}
  {w : ℕ → σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} (Δ : Finset σ),
  (∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ∀ (m : ℕ),
        (Singularity.pointChart (w m) 0) (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m) =
            MvPolynomial.X (w m) ^ p * Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g (m + 1) ∧
          (Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ (m + 1), Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g (m + 1)) =
            (Singularity.blowupDivisor (Singularity.OriginRuns.runDivisor w Δ m) (w m) 0,
              Singularity.cleanPart p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g (m + 1)))

Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → (ℕ → σ) → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) (w : ℕ → σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k) (a n : ℕ),
  Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g (a + n) =
    Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runList w a n) (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g a)

Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly_ne_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ} {w : ℕ → σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p (Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m)) →
    g ≠ 0 → ∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.OriginRuns.runPoly p w g m ≠ 0

Singularity.OriginRuns.sum_comp_update.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (F : ℤ → ℤ) (δ : ι → ℤ) (j : ι) (v : ℤ),
  ∑ i, F (Function.update δ j v i) = ∑ i, F (δ i) - F (δ j) + F v

Singularity.OriginRuns.sum_le_sum_diffSt.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {δ : ι → ℤ},
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ δ i) → ∀ (j : ι), ∑ i, δ i ≤ ∑ i, Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j δ i

Singularity.OriginRuns.sum_neg_apply.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (δ : ι → ℤ), ∑ i, (-δ) i = -∑ i, δ i

Singularity.OriginRuns.sum_univ_erase_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {L : Finset σ} {t : σ},
  t ∈ L → ∀ (f : σ → ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, f i = ∑ s ∈ L.erase t, f s + ∑ u ∈ Lᶜ, f u

Singularity.OriginRuns.support_originTra.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {p : ℕ} (j : σ)
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.OriginRuns.DegreeGe p g →
    (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g).support = Finset.image (Singularity.OriginRuns.expStep p j) g.support

Singularity.OriginRuns.support_polySteps.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {l : List σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.OriginRuns.IsAdmissible p l g →
    (Singularity.OriginRuns.polySteps p l g).support = Finset.image (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l) g.support ∧
      ∀ e ∈ g.support, Singularity.OriginRuns.ExpAdmissible p l e

Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ_expStep_sub.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {p : ℕ} (j : σ) {e e' : σ →₀ ℕ},
  p ≤ Finsupp.degree e →
    p ≤ Finsupp.degree e' →
      Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ (Singularity.OriginRuns.expStep p j e) -
          Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ (Singularity.OriginRuns.expStep p j e') =
        Singularity.OriginRuns.diffStep j (Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ e - Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ e')

Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ_expSteps_sub.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {p : ℕ} {l : List σ} {e e' : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Singularity.OriginRuns.ExpAdmissible p l e →
    Singularity.OriginRuns.ExpAdmissible p l e' →
      Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l e) -
          Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l e') =
        Singularity.OriginRuns.diffSteps l (Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ e - Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ e')

Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ_sum.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (e : σ →₀ ℕ), ∑ i, Singularity.OriginRuns.toZ e i = ↑(Finsupp.degree e)

Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → (σ →₀ ℕ) → ℕ

Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {inst_1 : DecidableEq σ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (L L_1 : Finset σ),
  L = L_1 → ∀ (e e_1 : σ →₀ ℕ), e = e_1 → Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum L e = Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum L_1 e_1

Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum_expSteps.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) (L : Finset σ) {l : List σ},
  (∀ j ∈ l, j ∈ L) →
    ∀ {e : σ →₀ ℕ},
      Singularity.OriginRuns.ExpAdmissible p l e →
        Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum L (Singularity.OriginRuns.expSteps p l e) = Singularity.OriginRuns.uSum L e

Singularity.OriginRuns.unitCols.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → σ → ℤ

Singularity.OriginRuns.windowBound.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → [inst : Field k] → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ

Singularity.OriginRuns.windowBound.congr.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] {inst_1 : DecidableEq σ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_3 : Field k]
  (g g_1 : MvPolynomial σ k), g = g_1 → Singularity.OriginRuns.windowBound g = Singularity.OriginRuns.windowBound g_1

Singularity.P1Hypersurface.type: (k : Type u) → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

Singularity.P1Ring.type: (k : Type u) → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k → Type u

Singularity.Perron.IsValidRun.type: {ι : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq ι] → (ι → ℝ) → List (ι × ι) → Prop

Singularity.Perron.IsValidRun.congr_simp.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {inst : DecidableEq ι} [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (w w_1 : ι → ℝ),
  w = w_1 →
    ∀ (a a_1 : List (ι × ι)), a = a_1 → Singularity.Perron.IsValidRun w a = Singularity.Perron.IsValidRun w_1 a_1

Singularity.Perron.IsValidRun.eq_def.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (x : List (ι × ι)),
  Singularity.Perron.IsValidRun w x =
    match x with
    | [] => True
    | s :: l => w s.1 < w s.2 ∧ Singularity.Perron.IsValidRun (Singularity.Perron.stepWeight w s) l

Singularity.Perron.adjoin_range_le_adjoi.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {K : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field K] (k : Type u_3) [inst_3 : Field k]
  [inst_4 : Algebra k K] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    ∀ {l : List (ι × ι)},
      (∀ s ∈ l, s.1 ≠ s.2) →
        Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range x) ≤ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (Singularity.Perron.runCoord x l))

Singularity.Perron.coe_runExpNat.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (l : List (ι × ι)) (d : ι →₀ ℕ),
  (fun i => ↑((Singularity.Perron.runExpNat l d) i)) = Singularity.Perron.runExp l fun i => ↑(d i)

Singularity.Perron.coe_stepExpNat.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : ι × ι) (d : ι →₀ ℕ),
  (fun i => ↑((Singularity.Perron.stepExpNat s d) i)) = Singularity.Perron.stepExp s fun i => ↑(d i)

Singularity.Perron.coeff_runHom.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {k : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommSemiring k] {l : List (ι × ι)},
  Function.Injective (Singularity.Perron.runExpNat l) →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial ι k) (d : ι →₀ ℕ),
      ((Singularity.Perron.runHom k l) f).coeff (Singularity.Perron.runExpNat l d) = f.coeff d

Singularity.Perron.constantCoeff_runHom.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] {k : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommSemiring k] {l : List (ι × ι)},
  (∀ s ∈ l, s.1 ≠ s.2) →
    ∀ (g : MvPolynomial ι k),
      MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((Singularity.Perron.runHom k l) g) = MvPolynomial.constantCoeff g

Singularity.Perron.stepExp_add.type:

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : ι × ι) (D : ι → ℤ) (l : ι),

    ∀ {γ : ι → ℝ},

        ∀ {l : List (ι × ι)},

∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w →

        (∀ q ∈ S, q ≠ qs → Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ qs < Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ q) →
          ∃ m₀,
            m ≤ m₀ ∧
              ∀ m' ≥ m₀,
                ∀ q ∈ S,

∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} {p : ℕ}
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] [PerfectRing k p] (hθ : Irrational θ) (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w)
  (t : ℕ → σ → k),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarRun t →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥(Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring),
      (∀ (e : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.Above (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w 0) 0 ↑(f.coeff e)) →
        ∀ (i₀ : σ),
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i₀ => 1) f ≠ 0 →
            (∀ (i : σ),
                (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerEval hθ hw t (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i₀ => 1) f)) ≤
                  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerEval hθ hw t (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1) f))) →
              (∀ (i : σ) (a : ℕ),
                  1 ≤ a →
                    Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ a) f ≠ 0 →
                      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                            (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerEval hθ hw t
                              (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i₀ => 1) f)) +
                          ↑(1 + θ) <
                        (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                            (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerEval hθ hw t
                              (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ a) f)) +
                          ↑(↑(p ^ a) * (1 + θ))) →
                ∀ {x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k},
                  Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerEval hθ hw t (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i₀ => 1) f) = x →
                    ∃ m₂,
                      ∀ m ≥ m₂,
                        x.order + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w m ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w m ∧
                          ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i₀ => 1)
                                        (Singularity.PlanarRuns.chartAt w t m
                                          ((MvPolynomial.map (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).subtype)
                                            f))).coeff
                                    0).coeff
                                (x.order + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w m) =
                              x.coeff x.order ∧
                            (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
                                Singularity.PlanarRuns.Above (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w m)
                                  (x.order + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w m)
                                  ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i₀ => 1)
                                        (Singularity.PlanarRuns.chartAt w t m
                                          ((MvPolynomial.map (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).subtype)
                                            f))).coeff
                                    d)) ∧
                              ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
                                d ≠ 0 →
                                  Singularity.PlanarRuns.Above (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w m)
                                    (x.order + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w m)
                                    ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.chartAt w t m
                                          ((MvPolynomial.map (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).subtype)
                                            f)).coeff
                                      d)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.belowSet_mul_subs.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.box.type: (σ : Type u_3) → [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {K : Type u_2} → [inst : Field K] → (σ → K) → K → MvPolynomial σ K → MvPolynomial σ K

Singularity.PlanarRuns.chartAt.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →

Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart_C_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (φ : σ → K) (M a : K) (f : MvPolynomial σ K),

Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart_chart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (φ φ' : σ → K) (M M' : K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K),

    Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart (fun i => φ i + M * φ' i) (M * M') g

Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart_mem_powerFo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K} {cl : K →+ K}
  [CharP K p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
      ∀ (φ : σ → K) (M : K) {h : MvPolynomial σ K},
        h ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.powerForm p K0 →
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M h ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.powerForm p K0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart_sub.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (φ : σ → K) (M : K) (f g : MvPolynomial σ K),

Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart_zero_one.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (g : MvPolynomial σ K), Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart 0 1 g = g

Singularity.PlanarRuns.choose_mul_choose.type: ∀ (a b c : ℕ), (a + b).choose b * (a + b + c).choose c = (c + b).choose c * (a + (c + b)).choose (c + b)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cl0_eval_hasse_po.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K} [CharP K p],
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
      M ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K) {N : ℕ},
          (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i g ≤ N) →
            ∀ (i : σ) {e : ℕ},
              1 ≤ e →
                (MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) -
                    cl
                      ((MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                        (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e)
                          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g))) =
                  M ^ (p ^ e - p) *
                    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restartSum p g φ Δ i e N -
                      cl (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restartSum p g φ Δ i e N))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.clCoeff.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {K : Type u_2} → [Fintype σ] → [inst : Field K] → ℕ → (K →+ K) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → K → K

Singularity.PlanarRuns.clCoeff_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K) (k : σ →₀ ℕ),

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cl_eval_restart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
      M ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K),
          cl ((MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) =
            (M ^ p)⁻¹ * cl ((MvPolynomial.eval (φ + Δ)) g)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.classHom.type: {θ : ℝ} → (p : ℕ) → Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ →+ ZMod p × ZMod p

Singularity.PlanarRuns.classHom_expAt_eq.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.classHom_ne_zero_.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {σ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.classHom_nsmul_se.type: ∀ {θ : ℝ} (p : ℕ) (r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ), (Singularity.PlanarRuns.classHom p) (p • r) = 0

{θ : ℝ} →

Singularity.PlanarRuns.classPart0_eq_zer.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (p : ℕ) {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k},

Singularity.PlanarRuns.classPart_add.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.clean.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {K : Type u_2} → [Fintype σ] → [inst : Field K] → ℕ → (K →+ K) → MvPolynomial σ K → MvPolynomial σ K

Singularity.PlanarRuns.clean_C_mul.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.clean_chart_clean.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}

Singularity.PlanarRuns.clean_eq_sub_remo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K) (h : MvPolynomial σ K),

Singularity.PlanarRuns.clean_eq_zero_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}

Singularity.PlanarRuns.clean_sub.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coe_eval_cornerPo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} (hθ : Irrational θ) (t : ℕ → σ → k) (m : ℕ)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_chart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] (φ : σ → K) (M : K)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_classPart.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (p : ℕ) {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (c : ZMod p × ZMod p)

  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.classPart p c x).coeff r = if (Singularity.PlanarRuns.classHom p) r = c then x.coeff r else 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_clean.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_clean_chart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K) (φ : σ → K)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_cornerLimit.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c : ℕ → k)
  (r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ),
  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c).coeff r =
    if h : ∃ j, Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1) = r then c (Classical.choose h) else 0

∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c : ℕ → k)
  (j : ℕ), (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c).coeff (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1)) = c j

∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c : ℕ → k)
  {r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ},
  (∀ (j : ℕ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1) ≠ r) → (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c).coeff r = 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_cornerTail.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c : ℕ → k)
  (m j : ℕ),
  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c -
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w) (fun j => HahnSeries.C (c j)) m).coeff
      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1)) =
    if m ≤ j then c j else 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_hahnCl.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) (x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k)
  (r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ),
  ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnCl p) x).coeff r = if (Singularity.PlanarRuns.classHom p) r = 0 then 0 else x.coeff r

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_hasse.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (k m : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R), (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f).coeff m = (∏ i, (m i + k i).choose (k i)) • f.coeff (m + k)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_mapCoeff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] (f : R →+ R) (h : MvPolynomial σ R) (k : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.mapCoeff f h).coeff k = f (h.coeff k)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_mul_sum_sin.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι)
  (α : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k) (a : ι → Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) (b : ι → k)
  (r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ),
  (α * ∑ i ∈ s, (HahnSeries.single (a i)) (b i)).coeff r = ∑ i ∈ s, α.coeff (r - a i) * b i

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_order_eq_of.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {x y : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k},
  x ≠ 0 →
    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k) x < (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k) (x - y) →
      y.coeff x.order = x.coeff x.order

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_order_ne.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k},
  x ≠ 0 → x.coeff x.order ≠ 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_removed_ne_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {cl : K →+ K}
  {h : MvPolynomial σ K} {k : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed p cl h).coeff k ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (i : σ), p ∣ k i) ∧ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed p cl h).coeff k = h.coeff k - cl (h.coeff k)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_restart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K) (φ : σ → K)
  (M : K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (k : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g).coeff k =
    (M ^ p)⁻¹ *
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.clCoeff p cl k
        (M ^ Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k * (MvPolynomial.eval φ) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_weightMul.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (f : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ → k)
  (x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k) (r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ),
  ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.weightMul f) x).coeff r = f r * x.coeff r

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coeff_zero_hasse.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (k : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R), (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f).coeff 0 = f.coeff k

Singularity.PlanarRuns.condC_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.CondC p g ↔
    ∀ (e : ℕ),
      1 ≤ e →
        ∀ (i : σ),
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e) g =
            MvPolynomial.C ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e) g).coeff 0)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.condC_of_eq_sum.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommRing R] {p : ℕ} [CharP R p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (α : ℕ → σ → R) {h : MvPolynomial σ R},
      h.totalDegree < p →
        Singularity.PlanarRuns.CondC p (∑ e ∈ s, ∑ i, MvPolynomial.C (α e i) * MvPolynomial.X i ^ p ^ e + h)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.condC_of_totalDeg.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] {p : ℕ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ R}, g.totalDegree ≤ p → Singularity.PlanarRuns.CondC p g

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone_le_succ.type: ∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w m ≤ Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w (m + 1)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone_mono.type: ∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) {m n : ℕ}, m ≤ n → Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w m ≤ Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w n

Singularity.PlanarRuns.conjectureP_corne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} {p : ℕ}
  [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (t : ℕ → σ → k)
  (F : Subring (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k))
  (hF : ∀ (m : ℕ) (l : σ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPoint t m l ∈ F) (g : MvPolynomial σ ↥F),
  (∀ (kk : σ →₀ ℕ),
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse kk g ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.PlanarRuns.StatementDHolds (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k) F
          (fun m l => ⟨Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPoint t m l, ⋯⟩)
          (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l) (1 + θ) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse kk g)) →
    ∀ (μ : ℕ → WithTop ℝ),
      (∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
          ∃ e,
            1 ≤ e ∧

Singularity.PlanarRuns.coord_col.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m n : ℕ),
  ∃ α β γ δ,
    1 ≤ α ∧
      0 ≤ β ∧
        0 ≤ γ ∧
          1 ≤ δ ∧
            (∀ (r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ),
                Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordY w (m + n) r =
                  α * Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordY w m r + β * Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordZ w m r) ∧
              (∀ (r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ),
                  Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordZ w (m + n) r =
                    γ * Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordY w m r + δ * Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordZ w m r) ∧
                Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w (m + n)) =
                    ↑α * Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m) -
                      ↑β * Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m) ∧
                  Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w (m + n)) =
                    ↑δ * Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m) -

      [inst : Field k] →
        Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w → (ℕ → k) → HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit.congr.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {w w_1 : ℕ → Bool} (e_w : w = w_1) {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k]
  (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c c_1 : ℕ → k),
  c = c_1 → Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c = Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit ⋯ c_1

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerM.type: (θ : ℝ) → (k : Type u_1) → [inst : Field k] → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerM_ne_zero.type: ∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerM θ k w m ≠ 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerMono.type: {R : Type u_1} → [CommRing R] → (ℕ → R) → ℕ → R

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerMono.eq_def.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (L : ℕ → R) (x : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerMono L x =
    match x with
    | 0 => 1
    | m.succ => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerMono L m * L m

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerMono_corner.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerMono (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w) m = Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerM θ k w m

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPoint.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {θ : ℝ} →
    {k : Type u_2} →
      [inst : Field k] → {w : ℕ → Bool} → (ℕ → σ → k) → ℕ → σ → HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPointFT.type:
{θ : ℝ} →
  {k : Type u_1} →
    [inst : Field k] →
      {σ : Type u_2} →
        {w : ℕ → Bool} →
          (hθ : Irrational θ) → (ℕ → σ → k) → ℕ → σ → ↥(Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerRunFn.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  [Fintype σ] →
    {θ : ℝ} →
      {k : Type u_2} →
        [inst : Field k] →
          ℕ →
            (ℕ → Bool) →
              (ℕ → σ → k) →
                MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k) →
                  ℕ → MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerRunFn_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field k] (p : ℕ) (w : ℕ → Bool) (t : ℕ → σ → k)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k)) (m : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerRunFn p w t g m =
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnCl p)
      (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPoint t m l) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerM θ k w m) g

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerRunFn_succ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ}
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (w : ℕ → Bool) (t : ℕ → σ → k)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k)) (m : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerRunFn p w t g (m + 1) =
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnCl p)
      (fun i => HahnSeries.C (t m i) * Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w m) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w m)
      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerRunFn p w t g m)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum.type: {R : Type u_1} → [CommRing R] → (ℕ → R) → (ℕ → R) → ℕ → R

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum.eq_def.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (L a : ℕ → R) (x : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum L a x =
    match x with
    | 0 => 0
    | m.succ => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum L a m + a m * Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerMono L (m + 1)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum_eq.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (w : ℕ → Bool) (c : ℕ → k) (m : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w) (fun j => HahnSeries.C (c j)) m =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (HahnSeries.single (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1))) (c j)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerTail_pow.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c : ℕ → k)
  {p : ℕ} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (e : ℕ) {m J : ℕ},
  m ≤ J →
    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c -
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w) (fun j => HahnSeries.C (c j)) m) ^
        p ^ e =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico m J, (HahnSeries.single (p ^ e • Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1))) (c j ^ p ^ e) +
        (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c -
            Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w) (fun j => HahnSeries.C (c j)) J) ^
          p ^ e

Singularity.PlanarRuns.degreeOf_hasse_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (k : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f) ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f - k i

Singularity.PlanarRuns.det_expY_expZ.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ),
  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m).fst * (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m).snd -
      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m).snd * (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m).fst =
    1

Singularity.PlanarRuns.divY.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {θ : ℝ} →
    {k : Type u_2} →
      [inst : Field k] → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k) → ℕ

Singularity.PlanarRuns.divZ.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {θ : ℝ} →
    {k : Type u_2} →
      [inst : Field k] → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k) → ℕ

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eq_cornerSum_add_.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (L a x : ℕ → R),
  (∀ (m : ℕ), x m = L m * (x (m + 1) + a m)) →
    ∀ (m : ℕ), x 0 = Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum L a m + Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerMono L m * x m

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eq_zero_or_add_of.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {S : Set (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ)} {r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ},
  r ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure S → r = 0 ∨ ∃ s ∈ S, ∃ r' ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure S, r = s + r'

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eval_chart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (φ x : σ → K) (M : K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K),
  (MvPolynomial.eval x) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M g) = (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => φ i + M * x i) g

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eval_hasse_pow_re.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
      M ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K) {N : ℕ},
          (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i g ≤ N) →
            ∀ (i : σ) (e : ℕ),
              (MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) =
                M ^ (↑(p ^ e) - ↑p) *
                  ∑ k ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.box σ N,
                    ↑((k i).choose (p ^ e)) *
                        Singularity.PlanarRuns.clCoeff p cl k
                          ((MvPolynomial.eval φ) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g)) *
                      ∏ l, Δ l ^ (k l - (fun₀ | i => p ^ e) l)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eval_hasse_remove.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ K) {j : σ →₀ ℕ},
      (∀ (i : σ), p ∣ j i) →
        ∀ (x : σ → K),
          (MvPolynomial.eval x) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j (Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed p cl h)) ∈ K0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eval_hasse_restar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K)
  (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
  M ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (j : σ →₀ ℕ),
      (MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) =
        (M ^ p)⁻¹ *
          (M ^ Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord j * (MvPolynomial.eval (φ + Δ)) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j g) -
            (MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
              (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j
                (Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed p cl (Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M g))))

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
      M ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K) {N : ℕ},
          (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i g ≤ N) →
            ∀ (j : σ →₀ ℕ),
              (MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) =
                M ^ (↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord j) - ↑p) *
                  ∑ k ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.box σ N,
                    ↑(∏ i, (k i).choose (j i)) *
                        Singularity.PlanarRuns.clCoeff p cl k
                          ((MvPolynomial.eval φ) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g)) *
                      ∏ i, Δ i ^ (k i - j i)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eval_hasse_single.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} [CharP K p] (cl : K →+ K)
  (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
  M ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (i : σ),
      (MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) =
        M ^ (1 - ↑p) * (MvPolynomial.eval (φ + Δ)) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1) g)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eval\u2082_C_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (φ : σ → K) (f : MvPolynomial σ K),
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun i => MvPolynomial.C (φ i)) f = MvPolynomial.C ((MvPolynomial.eval φ) f)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eval\u2082_add_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] {S : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : CommSemiring S] (φ : R →+* S) (a s : σ → S) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) {N : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f ≤ N) →
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ (a + s) f =
      ∑ k ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.box σ N, MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ a (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f) * ∏ i, s i ^ k i

Singularity.PlanarRuns.eventually_lt_add.type:
∀ {γ : ℕ → ℝ} {Θ : ℝ},
  Filter.Tendsto γ Filter.atTop (nhds Θ) →
    ∀ {a b : WithTop ℝ} (n : ℕ), a < b + ↑(↑n * Θ) → ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, a < b + ↑(↑n * γ m)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.exists_le_map_cl0.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K} [CharP K p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
      ∀ (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)),
        (∀ (x : K), v x ≤ v (x - cl x)) →
          ∀ (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
            M ≠ 0 →
              ∀ {r γ : ℝ},
                v M = ↑r →
                  (∀ (l : σ), ↑γ ≤ v (Δ l)) →
                    ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K) {N : ℕ},
                      (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i g ≤ N) →
                        ∀ (i : σ) {e : ℕ},
                          1 ≤ e →
                            (MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                                    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e)
                                      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) -
                                  cl
                                    ((MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                                      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e)
                                        (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g))) ≠
                                0 →
                              ∃ k ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.restartIndex p g i e N,
                                v ((MvPolynomial.eval φ) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g)) +
                                    ↑((↑(p ^ e) - ↑p) * r + (↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k) - ↑(p ^ e)) * γ) ≤
                                  v
                                    ((MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                                        (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e)
                                          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) -
                                      cl
                                        ((MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                                          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ e)
                                            (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g))))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.exists_ne_zero_of.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] {k : σ →₀ ℕ}, k ≠ 0 → ∃ i, k i ≠ 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.exists_pow_not_dv.type: ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → ∃ e, p ^ e ≤ n ∧ ¬p ∣ n.choose (p ^ e)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expAt.type: {θ : ℝ} → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → ℤ → ℤ → Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expAt_add.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ) (a b a' b' : ℤ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.expAt w m (a + a') (b + b') =
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.expAt w m a b + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expAt w m a' b'

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expAt_coord.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ) (r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.expAt w m (Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordY w m r) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordZ w m r) = r

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expL_mem_cone.type: ∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) {l n : ℕ}, l < n → Singularity.PlanarRuns.expL w l ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w n

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM.eq_def.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (x : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w x =
    match x with
    | 0 => 0
    | m.succ => Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w m + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expL w m

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM_eq.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w m =
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.mk 1 1 - (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM_mem_cone.type: ∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) {b n : ℕ}, b ≤ n → Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w b ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w n

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM_sub_mem_cone.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) {a b n : ℕ},
  a ≤ b → b ≤ n → Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w b - Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w a ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w n

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ.type: {θ : ℝ} → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ × Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ.eq_def.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (x : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ w x =
    match x with
    | 0 => (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.mk 1 0, Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.mk 0 1)
    | m.succ =>
      if w m = true then
        ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ w m).1,
          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ w m).2 - (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ w m).1)
      else
        ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ w m).1 - (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ w m).2,
          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expYZ w m).2)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY_succ.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w (m + 1) =
    if w m = true then Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m
    else Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m - Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m

Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ_succ.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w (m + 1) =
    if w m = true then Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m - Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m
    else Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m

Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfiel.type:
{θ : ℝ} →
  (k : Type u_1) → [inst : Field k] → Irrational θ → Subfield (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.finite_belowSet_m.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c : ℕ → k)
  (m : ℕ) {u : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFiniteType u →
    ∀ {s0 : ℝ},
      0 < s0 →
        (∀ r ∈ u.support, s0 ≤ Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ r) →
          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.belowSet (1 + θ)
              (u *
                (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c -
                  Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w) (fun j => HahnSeries.C (c j))
                    m))).Finite

Singularity.PlanarRuns.finite_belowSet_s.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (V : ℝ)
  (x : ι → HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k),
  (∀ i ∈ s, (Singularity.PlanarRuns.belowSet V (x i)).Finite) →
    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.belowSet V (∑ i ∈ s, x i)).Finite

Singularity.PlanarRuns.finite_closure_be.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {S : Set (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ)} {s0 : ℝ},
  0 < s0 →
    (∀ s ∈ S, s0 ≤ Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ s) →
      (∀ (V : ℝ), {s | s ∈ S ∧ Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ s < V}.Finite) →
        ∀ (V : ℝ), {r | r ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure S ∧ Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ r < V}.Finite

Singularity.PlanarRuns.finite_smul_expM_.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool},
  Irrational θ →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w →
      ∀ {p : ℕ},
        Nat.Prime p →
          ∀ {e e' : ℕ} (d : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ),
            e ≠ e' ∨ d ≠ 0 →
              {j |
                  ∃ j',
                    p ^ e • Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1) =
                      d + p ^ e' • Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j' + 1)}.Finite

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnCl.type:
{θ : ℝ} →
  ℕ →
    {k : Type u_1} →
      [inst : Field k] →
        HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k →+ HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnK0.type: {θ : ℝ} → ℕ → {k : Type u_1} → [inst : Field k] → Subring (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal.type:
(θ : ℝ) →
  (k : Type u_1) → [inst : Field k] → AddValuation (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k) (WithTop ℝ)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal_add_sum_m.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {σ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {w : ℕ → Bool},
  Irrational θ →
    ∀ (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (t : ℕ → σ → k),
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarRun t →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (α : σ → HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k),
          (∀ (l : σ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFiniteType (α l)) →
            α ≠ 0 →
              ∀ (c : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k),
                Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFiniteType c →
                  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                      (c +
                        ∑ l,
                          α l *
                            ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l) -
                              Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPoint t m l)) <
                    (Finset.univ.inf fun l => (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k) (α l)) + ↑(1 + θ)

∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} {σ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {p : ℕ}
  [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] [PerfectRing k p],
  Irrational θ →
    ∀ (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (t : ℕ → σ → k),
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarRun t →
        ∀ (m n : ℕ) (α : σ × ℕ → HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k),
          (∀ (x : σ × ℕ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFiniteType (α x)) →
            (∃ x ∈ Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.range n, α x ≠ 0) →
              ∀ (c : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k),
                Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFiniteType c →
                  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                      (c +
                        ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.range n,
                          α x *
                            ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j x.1) -
                                Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPoint t m x.1) ^
                              p ^ x.2) <
                    (Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.range n).inf fun x =>
                      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k) (α x) + ↑(↑(p ^ x.2) * (1 + θ))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal_cornerM.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Fintype σ] → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_C_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommRing R] (k : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k (MvPolynomial.C a * f) = MvPolynomial.C a * Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_chart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] (φ : σ → K) (M : K)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (j : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j (Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M g) =
    MvPolynomial.C (M ^ Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord j) *
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j g)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_eq_zero_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {g : MvPolynomial σ K} {N : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i g ≤ N) → ∀ {k : σ →₀ ℕ} {i : σ}, N < k i → Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g = 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {g : MvPolynomial σ K}
  {k : σ →₀ ℕ}, g.totalDegree < Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k → Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g = 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_hasse.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (j k : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f) =
    (∏ i, (k i + j i).choose (k i)) • Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (k + j) f

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_map.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4} [inst_2 : CommSemiring R]
  [inst_3 : CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (k : σ →₀ ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k ((MvPolynomial.map f) g) = (MvPolynomial.map f) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_single_clea.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} [CharP K p] (cl : K →+ K)
  (φ : σ → K) (M : K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (i : σ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1)
      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.clean p cl (Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M g)) =
    MvPolynomial.C M * Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1) g)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_single_remo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} [CharP K p] (cl : K →+ K)
  (h : MvPolynomial σ K) (i : σ),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed p cl h) = 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_sub.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommRing R] (k : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k (f - g) = Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f - Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_sub_hasse_s.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (k : σ →₀ ℕ) {i : σ}
  {a : ℕ},
  a ≤ k i →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (k - fun₀ | i => a) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => a) f) =
        (k i).choose a • Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_sub_single_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (k : σ →₀ ℕ) {i : σ},
  k i ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (k - fun₀ | i => 1) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1) f) =
        k i • Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f

Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse_zero.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.isFiniteType_corn.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.isFiniteType_sing.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.isFrobTail_corner.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} {σ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {p : ℕ}
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] [PerfectRing k p] (hθ : Irrational θ) (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w)
  (t : ℕ → σ → k),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarRun t →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFrobTail (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPointFT hθ t)
      (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l) p (1 + θ) fun m =>
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (m + 1))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.isPlanarTail_corn.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {σ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {w : ℕ → Bool} (hθ : Irrational θ)
  (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (t : ℕ → σ → k),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarRun t →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarTail (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPointFT hθ t)
      (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l) (1 + θ) fun m =>
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp.val θ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (m + 1))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.lambda_le_corner.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} {p : ℕ}
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] [PerfectRing k p] (hθ : Irrational θ) (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w)
  (t : ℕ → σ → k),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarRun t →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥(Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring) (n : σ →₀ ℕ),
      n ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse n f ≠ 0 →
          ∃ i a,
            p ^ a ≤ n i ∧
              Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ a) f ≠ 0 ∧
                (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                        (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).subtype
                          (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l)
                          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ a) f)) +
                      ↑(↑(p ^ a) * (1 + θ)) ≤
                    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                        (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).subtype
                          (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l)
                          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse n f)) +
                      ↑(↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord n) * (1 + θ)) ∧
                  ((n ≠ fun₀ | i => p ^ a) →
                    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                          (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).subtype
                            (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l)
                            (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ a) f)) +
                        ↑(↑(p ^ a) * (1 + θ)) <
                      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
                          (MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).subtype
                            (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l)
                            (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse n f)) +
                        ↑(↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord n) * (1 + θ)))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.lambda_le_of_frob.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)}
  {F : Subring K} {Φ : ℕ → σ → ↥F} {Φi : σ → K} {Θ : ℝ} {γ : ℕ → ℝ} {p : ℕ} [CharP K p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFrobTail v F Φ Φi p Θ γ →
      ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥F) (k : σ →₀ ℕ),
        k ≠ 0 →
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f ≠ 0 →
            ∃ i a,
              p ^ a ≤ k i ∧
                Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ a) f ≠ 0 ∧
                  v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ a) f)) +
                        ↑(↑(p ^ a) * Θ) ≤
                      v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f)) +
                        ↑(↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k) * Θ) ∧
                    ((k ≠ fun₀ | i => p ^ a) →
                      v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => p ^ a) f)) +
                          ↑(↑(p ^ a) * Θ) <
                        v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f)) +
                          ↑(↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k) * Θ))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.le_degreeOf_of_ha.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] {k : σ →₀ ℕ}

Singularity.PlanarRuns.le_hahnVal_corner.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c : ℕ → k)
  (m : ℕ),

    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)

        Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w) (fun j => HahnSeries.C (c j)) m)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.le_hahnVal_of_for.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.le_map_mul_prod_p.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.le_map_prod_pow.type:

  {γ : ℝ}, (∀ (i : σ), ↑γ ≤ v (Δ i)) → ∀ (k : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑(↑(∑ i, k i) * γ) ≤ v (∏ i, Δ i ^ k i)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.le_map_prod_pow_f.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)) {σ : Type u_2} (s : Finset σ) {Δ : σ → K} {γ : ℝ},
  (∀ (i : σ), ↑γ ≤ v (Δ i)) → ∀ (k : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑(↑(∑ i ∈ s, k i) * γ) ≤ v (∏ i ∈ s, Δ i ^ k i)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.le_of_mem_restart.type:

Singularity.PlanarRuns.map_cl_eval_resta.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)) (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
      M ≠ 0 →
        ∀ {r : ℝ},
          v M = ↑r →
            ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K),
              v (cl ((MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g))) + ↑(↑p * r) =
                v (cl ((MvPolynomial.eval (φ + Δ)) g))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.map_eq_of_lt_map_.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)) {x y : K}, v x < v (x - y) → v y = v x

Singularity.PlanarRuns.map_hasse_single_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} [CharP K p]
  (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)) (cl : K →+ K) (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
  M ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {r : ℝ},
      v M = ↑r →
        ∀ (Θ : ℝ) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (i : σ),
          v
                ((MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                  (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g))) +
              ↑(Θ - r + ↑p * r) =
            v ((MvPolynomial.eval (φ + Δ)) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse (fun₀ | i => 1) g)) + ↑Θ

Singularity.PlanarRuns.map_inv_pow.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)) {M : K} {r : ℝ},
  v M = ↑r → ∀ (p : ℕ), v (M ^ p)⁻¹ = ↑(-(↑p * r))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.map_zpow_one_sub.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)) {M : K},
  M ≠ 0 → ∀ {r : ℝ}, v M = ↑r → ∀ (p : ℕ), v (M ^ (1 - ↑p)) = ↑((1 - ↑p) * r)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.mem_box.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {N : ℕ} {k : σ →₀ ℕ},
  k ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.box σ N ↔ ∀ (i : σ), k i ≤ N

Singularity.PlanarRuns.mem_cone.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool} {m : ℕ} {r : Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ},
  r ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.cone w m ↔
    0 ≤ Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordY w m r ∧ 0 ≤ Singularity.PlanarRuns.coordZ w m r

Singularity.PlanarRuns.mem_finiteTypeSub.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (hθ : Irrational θ) {x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k},
  x ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ ↔ Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFiniteType x

Singularity.PlanarRuns.mem_hahnK0.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (p : ℕ) {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k},
  x ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnK0 p ↔ Singularity.PlanarRuns.InClass p 0 x

Singularity.PlanarRuns.mem_restartIndex.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ K} {i : σ} {e N : ℕ} {k : σ →₀ ℕ},
  k ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.restartIndex p g i e N ↔
    k ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.box σ N ∧
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k g ≠ 0 ∧ (¬∀ (l : σ), p ∣ k l) ∧ ¬p ∣ (k i).choose (p ^ e)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.not_dvd_choose_po.type: ∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (e : ℕ) {u : ℕ}, ¬p ∣ u → ¬p ∣ (p ^ e * u).choose (p ^ e)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.not_dvd_expU.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {p : ℕ},
  Nat.Prime p →
    ∀ (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ),
      ¬(↑p ∣ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m).fst ∧
          ↑p ∣ (Singularity.PlanarRuns.expY w m + Singularity.PlanarRuns.expZ w m).snd)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.ordAt.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  [Fintype σ] →
    {θ : ℝ} →
      {k : Type u_2} →
        [inst : Field k] → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k) → ℕ∞

Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord_eq_degree.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (k : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k = Finsupp.degree k

Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord_single.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (a : ℕ), (Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord fun₀ | i => a) = a

Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord_sub_single.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (k : σ →₀ ℕ) {i : σ},
  k i ≠ 0 → Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord (k - fun₀ | i => 1) + 1 = Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k

Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord_sub_single'.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (k : σ →₀ ℕ) {i : σ} {a : ℕ},

Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord_tsub_single.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (k : σ →₀ ℕ) {i : σ} {n : ℕ},
  n ≤ k i → Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord (k - fun₀ | i => n) + n = Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k

Singularity.PlanarRuns.powerForm.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {K : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq σ] → [inst : Field K] → ℕ → Subring K → Subring (MvPolynomial σ K)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.prod_C_mul_X_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Field K] (M : K) (k : σ →₀ ℕ),
  ∏ i, (MvPolynomial.C M * MvPolynomial.X i) ^ k i = (MvPolynomial.monomial k) (M ^ Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.prod_add_pow_eq_s.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Type u_3} [inst_2 : CommSemiring S] (a s : σ → S)
  (e : σ →₀ ℕ) {N : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : σ), e i ≤ N) →
    ∏ i, (a i + s i) ^ e i =
      ∑ k ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.box σ N, (↑(∏ i, (e i).choose (k i)) * ∏ i, a i ^ (e i - k i)) * ∏ i, s i ^ k i

Singularity.PlanarRuns.prod_pow_single.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {M : Type u_3} [inst_1 : CommMonoid M] (Δ : σ → M) (i : σ) (a : ℕ),
  ∏ l, Δ l ^ (fun₀ | i => a) l = Δ i ^ a

Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {K : Type u_2} → [Fintype σ] → [inst : Field K] → ℕ → (K →+ K) → MvPolynomial σ K → MvPolynomial σ K

Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed_mem_power.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ K), Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed p cl h ∈ Singularity.PlanarRuns.powerForm p K0

{σ : Type u_1} →
  {θ : ℝ} →
    {k : Type u_2} →
      [inst : Field k] →

          ℕ →

Singularity.PlanarRuns.restartSum.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {K : Type u_2} →
    [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → [inst : Field K] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ K → (σ → K) → (σ → K) → σ → ℕ → ℕ → K

Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K) (φ : σ → K) (M : K)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ K),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g =
    MvPolynomial.C (M ^ p)⁻¹ * Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M g -
      MvPolynomial.C (M ^ p)⁻¹ * Singularity.PlanarRuns.removed p cl (Singularity.PlanarRuns.chart φ M g)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart_restart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K} [CharP K p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
      ∀ (φ φ' : σ → K) (M M' : K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K),
        Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ' M' (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g) =
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl (fun i => φ i + M * φ' i) (M * M') g

Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart_sub_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (φ Δ : σ → K) {M : K},
      M ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ K) {j : σ →₀ ℕ},
          (∀ (i : σ), p ∣ j i) →
            M ^ (↑p - ↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord j)) *
                  (MvPolynomial.eval fun l => Δ l / M)
                    (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j (Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl φ M g)) -
                (MvPolynomial.eval (φ + Δ)) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse j g) ∈
              K0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.rhoAt.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →

Singularity.PlanarRuns.rhoAt_eq_zero_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p]
  {w : ℕ → Bool} {m : ℕ} {h : MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k)},
  ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.resid w m h).coeff 0).coeff 0 ≠ 0 →
    ¬p ∣ Singularity.PlanarRuns.divY w m h → Singularity.PlanarRuns.rhoAt w m h = 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p]
  {w : ℕ → Bool} {m : ℕ} {h : MvPolynomial σ (HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k)},
  ((Singularity.PlanarRuns.resid w m h).coeff 0).coeff 0 ≠ 0 →
    ¬p ∣ Singularity.PlanarRuns.divZ w m h → Singularity.PlanarRuns.rhoAt w m h = 0
