{σ : Type u_1} →
  {K : Type u_2} →
    [Fintype σ] → [inst : Field K] → ℕ → (K →+ K) → (ℕ → K) → (ℕ → σ → K) → MvPolynomial σ K → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ K

Singularity.PlanarRuns.runFn_succ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} [CharP K p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    ∀ {K0 : Subring K} {cl : K →+ K},
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
        ∀ (L : ℕ → K) (a : ℕ → σ → K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (m : ℕ),
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.runFn p cl L a g (m + 1) =
            Singularity.PlanarRuns.restart p cl (fun i => a m i * L m) (L m) (Singularity.PlanarRuns.runFn p cl L a g m)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.runFn_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Field K] (p : ℕ) (cl : K →+ K) (L : ℕ → K) (a : ℕ → σ → K)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ K), Singularity.PlanarRuns.runFn p cl L a g 0 = Singularity.PlanarRuns.clean p cl g

Singularity.PlanarRuns.smul_expM_injecti.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w →
    ∀ {q : ℕ}, 0 < q → Function.Injective fun j => q • Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1)

Singularity.PlanarRuns.statementD.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)}
  {F : Subring K} {Φ : ℕ → σ → ↥F} {Φi : σ → K} {Θ : ℝ} {γ : ℕ → ℝ},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarTail v F Φ Φi Θ γ →
    ∀ {p : ℕ},
      (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → n < p → v ↑n = 0) →
        ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥F),
          f ≠ 0 →
            (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f < p) →
              MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi f ≠ 0 ∧
                (∀ (k : σ →₀ ℕ),
                    k ≠ 0 →
                      Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f ≠ 0 →
                        v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi f) <
                          v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f)) +
                            ↑(↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k) * Θ)) ∧
                  ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                    v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi f) <
                      v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi f - ↑((MvPolynomial.eval (Φ m)) f))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.statementDHolds_c.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {σ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {w : ℕ → Bool} {p : ℕ}
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (hθ : Irrational θ) (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (t : ℕ → σ → k),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarRun t →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥(Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring),
      f ≠ 0 →
        (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f < p) →
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.StatementDHolds (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
            (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPointFT hθ t)
            (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l) (1 + θ) f

∀ {θ : ℝ} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {w : ℕ → Bool} {σ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {p : ℕ}
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] [PerfectRing k p] (hθ : Irrational θ) (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w)
  (t : ℕ → σ → k),
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarRun t →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥(Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring),
      f ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.PlanarRuns.StatementDHolds (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnVal θ k)
          (Singularity.PlanarRuns.finiteTypeSubfield k hθ).toSubring (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerPointFT hθ t)
          (fun l => Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw fun j => t j l) (1 + θ) f

Singularity.PlanarRuns.statementDHolds_o.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)}
  {F : Subring K} {Φ : ℕ → σ → ↥F} {Φi : σ → K} {Θ : ℝ} {p : ℕ} [CharP K p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    ∀ {γ : ℕ → ℝ},
      Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarTail v F Φ Φi Θ γ →
        ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥F),
          f ≠ 0 → (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f < p) → Singularity.PlanarRuns.StatementDHolds v F Φ Φi Θ f

Singularity.PlanarRuns.statementD_frob.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)}
  {F : Subring K} {Φ : ℕ → σ → ↥F} {Φi : σ → K} {Θ : ℝ} {γ : ℕ → ℝ} {p : ℕ} [CharP K p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsFrobTail v F Φ Φi p Θ γ →
      ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥F), f ≠ 0 → Singularity.PlanarRuns.StatementDHolds v F Φ Φi Θ f

Singularity.PlanarRuns.statementD_of_cha.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {v : AddValuation K (WithTop ℝ)}
  {F : Subring K} {Φ : ℕ → σ → ↥F} {Φi : σ → K} {Θ : ℝ} {γ : ℕ → ℝ} {p : ℕ} [CharP K p],
  Nat.Prime p →
    Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsPlanarTail v F Φ Φi Θ γ →
      ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ ↥F),
        f ≠ 0 →
          (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f < p) →
            MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi f ≠ 0 ∧
              (∀ (k : σ →₀ ℕ),
                  k ≠ 0 →
                    Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f ≠ 0 →
                      v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi f) <
                        v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hasse k f)) +
                          ↑(↑(Singularity.PlanarRuns.ord k) * Θ)) ∧
                ∀ᶠ (m : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                  v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi f) <
                    v (MvPolynomial.eval₂ F.subtype Φi f - ↑((MvPolynomial.eval (Φ m)) f))

Singularity.PlanarRuns.sub_hahnCl.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (p : ℕ) {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k),
  x - (Singularity.PlanarRuns.hahnCl p) x = (Singularity.PlanarRuns.classPart0 p) x

Singularity.PlanarRuns.sum_classPart.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (p : ℕ) {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : NeZero p]
  (x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k), ∑ c, Singularity.PlanarRuns.classPart p c x = x

Singularity.PlanarRuns.support_classPart.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (p : ℕ) {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (c : ZMod p × ZMod p)
  (x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k), (Singularity.PlanarRuns.classPart p c x).support ⊆ x.support

Singularity.PlanarRuns.support_cornerTai.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool} {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (hw : Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsCornerWord θ w) (c : ℕ → k)
  (m : ℕ),
  ∀
    r ∈
      (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerLimit hw c -
          Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerSum (Singularity.PlanarRuns.cornerL θ k w) (fun j => HahnSeries.C (c j))
            m).support,
    ∃ j, m ≤ j ∧ Singularity.PlanarRuns.expM w (j + 1) = r

Singularity.PlanarRuns.support_sub_class.type:
∀ {θ : ℝ} (p : ℕ) {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (x : HahnSeries (Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ) k),
  ∀ r ∈ (x - (Singularity.PlanarRuns.classPart0 p) x).support, (Singularity.PlanarRuns.classHom p) r ≠ 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.termOrd.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → {θ : ℝ} → (ℕ → Bool) → ℕ → (σ →₀ ℕ) → Singularity.PlanarRuns.CornerExp θ → ℕ

Singularity.PlanarRuns.termOrd_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {θ : ℝ} (w : ℕ → Bool) (m : ℕ), Singularity.PlanarRuns.termOrd w m 0 0 = 0

Singularity.PlanarRuns.totalDegree_resta.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Field K] {p : ℕ} {K0 : Subring K}
  {cl : K →+ K},
  Singularity.PlanarRuns.IsClassPart p K0 cl →
    ∀ (φ : σ → K) {M : K},
      M ≠ 0 →
        ∀ {g : MvPolynomial σ K},

∀ {θ : ℝ} {w : ℕ → Bool},

∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [CharP K p] [PerfectRing K p] {f : Polynomial K},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ {e m₀ m : ℕ},
      m = p ^ e * m₀ →
        ¬p ∣ m₀ →
          f.natDegree = m →
            (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 < j → j < p ^ e → f.coeff (m - j) = 0) →
              ∃ c, (f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)).coeff (m - p ^ e) = 0

Singularity.Portfolio.inseparable_layer_.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [CharP R p] {f : Polynomial R} {e m₀ m : ℕ},
  m = p ^ e * m₀ →
    ¬p ∣ m₀ →
      f.natDegree = m →
        ∀ (c : R) {i : ℕ},
          0 < i →
            i < p ^ e →
              (f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)).coeff (m - i) =
                f.coeff (m - i) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 i, ↑((m - j).choose (i - j)) * f.coeff (m - j) * c ^ (i - j)

∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [CharP R p] {f : Polynomial R} {e m₀ m : ℕ},

    ¬p ∣ m₀ →
      f.natDegree = m →
        ∀ (c : R) {i : ℕ},
          0 < i →
            i < p ^ e →
              (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 < j → j < i → f.coeff (m - j) = 0) →
                (f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)).coeff (m - i) = f.coeff (m - i)

∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [CharP R p] {f : Polynomial R} {e m₀ m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ e →
    m = p ^ e * m₀ →
      ¬p ∣ m₀ → f.natDegree = m → ∀ (c : R), (f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)).coeff (m - 1) = f.coeff (m - 1)

Singularity.Portfolio.lift_base_blowup.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {I : Ideal R},

    ∀ (g h : R) (e : ℕ),
      Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C g ∈ Ideal.span {Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h} ⊔ Ideal.map Polynomial.C I ∧
          Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C g ∈
              (Ideal.span {Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h} ⊔ Ideal.map Polynomial.C I) ^ p ^ e ∧
            Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C g ∉
              (Ideal.span {Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C h} ⊔ Ideal.map Polynomial.C I) ^ (p ^ e + 1) ↔
        g + h ^ p ^ e ∈ I ^ p ^ e

Singularity.Portfolio.lift_base_blowup_c.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {A : Type u_2} [inst_2 : CommRing A] (φ : R →+* A)
  {I : Ideal R} {x : A},
  Ideal.map φ I ≤ Ideal.span {x} →
    ∀ (g h : R) (e : ℕ),
      g + h ^ p ^ e ∈ I ^ p ^ e →
        ∃ g'',
          φ (g + h ^ p ^ e) = x ^ p ^ e * g'' ∧
            (Polynomial.map φ ((Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C g).comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C h))).comp
                (Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X) =
              Polynomial.C (x ^ p ^ e) * (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C g'')

Singularity.Portfolio.lucas_tschirnhause.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [CharP R p] {f : Polynomial R},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ {e m₀ m : ℕ},
      m = p ^ e * m₀ →
        ¬p ∣ m₀ →
          f.natDegree = m →
            ∀ (c : R),
              (f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)).coeff (m - p ^ e) =
                f.coeff (m - p ^ e) + ↑m₀ * c ^ p ^ e +
                  ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 (p ^ e), ↑((m - j).choose (p ^ e - j)) * f.coeff (m - j) * c ^ (p ^ e - j)

∀ {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [CharP R p] {f : Polynomial R},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ {e m₀ m : ℕ},
      m = p ^ e * m₀ →
        ¬p ∣ m₀ →
          f.natDegree = m →
            ∀ (c : R),
              (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 < j → j < p ^ e → f.coeff (m - j) = 0) →
                (f.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)).coeff (m - p ^ e) = f.coeff (m - p ^ e) + ↑m₀ * c ^ p ^ e

  {G : MvPolynomial σ R}, z ∉ G.vars → Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X z ^ p + G) = min (↑p) (Singularity.ord G)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p] (a : σ → R) {z : σ}

    i < m →
      ∀ {s t u : R}, u * t = 1 → u ^ (m - (i - 1)) * (s * t ^ 2) ^ (m - 1 - (i - 1)) = s ^ (m - i) * t ^ (m - 1 - i)

Singularity.aChain_glue_y.type:

  1 ≤ i → ∀ {s t u : R}, u * t = 1 → u ^ (i - 1) * (s * t ^ 2) ^ (i - 1 + 1) = s ^ i * t ^ (i + 1)

Singularity.abhyankar_inequality.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (A : ValuationSubring K) {k : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field k] [inst_2 : Algebra k K]
  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥A] [IsScalarTower k (↥A) K],
  Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive A.ValueGroupˣ)) + Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥A) ≤
    Algebra.trdeg k K

Singularity.abhyankar_inequality_relativ.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type uL} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} {Γ₁ : Type uΓ}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vK : Valuation K Γ₀)
  (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL],
  Cardinal.lift.{uL, uΓ}
        (Module.rank ℚ
          (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ
            (Additive
              ↥(Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup)
                  (↑vL).valueGroup)))) +
      Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL}
        (Algebra.trdeg (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vL.valuationSubring)) ≤
    Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL} (Algebra.trdeg K L)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {A B : ValuationSubring K} [IsDiscreteValuationRing ↥B] (hBA : B ≤ A),
  (∀ x ∈ B, B.valuation x < 1 → A.valuation x < 1) →
    A = B ∧
      Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive A.ValueGroupˣ)) = 1 ∧
        (Function.Surjective fun b => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥A) ⟨↑b, ⋯⟩) ∧ ringKrullDim ↥B = 1

Singularity.add_le_of_choose_mul_choose_.type:
∀ (r s d k₀ N₀ : ℕ),

      (∀ (M : ℕ), ↑((M + r).choose r * (M + s).choose s) ≤ ℓ (2 * k₀ * M + 1)) →
        (∀ (N : ℕ), N₀ ≤ N → ℓ N ≤ A * ↑N ^ d) → r + s ≤ d

Singularity.add_trdeg_eq_dim_iff.type:
∀ {k κ K L : Type u} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field κ] [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Field L] [inst_4 : Algebra k κ]
  [inst_5 : Algebra κ L] [inst_6 : Algebra k L] [IsScalarTower k κ L] [inst_8 : Algebra k K] (d r : ℕ),
  Algebra.trdeg k κ < Cardinal.aleph0 →
    Algebra.trdeg κ L < Cardinal.aleph0 →
      d + Cardinal.toNat (Algebra.trdeg k κ) = Cardinal.toNat (Algebra.trdeg k K) →
        (r + Cardinal.toNat (Algebra.trdeg κ L) = d ↔
          r + Cardinal.toNat (Algebra.trdeg k L) = Cardinal.toNat (Algebra.trdeg k K))

Singularity.add_wildSigma_add_mul.type:

Singularity.adjoin_eq_adjoin_of_eq_sum.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : Field E] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP E p] {E' : Type u_2} [inst_2 : Field E']

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
      (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
        AlgebraicIndependent K (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) fun j => ↑(y j))

∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {V : ValuationSubring K} [inst_4 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {x : ι → K}
  {y : κ → ↥V},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0) →
      (AlgebraicIndependent k fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y j)) →

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {k : Type u_3}

    ∀ {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} (x : ι → Kˣ),
      (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i => Additive.ofMul (π (x i))) →
        ∀ (y : κ → K),
          (∀ (P : MvPolynomial κ k), P ≠ 0 → ∃ c, π c = 1 ∧ v ((MvPolynomial.aeval y) P) = v ↑c) →
            AlgebraicIndependent k (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) y)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {k : Type u_3}

  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i => Additive.ofMul ((Units.map ↑v) (x i))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → K),

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]

Singularity.augmentedValuationFun_add_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      ∀ (f g : Polynomial K),
        Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ (f + g) ≤
          max (Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f) (Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ g)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      ∀ {f : Polynomial K} {c : Γ₀},
        Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f ≤ c ↔ ∀ (j : ℕ), μ (Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j) * γ ^ j ≤ c

Singularity.augmentedValuationFun_le_of_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ μ f) →
    φ.Monic →
      ν φ < μ φ →
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
          ψ.Monic →
            ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree →
              ν ψ < μ ψ →
                ν φ ≤ ν ψ →
                  ∀ (f : Polynomial K),
                    Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ (ν φ) f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ ψ (ν ψ) f

Singularity.augmentedValuationFun_lt_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]

  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ μ f) →
    φ.Monic →
      ν φ < μ φ →
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
          ∀ (f : Polynomial K), Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ (ν φ) f < μ f ↔ ν f < μ f

Singularity.augmentedValuationFun_mono.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]

    0 < φ.natDegree →

          ∀ (f : Polynomial K), Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ' f

                            2 * MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 2) =

Singularity.castHom_moduleEnd_apply.type:

Singularity.centerChart.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.centerChartExponent.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → σ → (σ →₀ ℕ) → σ →₀ ℕ

Singularity.centerChartExponent_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ) (d e : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.centerChartExponent S c (d + e) =
    Singularity.centerChartExponent S c d + Singularity.centerChartExponent S c e

Singularity.centerChartExponent_injectiv.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ), Function.Injective (Singularity.centerChartExponent S c)

Singularity.centerChartExponent_nsmul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ) (n : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.centerChartExponent S c (n • d) = n • Singularity.centerChartExponent S c d

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing R] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → σ → ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R) → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_co.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ) {m : ℕ}
  {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ m →
    Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c m.factorial
        (⨆ l, Singularity.derivIdeal^[↑l] I ^ (m.factorial / (m - ↑l))) =
      ⨆ l, Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c (m - ↑l) (Singularity.derivIdeal^[↑l] I) ^ (m.factorial / (m - ↑l))

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_iS.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] {ι : Type u_3} (S : Finset σ)
  (c : σ) (B : ι → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) (k : ι → ℕ) {N : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : ι), k i ∣ N) →
    (∀ (i : ι), B i ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ k i) →
      Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c N (⨆ i, B i ^ (N / k i)) =
        ⨆ i, Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c (k i) (B i) ^ (N / k i)

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ)
  {a a' : ℕ},
  a' ≤ a →
    ∀ {A : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
      A ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ a →
        Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a' A ≤ Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a A

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_mo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ) (a : ℕ)
  {A B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  A ≤ B → Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a A ≤ Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a B

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_mu.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ)
  {a b : ℕ} {A B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  A ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ a →
    B ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ b →
      Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c (a + b) (A * B) =
        Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a A * Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c b B

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ)
  {a a' : ℕ},
  a' ≤ a →
    ∀ {A : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
      A ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ a →
        Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a' A =
          Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X c ^ (a - a')} * Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a A

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_po.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ) {a : ℕ}
  {A : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  A ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ a →
    ∀ (e : ℕ),
      Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c (a * e) (A ^ e) = Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a A ^ e

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_si.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] (l : σ) {a m : ℕ},
  m ≤ a →
    ∀ (N : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
      Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal {l} l m (Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X l ^ a} * N) =
        Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X l ^ (a - m)} * N

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] {h : σ} {m : ℕ}
  {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)}, MvPolynomial.X h ^ m ∈ I → Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal {h} h m I = ⊤

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_sp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ),
  Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c 1 (Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X c}) = ⊤

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] {S : Finset σ} {c : σ},
  c ∈ S →
    ∀ {m : ℕ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
      m ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, d i →
        Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c m (Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial d) 1}) =
          Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.centerChartExponent S c d - fun₀ | c => m)) 1}

Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal_su.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ) {a : ℕ}
  {A B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  A ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ a →
    B ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ a →
      Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a (A ⊔ B) =
        Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a A ⊔ Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c a B

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] {S : Finset σ} (c : σ)
  {m s : ℕ} {N I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  N ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ s →
    I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ m →
      0 < m →
        0 < s →
          Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c (m * s) (N ^ m ⊔ I ^ s) =
            Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c s N ^ m ⊔ Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal S c m I ^ s

Singularity.centerChartUnit.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.centerChart_X_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (i : σ),
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) =
        (MvPolynomial.X j ^ if i ∈ S then 1 else 0) * (Singularity.centerRest S j t) (MvPolynomial.X i)

Singularity.centerChart_X_mul_pderiv_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (Δ : Finset σ)
  {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k) {m : σ},
      m ∈ S →
        (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) ∈
          Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) g)

Singularity.centerChart_X_mul_pderiv_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {m j : σ},
  m ∈ S →
    m ≠ j →
      ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
        (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) =
          (MvPolynomial.X m + MvPolynomial.C (t m)) * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {m j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    m ∉ S →
      ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
        (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) =
          MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) g)

Singularity.centerChart_X_of_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ} (t : σ → k),
  i ∈ S →
    i ≠ j →
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (t i))

Singularity.centerChart_X_of_notMem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ} (t : σ → k),
  i ∉ S → i ≠ j → (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X i

Singularity.centerChart_X_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (MvPolynomial.X j) = MvPolynomial.X j

Singularity.centerChart_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) =
        (MvPolynomial.X j ^ ∑ i ∈ S, a i) * (Singularity.centerRest S j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c)

Singularity.centerChart_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {S : Finset σ}
  {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (r : σ →₀ ℕ),
      (Singularity.centerChart S j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1) =
        (MvPolynomial.X j ^ ∑ i ∈ S, r i) * (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.centerExponent S j t r)) 1 *
          Singularity.centerChartUnit S j t r

Singularity.centerChart_univ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Fintype σ] (j : σ)
  (t : σ → k), Singularity.centerChart Finset.univ j t = Singularity.pointChart j t

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k]

Singularity.centerExponent.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {inst_2 : DecidableEq k}
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq k] (S S_1 : Finset σ),
