Singularity.centerRest_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (S : Finset σ)
  (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (r : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.centerRest S j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.centerExponent S j t r)) 1 * Singularity.centerChartUnit S j t r

Singularity.centerSubring.type: {K : Type u_2} → [inst : Field K] → ValuationSubring K → Subring K → Subring K

Singularity.centerSubring_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R S : Subring K},
  S ≤ Singularity.centerSubring V R → Singularity.centerSubring V S ≤ Singularity.centerSubring V R

Singularity.centerSubring_le_of_inv_mem.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {W : ValuationSubring K} {B N : Subring K},
  B ≤ N → (∀ x ∈ N, W.valuation x = 1 → x⁻¹ ∈ N) → Singularity.centerSubring W B ≤ N

Singularity.centerSubring_le_toSubring.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R : Subring K},
  R ≤ V.toSubring → Singularity.centerSubring V R ≤ V.toSubring

Singularity.centerSubring_map.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} {K' : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field K'] (e : K ≃+* K') (V' : ValuationSubring K')
  (R : Subring K),
  Singularity.centerSubring V' (Subring.map e.toRingHom R) =
    Subring.map e.toRingHom (Singularity.centerSubring (V'.comap e.toRingHom) R)

Singularity.centerSubring_mono.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R S : Subring K},
  R ≤ S → Singularity.centerSubring V R ≤ Singularity.centerSubring V S

Singularity.centerUnit.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → Finset σ → Finset σ → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.centerUnit_univ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k]
  [inst_3 : Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Singularity.centerUnit Δ Finset.univ j t = Singularity.blowupUnit Δ j t

Singularity.changeParam.type: {ι : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq ι] → [Mul R] → (ι → R) → ι → R → ι → R

Singularity.changeParam.congr_simp.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {inst : DecidableEq ι} [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Mul R] (x x_1 : ι → R),
  x = x_1 →
    ∀ (i i_1 : ι),
      i = i_1 →
        ∀ (v v_1 : R),
          v = v_1 → ∀ (a a_1 : ι), a = a_1 → Singularity.changeParam x i v a = Singularity.changeParam x_1 i_1 v_1 a_1

Singularity.changeParam_apply.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Monoid R] (x : ι → R) (i : ι) (v : R) (j : ι),
  Singularity.changeParam x i v j = (if j = i then v else 1) * x j

Singularity.charDelta.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing k] → [Fintype σ] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → ℝ

Singularity.charDelta_eq_polyDelta.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)},
  Singularity.IsMinimalCoord f →
    (Singularity.projPolyhedron f).Nonempty →
      Singularity.charDelta f = Singularity.polyDelta (fun x => 1) f ∧
        Singularity.charDelta f = sInf (Singularity.projWeights f fun x => 1)

Singularity.charDelta_taylor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k))
  {ψ : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff ψ = 0 → Singularity.charDelta ((Polynomial.taylor ψ) f) = Singularity.charDelta f

Singularity.charP_moduleEnd.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] {p : ℕ} [CharP R p],
  CharP (Module.End k R) p

Singularity.charPolyhedron.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → Set (σ → ℝ)

Singularity.charPolyhedron_X_pow_add_C_e.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [Nontrivial k] (e : ℕ) {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C ↑F) = (↑(p ^ e))⁻¹ • Singularity.newtonPolyhedron F

Singularity.charPolyhedron_X_pow_add_C_o.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [Nontrivial k] (e : ℕ)
  {F : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) F ≠ 0 → ¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ α i) →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F) =
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  {F : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) F ≠ 0 → (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) (φ ^ p + F) ≠ 0) →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C F) =
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C F)

Singularity.charPolyhedron_add_orthant.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.charPolyhedron f + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.charPolyhedron f

Singularity.charPolyhedron_eq_of_isMinim.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)},
  Singularity.IsMinimalCoord f → Singularity.charPolyhedron f = Singularity.projPolyhedron f

Singularity.charPolyhedron_example_3_1_7.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [CharP k 2] [Nontrivial k],
  Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.X 0 ^ 2 + MvPowerSeries.X 1 ^ 3)) =
    2⁻¹ • Singularity.newtonPolyhedron (MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3)

∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [CharP k 2] [Nontrivial k],
  Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.X 0 ^ 2 + MvPowerSeries.X 1 ^ 3)) =
    {2⁻¹ • Singularity.expToReal fun₀ | 1 => 3} + Singularity.orthant (Fin 2)

Singularity.charPolyhedron_imperfect.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {t : k},
  (∀ (c : k), c ^ p ≠ t) →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C (Singularity.imperfectF p t)) =
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C (Singularity.imperfectF p t))

Singularity.charPolyhedron_originTransfo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ} [ExpChar k p] {j : σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
      Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C ↑(Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g)) =
        (↑p)⁻¹ • Singularity.newtonPolyhedron (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ} [ExpChar k p] {j : σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
      Singularity.charPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C ↑(Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g)) =
        Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C ↑(Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g))

Singularity.charPolyhedron_subset_projPo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.charPolyhedron f ⊆ Singularity.projPolyhedron f

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) {φ : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff φ = 0 →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron f ⊆ Singularity.projPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor φ) f)

Singularity.charPolyhedron_taylor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) {ψ : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff ψ = 0 →
    Singularity.charPolyhedron ((Polynomial.taylor ψ) f) = Singularity.charPolyhedron f

Singularity.chartCenterIdeal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → Finset σ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.chartCenterIdeal_ne_span_sin.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ},
  i ∈ S → j ∈ S → i ≠ j → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ≠ Ideal.span {g}

Singularity.chartCenterIdeal_singleton.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (l : σ),
  Singularity.chartCenterIdeal {l} = Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X l}

Singularity.chartEval.type:
{k : Type u_1} →
  {K : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [inst_1 : Field K] → [Algebra k K] → K → K → Polynomial (Polynomial k) →+* K

Singularity.chartEval_C.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (u w : K) (P : Polynomial k),
  (Singularity.chartEval u w) (Polynomial.C P) = (Polynomial.aeval w) P

Singularity.chartEval_X.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (u w : K),
  (Singularity.chartEval u w) Polynomial.X = u

Singularity.chartExponent.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → σ → (σ → k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → σ →₀ ℕ

Singularity.chartExponent.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {inst_2 : DecidableEq k}
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq k] (j j_1 : σ),
  j = j_1 →
    ∀ (t t_1 : σ → k),
      t = t_1 → ∀ (r r_1 : σ →₀ ℕ), r = r_1 → Singularity.chartExponent j t r = Singularity.chartExponent j_1 t_1 r_1

Singularity.chartImage.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → σ → σ → MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.chartImage_eq_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c i : σ),
  Singularity.chartImage S c i = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.centerChartExponent S c fun₀ | i => 1)) 1

Singularity.chartLinear.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartLinear_eq_chartRest.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {m : ℕ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g.IsHomogeneous m →
    ((Singularity.chartRest j t) g).IsHomogeneous m → (Singularity.chartLinear j t) g = (Singularity.chartRest j t) g

Singularity.chartN_eq_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
    ∀ (c : ℕ) {i : σ}, i ∉ Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t → ((fun₀ | j => c) + Singularity.chartExponent j t r) i = 0

Singularity.chartPointIdeal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → (k : Type u_2) → [inst : Field k] → (σ → k) → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.chartPointIdeal_isPrime.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (t : σ → k), (Singularity.chartPointIdeal k t).IsPrime

Singularity.chartRest.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartRest_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (r : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t r)) 1 * Singularity.chartUnit j t r

Singularity.chartRest_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ),
  Singularity.chartRest j 0 = Singularity.dehomogenize j

Singularity.chartSeqFactor.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → List (Finset σ × σ) → MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.chartSeqFactor.eq_def.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (m : ℕ) (x : List (Finset σ × σ)),
  Singularity.chartSeqFactor m x =
    match x with
    | [] => 1
    | p :: l => (Singularity.chartSeqMap l) (MvPolynomial.X p.2 ^ m) * Singularity.chartSeqFactor m l

Singularity.chartSeqMap.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → [DecidableEq σ] → List (Finset σ × σ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.chartSeqMap.eq_def.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (x : List (Finset σ × σ)),
  Singularity.chartSeqMap x =
    match x with
    | [] => AlgHom.id R (MvPolynomial σ R)
    | p :: l => (Singularity.chartSeqMap l).comp (Singularity.chartSubst p.1 p.2)

Singularity.chartSeqTransform.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing R] →
      [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → List (Finset σ × σ) → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R) → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.chartSeqTransform.eq_def.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (m : ℕ) (x : List (Finset σ × σ))
  (x_1 : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.chartSeqTransform m x x_1 =
    match x, x_1 with
    | [], I => I
    | p :: l, I => Singularity.chartSeqTransform m l (Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal p.1 p.2 m I)

Singularity.chartShift.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartShift_comp_dehomogenize.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.chartShift j t).comp (Singularity.dehomogenize j) = Singularity.chartRest j t

Singularity.chartShift_injective.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.chartShift j t)

Singularity.chartShift_neg_comp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.chartShift j (-t)).comp (Singularity.chartShift j t) = AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.chartStrictTransform.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → (I : Ideal R) → Ideal R → (f : R) → Ideal ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)

Singularity.chartSubst.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → σ → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.chartSubst_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c i : σ),
  (Singularity.chartSubst S c) (MvPolynomial.X i) = Singularity.chartImage S c i

Singularity.chartSubst_X_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {R : Type u_3} [inst_1 : CommRing R] {S : Finset σ} {c h : σ},
  h ∈ S → h ≠ c → (Singularity.chartSubst S c) (MvPolynomial.X h) = MvPolynomial.X c * MvPolynomial.X h

Singularity.chartSubst_X_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {R : Type u_3} [inst_1 : CommRing R] (S : Finset σ) (h : σ),
  (Singularity.chartSubst S h) (MvPolynomial.X h) = MvPolynomial.X h

Singularity.chartSubst_eq_X_pow_mul_X_mu.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {c : σ} {n : ℕ}
  {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  (Singularity.chartSubst S c) f = MvPolynomial.X c ^ (n + 1) * g →
    (Singularity.chartSubst S c) f = MvPolynomial.X c ^ n * (MvPolynomial.X c * g)

Singularity.chartSubst_hyperplaneRestric.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {T : Finset σ} {c h : σ},
  c ≠ h →
    ∀ {a : ℕ} {φ g : MvPolynomial σ R},
      (Singularity.chartSubst T c) φ = MvPolynomial.X c ^ a * g →
        (Singularity.chartSubst (T.erase h) c) ((Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) φ) =
          MvPolynomial.X c ^ a * (Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) g

Singularity.chartSubst_injective.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ),
  Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.chartSubst S c)

Singularity.chartSubst_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ)
  (a : R),
  (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) a) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.centerChartExponent S c d)) a

Singularity.chartSubst_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) 1) =
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.centerChartExponent S c d)) 1

Singularity.chartSubst_pderiv_center.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] [IsDomain R] {S : Finset σ}
  {c : σ} {n : ℕ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  (Singularity.chartSubst S c) f = MvPolynomial.X c ^ (n + 1) * g →
    (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv c) f) =
      MvPolynomial.X c ^ n *
        (↑(n + 1) * g + MvPolynomial.X c * (MvPolynomial.pderiv c) g -
          ∑ l ∈ S.erase c, MvPolynomial.X l * (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) g)

Singularity.chartSubst_pderiv_of_mem_era.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] [IsDomain R] {S : Finset σ}
  {c i : σ},
  i ∈ S.erase c →
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
      (Singularity.chartSubst S c) f = MvPolynomial.X c ^ (n + 1) * g →
        (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f) = MvPolynomial.X c ^ n * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g

Singularity.chartSubst_pderiv_of_not_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] {S : Finset σ} {c i : σ},
  c ∈ S →
    i ∉ S →
      ∀ {n : ℕ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
        (Singularity.chartSubst S c) f = MvPolynomial.X c ^ (n + 1) * g →
          (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f) =
            MvPolynomial.X c ^ n * (MvPolynomial.X c * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g)

Singularity.chartSubst_singleton_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (l : σ),
  Singularity.chartSubst {l} l = AlgHom.id R (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.chartTransform.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k) → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal_derivIde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {m : ℕ}
  {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I →
    ∀ {l : ℕ},
      l ≤ m →
        Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t (m - l) (Singularity.derivIdeal^[l] I) ≤
          Singularity.derivIdeal^[l] (Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t m I)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
      ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I →
        Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t (m - 1) (Singularity.derivIdeal I) ≤
          Singularity.derivIdeal (Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t m I)

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal_iSup_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {ι : Type u_3} (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (B : ι → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) (c : ι → ℕ) {N : ℕ},
  (∀ (i : ι), c i ∣ N) →
    (∀ (i : ι), ↑(c i) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (B i)) →
      Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t N (⨆ i, B i ^ (N / c i)) =
        ⨆ i, Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t (c i) (B i) ^ (N / c i)

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal_le_of_ma.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {a a' : ℕ},
  a' ≤ a →
    ∀ {A : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
      ↑a ≤ Singularity.idealOrd A → Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a' A ≤ Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a A

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal_mono.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (a : ℕ)
  {A B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  A ≤ B → Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a A ≤ Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a B

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {a b : ℕ}
  {A B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  ↑a ≤ Singularity.idealOrd A →
    ↑b ≤ Singularity.idealOrd B →
      Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t (a + b) (A * B) =
        Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a A * Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t b B

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal_of_mark_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {a a' : ℕ},
  a' ≤ a →
    ∀ {A : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
      ↑a ≤ Singularity.idealOrd A →
        Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a' A =
          Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X j ^ (a - a')} * Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a A

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {a : ℕ}
  {A : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  ↑a ≤ Singularity.idealOrd A →
    ∀ (e : ℕ), Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t (a * e) (A ^ e) = Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a A ^ e

Singularity.chartTransformIdeal_sup.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {a : ℕ}
  {A B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  ↑a ≤ Singularity.idealOrd A →
    ↑a ≤ Singularity.idealOrd B →
      Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a (A ⊔ B) =
        Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a A ⊔ Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t a B

Singularity.chartUnit.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → [DecidableEq k] → σ → (σ → k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.chartUnit_mul_chartTransform.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                Singularity.idealOrd
                      (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree
                          (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                        d) →
                  ∀ {ψ f' : MvPolynomial σ k},
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑d →
                      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈
                          Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                        (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ) =
                            MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * f' →
                          f' ∈
                              Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                (Singularity.cleanPart p g') →
                            Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartTransform j t d ψ) = ↑d ∧
                              Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) *
                                  Singularity.chartTransform j t d ψ ∈
                                Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixSet (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                  (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixSet Δ g →
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m ∧
                      Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartTransform j t m ψ) = ↑m ∧
                        Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) *
                            Singularity.chartTransform j t m ψ ∈
                          Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrixSet (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                            (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

Singularity.chartUnlinear.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.chartUnlinear_comp_rename_co.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  ((Singularity.chartUnlinear j t).comp (MvPolynomial.rename some)).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) =
    MvPolynomial.rename some

Singularity.chartUnlinear_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} (t : σ → k) {w : σ → k},
  w j = 0 →
    ((Singularity.chartUnlinear j t).comp (Singularity.translate w)).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) =
      Singularity.translate w

Singularity.chartUnshift.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] →
      [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.chartUnshift_comp_chartLinea.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (b : MvPolynomial (Option σ) k),
  (Singularity.chartUnshift j t b).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) =
    MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => MvPolynomial.X (some i) + MvPolynomial.C (Singularity.chartVector j t i) * b

Singularity.chartUnshift_comp_chartRest.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (b : MvPolynomial (Option σ) k),
  (Singularity.chartUnshift j t b).comp (Singularity.chartRest j t) =
    (Singularity.chartUnshift j t 0).comp (Singularity.chartRest j t)

Singularity.chartVector.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → σ → k

Singularity.chartVector.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {inst_1 : DecidableEq σ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (j j_1 : σ),
  j = j_1 →
    ∀ (t t_1 : σ → k),
      t = t_1 → ∀ (a a_1 : σ), a = a_1 → Singularity.chartVector j t a = Singularity.chartVector j_1 t_1 a_1

Singularity.chartVector_mem_directrix_in.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                  ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) ≠ 0 →
                    Singularity.chartVector j t ∈
                      Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))

Singularity.chartVector_mem_directrix_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m →
                      Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
              Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                  ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + m + 1) →
                ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g →
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m →
                      Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈
                      Singularity.logJacobianCaseIdeal Δ g →
                    Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  ψ ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobianCaseIdeal Δ g →
                    Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ)

Singularity.chartVector_mem_directrix_pd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              ∀ {l : σ},
                l ∉ Δ →
                  (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ≠ 0 →
                    Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') =
                        ↑(d - 1) →
                      Singularity.chartVector j t ∈
                        Singularity.directrix
                          ((MvPolynomial.pderiv l)
                            ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)))

Singularity.chartVector_mem_logJacobianD.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') =
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g →
            Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix Δ g

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) p g' =
              Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g + 1 →
            Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix Δ g

Singularity.chartVector_ne_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Singularity.chartVector j t ≠ 0

Singularity.choose_cast_eq_zero.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {e a n : ℕ},
  p ^ e ∣ a → ¬p ^ e ∣ n → ↑(a.choose n) = 0

Singularity.choose_pow_mul_cast.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (v b n : ℕ),
  ↑((p ^ v * b).choose n) = if p ^ v ∣ n then ↑(b.choose (n / p ^ v)) else 0

Singularity.ciSup_add_ciSup_le_of_forall.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ] {f : ι → Cardinal.{u}} {g : κ → Cardinal.{u}},
  BddAbove (Set.range f) →
    BddAbove (Set.range g) → ∀ {c : Cardinal.{u}}, (∀ (i : ι) (j : κ), f i + g j ≤ c) → iSup f + iSup g ≤ c

Singularity.classicalChart.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → Set σ → σ → Option σ → MvPolynomial (Option σ) R

Singularity.classicalChartX.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → Set σ → σ → σ → MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.classicalF.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → ℕ → (ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) R

Singularity.classical_optionEquivLeft_re.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) p) = Polynomial.C p

Singularity.classical_ord_le_ord_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord p ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.rename some) p)

Singularity.cleanOrdAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.cleanOrdAlong.congr_simp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {inst_1 : DecidableEq σ} [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (p p_1 : ℕ),
  p = p_1 →
    ∀ (S S_1 : Finset σ),
      S = S_1 →
        ∀ (g g_1 : MvPolynomial σ k), g = g_1 → Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p S g = Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p_1 S_1 g_1

Singularity.cleanPart.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.cleanPart_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) = Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F

Singularity.cleanPart_eq_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {q : ℕ} {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean q F → Singularity.cleanPart q F = F

Singularity.cleanPart_ne_zero_of_adapted.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k} {g F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), ψ (φ h) = h) →
    g ≠ 0 →
      Singularity.IsClean p g →
        Singularity.logJacobian Δ F = Ideal.map φ (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g) → Singularity.cleanPart p F ≠ 0

Singularity.coarsening.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → (V : ValuationSubring K) → Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ → ValuationSubring K

Singularity.coarseningSubring.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → (V : ValuationSubring K) → Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ → Subring K

Singularity.coe_adjoinRangeElem.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3} (z : ι → K)
  (i : ι), ↑(Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k z i) = z i

Singularity.coe_aeval_valuationSubring.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] (z : ↥vL.valuationSubring)
  (p : Polynomial ↥vK.valuationSubring),
  ↑((Polynomial.aeval z) p) = (Polynomial.aeval ↑z) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap (↥vK.valuationSubring) K) p)

Singularity.coe_mem_map_iff_idealChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {I J : Ideal R} {f : R} (b : ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)),
  ↑b ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)) J ↔
    ∃ k,
      (algebraMap R ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)) f ^ k * b ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)) J

Singularity.coe_weightedHomogeneousCompo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ↑((MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) f) = (MvPowerSeries.weightedHomogeneousComponent w n) ↑f

Singularity.coeff_X_add_C_pow_pow_mul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] (c : R) (e m₀ n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c) ^ (p ^ e * m₀)).coeff n =
    if p ^ e ∣ n then (c ^ p ^ e) ^ (m₀ - n / p ^ e) * ↑(m₀.choose (n / p ^ e)) else 0

Singularity.coeff_X_add_C_pow_pow_mul_eq.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] (c : R) {e m₀ n : ℕ},
  ¬p ^ e ∣ n → ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c) ^ (p ^ e * m₀)).coeff n = 0

Singularity.coeff_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (i : σ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G).coeff a = ↑(a i) * G.coeff a

Singularity.coeff_X_pow_add_C_sub.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {n i : ℕ},
  1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ∀ (G : MvPowerSeries σ k), (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C G).coeff (n - i) = if i = n then G else 0

Singularity.coeff_X_pow_add_sum.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.X ^ m + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * Polynomial.X ^ i).coeff n =
    if n < m then a n else if n = m then 1 else 0

Singularity.coeff_X_pow_sub_C_eq_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {p : ℕ} (a : K) {i : ℕ},
  0 < i → i < p → (Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C a).coeff i = 0

Singularity.coeff_add_apply.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f g : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (f + g).coeff d = f.coeff d + g.coeff d

Singularity.coeff_chartSubst.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  ((Singularity.chartSubst S c) f).coeff (Singularity.centerChartExponent S c d) = f.coeff d

Singularity.coeff_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.cleanPart q F).coeff d = if ∀ (i : σ), q ∣ d i then 0 else F.coeff d

Singularity.coeff_divisorExponent.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  g.coeff (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) = MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_ord.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  ↑(Finsupp.degree d) < Singularity.ord f → f.coeff d = 0

Singularity.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_weighted.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < Singularity.weightedOrd w f → f.coeff d = 0

Singularity.coeff_hyperplaneRestrict.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] {h : σ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  d h = 0 → ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ k), ((Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) f).coeff d = f.coeff d

Singularity.coeff_imperfectF.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (t : k) (α : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) (Singularity.imperfectF p t) =
    (if α = fun₀ | 0 => p then t else 0) + if α = fun₀ | 1 => p + 1 then 1 else 0

Singularity.coeff_initialForm.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.initialForm w f).coeff d =
    if (Finsupp.weight w) d = (Singularity.weightedOrd w f).toNat then f.coeff d else 0

Singularity.coeff_initialFormAt_of_gt.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (w : σ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
  (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) {d : ℕ}, f.natDegree < d → (Singularity.initialFormAt w δ f).coeff d = 0

Singularity.coeff_initialFormAt_of_lt.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (w : σ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
  (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) {d : ℕ},
  d < f.natDegree →
    (Singularity.initialFormAt w δ f).coeff d = Singularity.weightPart w (↑(f.natDegree - d) * δ) (f.coeff d)

Singularity.coeff_initialFormAt_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (w : σ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
  (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)), (Singularity.initialFormAt w δ f).coeff f.natDegree = 1

Singularity.coeff_iterate_divX.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (f : Polynomial K) (j n : ℕ), (Polynomial.divX^[j] f).coeff n = f.coeff (n + j)

Singularity.coeff_killOutside.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∈ a.support, i ∈ S) → ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ k), ((Singularity.killOutside S) f).coeff a = f.coeff a

Singularity.coeff_killVar_eq_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {i : σ} {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  a i ≠ 0 → ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k), ((Singularity.killVar i) F).coeff a = 0

Singularity.coeff_monomial_add_monomial_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] {a b : σ →₀ ℕ},
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ),
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) ((MvPowerSeries.monomial a) 1 + (MvPowerSeries.monomial b) 1) ≠ 0 ↔ α = a ∨ α = b

Singularity.coeff_pow_eq_zero_of_not_dvd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial σ k)
  {d : σ →₀ ℕ}, (¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ d i) → (h ^ p ^ e).coeff d = 0

Singularity.coeff_pow_expChar_pow_eq_zer.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ d i) → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) (φ ^ p ^ e) = 0

Singularity.coeff_pred_X_add_C.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (a : ℕ → A) (d : A),
      ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ m +
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ i).coeff
          (m - 1) =
        a (m - 1) + ↑m * d

Singularity.coeff_pred_taylor_of_monic.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] {f : Polynomial A},
  f.Monic →
    1 ≤ f.natDegree →
      ∀ (d : A), ((Polynomial.taylor d) f).coeff (f.natDegree - 1) = f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1) + ↑f.natDegree * d

Singularity.coeff_pred_taylor_tschirnhau.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] {f : Polynomial A},
  f.Monic →
    1 ≤ f.natDegree →
      ∀ {u : A},
        ↑f.natDegree * u = 1 → ((Polynomial.taylor (-(f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1) * u))) f).coeff (f.natDegree - 1) = 0

Singularity.coeff_shiftT_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] [Fintype σ] {I : ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)}
  {B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)},
  (∀ (a : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ K) (i : σ), f ∈ I a → (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f ∈ I (a + 1)) →
    ∀ {b : σ → MvPolynomial σ K},
      (∀ (i : σ), b i ∈ B) → ∀ (k c : ℕ), ∀ f ∈ I c, ((Singularity.shiftT b) f).coeff k ∈ B ^ k * I (c + k)

Singularity.coeff_smul_add_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G).coeff a = ↑(r i + a i) * G.coeff a

Singularity.coeff_smul_pow_char.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k) (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff (p • α)) (φ ^ p) = (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) φ ^ p

Singularity.coeff_sum_smul_add_X_mul_pde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (∑ i, (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G)).coeff a =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree r + Finsupp.degree a) * G.coeff a

Singularity.coeff_taylor_X_pow_add_sum.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) (d : A),
  (Polynomial.taylor d) (Polynomial.X ^ m + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * Polynomial.X ^ i) =
    (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ m + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ i

Singularity.coeff_taylor_eq_sum.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring A] (f : Polynomial A) (h : A) (d : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor h) f).coeff d = ∑ e ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1), ↑(e.choose d) * f.coeff e * h ^ (e - d)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k)
  (d : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial β) c)) f).coeff d =
    ∑ e ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1),
      ↑(e.choose d) * f.coeff e * (MvPowerSeries.monomial ((e - d) • β)) (c ^ (e - d))

Singularity.coeff_taylor_natDegree_sub.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : Polynomial R) (c : R) {i : ℕ},
  i ≤ f.natDegree →
    ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (f.natDegree - i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), ↑((f.natDegree - j).choose (i - j)) * f.coeff (f.natDegree - j) * c ^ (i - j)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_natDegree_sub_e.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : Polynomial R) (c : R) {i : ℕ},
  0 < i →
    i ≤ f.natDegree →
      ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (f.natDegree - i) =
        f.coeff (f.natDegree - i) + ↑(f.natDegree.choose i) * f.coeff f.natDegree * c ^ i +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 i, ↑((f.natDegree - j).choose (i - j)) * f.coeff (f.natDegree - j) * c ^ (i - j)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_natDegree_sub_o.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {f : Polynomial R},
  p ∣ f.natDegree → ∀ (c : R), ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (f.natDegree - 1) = f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_sub_of_lt_pow.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {f : Polynomial R} {e m₀ m : ℕ},
  m = p ^ e * m₀ →
    f.natDegree = m →
      ∀ (c : R) {i : ℕ},
        0 < i →
          i < p ^ e →
            ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (m - i) =
              f.coeff (m - i) + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 i, ↑((m - j).choose (i - j)) * f.coeff (m - j) * c ^ (i - j)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_sub_of_lt_pow_o.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {f : Polynomial R} {e m₀ m : ℕ},
  m = p ^ e * m₀ →
    f.natDegree = m →
      ∀ (c : R) {i : ℕ},
        0 < i →
          i < p ^ e →
            (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 < j → j < i → f.coeff (m - j) = 0) → ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (m - i) = f.coeff (m - i)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_sub_pow.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {f : Polynomial R},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ {e m₀ m : ℕ},
      m = p ^ e * m₀ →
        f.natDegree = m →
          ∀ (c : R),
            ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (m - p ^ e) =
              f.coeff (m - p ^ e) + ↑m₀ * c ^ p ^ e +
                ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ioo 0 (p ^ e), ↑((m - j).choose (p ^ e - j)) * f.coeff (m - j) * c ^ (p ^ e - j)

Singularity.coeff_taylor_sub_pow_of_eq_z.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar R p] {f : Polynomial R},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ {e m₀ m : ℕ},
      m = p ^ e * m₀ →
        f.natDegree = m →
          ∀ (c : R),
            (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 < j → j < p ^ e → f.coeff (m - j) = 0) →
              ((Polynomial.taylor c) f).coeff (m - p ^ e) = f.coeff (m - p ^ e) + ↑m₀ * c ^ p ^ e

Singularity.coeff_top_X_add_C.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → A) (d : A),
  ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ m +
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, Polynomial.C (a i) * (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C d) ^ i).coeff
      m =
    1

Singularity.coeff_vertexPoly.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (v : σ →₀ ℕ) (d : ℕ),
  (Singularity.vertexPoly f v).coeff d =
    if d ≤ f.natDegree then (MvPowerSeries.coeff ((f.natDegree - d) • v)) (f.coeff d) else 0

Singularity.coeff_weightInitialForm_of_i.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {w : σ → ℝ}
  {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)},
  f.Monic →
    ∀ {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
      Singularity.IsUniqueMinimizer w (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) (Singularity.expToReal v) →
        ∀ (d : ℕ),
          (Singularity.weightInitialForm w f).coeff d =
            (MvPowerSeries.monomial ((f.natDegree - d) • v)) ((Singularity.vertexPoly f v).coeff d)

Singularity.coeff_weightPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (w : σ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (g : MvPowerSeries σ k)
  (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff a) (Singularity.weightPart w c g) =
    if Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a) = c then (MvPowerSeries.coeff a) g else 0

Singularity.coeff_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) (e : Option σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.zMonic m a).coeff e =
    if e none < m then (a (e none)).coeff e.some else if e none = m then (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff 1) e.some else 0

Singularity.coeff_zero_shiftT.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (b : σ → MvPolynomial σ R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ((Singularity.shiftT b) f).coeff 0 = f

Singularity.coefficientIdeal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R) → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.cohomOneRes.type: (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) → {W W' : Y.Opens} → W' ≤ W → (Singularity.cohomOne Y W ⟶ Singularity.cohomOne Y W')

Singularity.colon_span_singleton_mul_eq.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [IsDomain A] {x : A},
  x ≠ 0 → ∀ (J : Ideal A), Submodule.colon (Ideal.span {x} * J) {x} = J

Singularity.comap_map_invariantSubring.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B],
  IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G) →
    ∀ (I : Ideal ↥(Singularity.invariantSubring G B)),
      Ideal.comap (Singularity.invariantSubring G B).subtype (Ideal.map (Singularity.invariantSubring G B).subtype I) =
        I

Singularity.comap_pointwise_smul.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (σ : Gal(L/K))
  (W : ValuationSubring L), (σ • W).comap (algebraMap K L) = W.comap (algebraMap K L)

Singularity.comap_purelyInseparableExten.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [inst_3 : ExpChar K p] [inst_4 : IsPurelyInseparable K L] (V : ValuationSubring K),
  (Singularity.purelyInseparableExtension p V).comap (algebraMap K L) = V

Singularity.comap_valuationSubring_eq_of.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {K₀ : IntermediateField k K}
  {Γ₀ : Type u_3} {Γ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] (v₀ : Valuation (↥K₀) Γ₀) (v : Valuation K Γ) [v₀.HasExtension v],
  v.valuationSubring.comap (algebraMap (↥K₀) K) = v₀.valuationSubring

Singularity.comap_valuation_eq_one_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {L : Type u_5} [inst_1 : Field L] (f : L →+* K) (c : L),
  (V.comap f).valuation c = 1 ↔ V.valuation (f c) = 1

Singularity.commonWeightSpace.type:
{k : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} →
    {ι : Type u_3} →
      [inst : CommRing k] →
        [inst_1 : CommRing R] → [inst_2 : Algebra k R] → {p : ℕ} → (ι → Derivation k R R) → (ι → ZMod p) → Submodule k R

Singularity.completeFamily.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] →
    {Γ₀ : Type uV} →
      [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] →
        {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} →
          {φ : Polynomial K} →
            (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f) →
              φ.Monic →
                ν φ < w φ →
                  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = w f) →
                    Singularity.ContinuousFamily w (↑(Singularity.completeValues ν φ))ᵒᵈ

Singularity.completeFamily_isStable.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {hle : ∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f} {hm : φ.Monic}
  {hlt : ν φ < w φ} {hlow : ∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = w f} {ψ : Polynomial K},
  ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → (Singularity.completeFamily hle hm hlt hlow).IsStable ψ

Singularity.completeFamily_le.type:

Singularity.cpOmega_cleanPart_le_center.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p]
  {Δ S : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    j ∈ S →
      g ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ p →
        (Singularity.centerChart S j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {ρ : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑ρ →
              (∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g,
                  ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ ρ,
                    f = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * q) →
                ((∀ f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g,
                      ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ (ρ + 1),
                        f = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * q) ∨
                    ∃ q,
                      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * q ∈
                          Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g ∧
                        Singularity.ord q = ↑ρ) →
                  Singularity.cpOmega (Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                    Singularity.cpOmega Δ g
