Singularity.crossRatio_comp_perm_mem.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (p : Fin 4 → Fin 2 → K),
  (∀ (i j : Fin 4), i ≠ j → Singularity.p1Bracket (p i) (p j) ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)),
      Singularity.crossRatio (p (σ 0)) (p (σ 1)) (p (σ 2)) (p (σ 3)) ∈
        Singularity.crossRatioOrbit (Singularity.crossRatio (p 0) (p 1) (p 2) (p 3))

Singularity.crossRatio_comp_swap.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (q : Fin 4 → Fin 2 → K),
  (∀ (i j : Fin 4), i ≠ j → Singularity.p1Bracket (q i) (q j) ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (x y : Fin 4),
      x ≠ y →
        Singularity.crossRatio (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 0)) (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 1)) (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 2))
              (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 3)) =
            1 - Singularity.crossRatio (q 0) (q 1) (q 2) (q 3) ∨
          Singularity.crossRatio (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 0)) (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 1)) (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 2))
                (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 3)) =
              (Singularity.crossRatio (q 0) (q 1) (q 2) (q 3))⁻¹ ∨
            Singularity.crossRatio (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 0)) (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 1)) (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 2))
                (q ((Equiv.swap x y) 3)) =
              1 - (1 - Singularity.crossRatio (q 0) (q 1) (q 2) (q 3))⁻¹

Singularity.crossRatio_den_ne_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {a b c d : Fin 2 → K},
  Singularity.p1Bracket a b ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.p1Bracket c d ≠ 0 → Singularity.p1Bracket b a * Singularity.p1Bracket d c ≠ 0

Singularity.crossRatio_klein_one.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (a b c d : Fin 2 → K), Singularity.crossRatio b a d c = Singularity.crossRatio a b c d

Singularity.crossRatio_klein_three.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (a b c d : Fin 2 → K), Singularity.crossRatio d c b a = Singularity.crossRatio a b c d

Singularity.crossRatio_klein_two.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (a b c d : Fin 2 → K), Singularity.crossRatio c d a b = Singularity.crossRatio a b c d

Singularity.crossRatio_mulVec.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K),
  M.det ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (a b c d : Fin 2 → K),
      Singularity.crossRatio (M.mulVec a) (M.mulVec b) (M.mulVec c) (M.mulVec d) = Singularity.crossRatio a b c d

Singularity.crossRatio_ne_one.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {a b c d : Fin 2 → K},
  Singularity.p1Bracket a b ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.p1Bracket a c ≠ 0 →
      Singularity.p1Bracket b d ≠ 0 → Singularity.p1Bracket c d ≠ 0 → Singularity.crossRatio a b c d ≠ 1

Singularity.crossRatio_ne_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {a b c d : Fin 2 → K},
  Singularity.p1Bracket a b ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.p1Bracket a d ≠ 0 →
      Singularity.p1Bracket b c ≠ 0 → Singularity.p1Bracket c d ≠ 0 → Singularity.crossRatio a b c d ≠ 0

Singularity.crossRatio_smul.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (a b c d : Fin 2 → K) {r s t u : K},
  r ≠ 0 →
    s ≠ 0 → t ≠ 0 → u ≠ 0 → Singularity.crossRatio (r • a) (s • b) (t • c) (u • d) = Singularity.crossRatio a b c d

Singularity.crossRatio_std.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (l : K), Singularity.crossRatio ![0, 1] ![1, 1] ![1, 0] ![l, 1] = l

Singularity.crossRatio_swap_zero_one.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {a b c d : Fin 2 → K},
  Singularity.p1Bracket a b ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.p1Bracket c d ≠ 0 → Singularity.crossRatio b a c d = 1 - Singularity.crossRatio a b c d

Singularity.crossRatio_swap_zero_three.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {a b c d : Fin 2 → K},
  Singularity.p1Bracket a b ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.p1Bracket a c ≠ 0 →
      Singularity.p1Bracket b d ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.p1Bracket c d ≠ 0 → Singularity.crossRatio d b c a = 1 - (1 - Singularity.crossRatio a b c d)⁻¹

Singularity.crossRatio_swap_zero_two.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (a b c d : Fin 2 → K),
  Singularity.crossRatio c b a d = (Singularity.crossRatio a b c d)⁻¹

Singularity.cubicCone_exceptional_ideal.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ z₁ : R), Ideal.span {x, x * y₁, x * z₁} = Ideal.span {x}

Singularity.cubicCone_fermat_charThree.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R], 3 = 0 → ∀ (x y z : R), x ^ 3 + y ^ 3 + z ^ 3 = (x + y + z) ^ 3

Singularity.cubicCone_fermat_chart_regul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {u : R},
  3 * u = 1 → ∀ (a b : R), Ideal.span {1 + a ^ 3 + b ^ 3, 3 * a ^ 2, 3 * b ^ 2} = ⊤

Singularity.cubicCone_fermat_finrank.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k], Module.finrank k (AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ 3 + 1)) = 3

Singularity.cubicCone_fermat_partials_eq.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R],
  3 ≠ 0 → ∀ {x y z : R}, 3 * x ^ 2 = 0 → 3 * y ^ 2 = 0 → 3 * z ^ 2 = 0 → x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ z = 0

Singularity.cubicCone_fermat_xChart.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ z₁ : R), x ^ 3 + (x * y₁) ^ 3 + (x * z₁) ^ 3 = x ^ 3 * (1 + y₁ ^ 3 + z₁ ^ 3)

Singularity.cubicCone_fermat_yChart.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y x₁ z₁ : R), (y * x₁) ^ 3 + y ^ 3 + (y * z₁) ^ 3 = y ^ 3 * (x₁ ^ 3 + 1 + z₁ ^ 3)

Singularity.cubicCone_fermat_zChart.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (z x₁ y₁ : R), (z * x₁) ^ 3 + (z * y₁) ^ 3 + z ^ 3 = z ^ 3 * (x₁ ^ 3 + y₁ ^ 3 + 1)

Singularity.cubicCone_fermat_zero_of_eq.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {y : R}, y ^ 3 + 0 ^ 3 = 0 → y = 0

Singularity.cubicCone_span_three_eq_top.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {a b c r s t : R}, r * a + s * b + t * c = 1 → Ideal.span {a, b, c} = ⊤

Singularity.cubicCone_three_euler.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y z : R),
  x * (-3 * x ^ 2 - z ^ 2) + y * (2 * y * z) + z * (y ^ 2 - 2 * x * z) = 3 * (y ^ 2 * z - x ^ 3 - x * z ^ 2)

Singularity.cubicCone_three_finrank_y.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k], Module.finrank k (AdjoinRoot Polynomial.X) = 1

Singularity.cubicCone_three_finrank_z.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k], Module.finrank k (AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ 2)) = 2

Singularity.cubicCone_three_partials_eq_.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R],
  3 = 0 →
    ∀ {x y z : R},
      y ^ 2 * z - x ^ 3 - x * z ^ 2 = 0 → -3 * x ^ 2 - z ^ 2 = 0 → y ^ 2 - 2 * x * z = 0 → x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ z = 0

Singularity.cubicCone_three_xChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ z₁ : R),
  (x * y₁) ^ 2 * (x * z₁) - x ^ 3 - x * (x * z₁) ^ 2 = x ^ 3 * (y₁ ^ 2 * z₁ - 1 - z₁ ^ 2)

Singularity.cubicCone_three_xChart_regul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R],
  3 = 0 → ∀ (y z : R), Ideal.span {y ^ 2 * z - 1 - z ^ 2, 2 * y * z, y ^ 2 - 2 * z} = ⊤

Singularity.cubicCone_three_yChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y x₁ z₁ : R),
  y ^ 2 * (y * z₁) - (y * x₁) ^ 3 - y * x₁ * (y * z₁) ^ 2 = y ^ 3 * (z₁ - x₁ ^ 3 - x₁ * z₁ ^ 2)

Singularity.cubicCone_three_yChart_regul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R],
  3 = 0 → ∀ (x z : R), Ideal.span {z - x ^ 3 - x * z ^ 2, -3 * x ^ 2 - z ^ 2, 1 - 2 * x * z} = ⊤

Singularity.cubicCone_three_zChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (z x₁ y₁ : R),
  (z * y₁) ^ 2 * z - (z * x₁) ^ 3 - z * x₁ * z ^ 2 = z ^ 3 * (y₁ ^ 2 - x₁ ^ 3 - x₁)

Singularity.cubicCone_three_zChart_regul.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R], 3 = 0 → ∀ (x y : R), Ideal.span {y ^ 2 - x ^ 3 - x, -3 * x ^ 2 - 1, 2 * y} = ⊤

Singularity.curveNodeOrigin.type: (k : Type u_1) → [inst : Field k] → Ideal (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))

Singularity.curveNodePoly.type: (k : Type u_1) → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)

Singularity.curveNodePoly_mem_origin_sq.type: ∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field k] {n : ℕ}, 2 ≤ n → Singularity.curveNodePoly k n ∈ Singularity.curveNodeOrigin k ^ 2

Singularity.curveNode_chart_t.type: ∀ {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] (n : ℕ) (t u' v' : A), t * u' * (t * v') - t ^ (n + 2) = t ^ 2 * (u' * v' - t ^ n)

Singularity.curveNode_chart_u.type: ∀ {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] (n : ℕ) (u t' : A), u * (u ^ (n + 1) * t' ^ (n + 2)) - (u * t') ^ (n + 2) = 0

Singularity.curveNode_t_mem_of_u_mem.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field k] {n : ℕ} (𝔭 : Ideal (AdjoinRoot (Singularity.curveNodePoly k n))) [𝔭.IsPrime],
  (AdjoinRoot.of (Singularity.curveNodePoly k n)) (MvPolynomial.X 0) ∈ 𝔭 →
    (AdjoinRoot.of (Singularity.curveNodePoly k n)) (MvPolynomial.X 1) ∈ 𝔭

Singularity.curveNode_t_mem_of_v_mem.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field k] {n : ℕ} (𝔭 : Ideal (AdjoinRoot (Singularity.curveNodePoly k n))) [𝔭.IsPrime],
  AdjoinRoot.root (Singularity.curveNodePoly k n) ∈ 𝔭 →
    (AdjoinRoot.of (Singularity.curveNodePoly k n)) (MvPolynomial.X 1) ∈ 𝔭

Singularity.cuspPair.type: {R : Type u_1} → [CommRing R] → R → R → R

Singularity.cuspPair_chart_one.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ : R),
  ((x * y₁) ^ 2 - x ^ 3) * ((x * y₁) ^ 2 - x ^ 5) = x ^ 4 * (y₁ ^ 2 - x) * (y₁ ^ 2 - x ^ 3)

Singularity.cuspPair_chart_three.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y₂ x₃ : R), y₂ ^ 2 - y₂ * x₃ = y₂ * (y₂ - x₃)

Singularity.cuspPair_chart_two_x.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y₁ x₂ : R),
  (y₁ ^ 2 - y₁ * x₂) * (y₁ ^ 2 - (y₁ * x₂) ^ 3) = y₁ ^ 3 * (y₁ - x₂) * (1 - y₁ * x₂ ^ 3)

Singularity.cuspPair_chart_two_y.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₂ : R),
  ((x * y₂) ^ 2 - x) * ((x * y₂) ^ 2 - x ^ 3) = x ^ 3 * (x * y₂ ^ 2 - 1) * (y₂ ^ 2 - x)

Singularity.cuspPair_inter.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {x y : R},
  y ^ 2 = x ^ 3 → y ^ 2 = x ^ 5 → 1 - x ^ 2 ≠ 0 → x = 0 ∧ y = 0

Singularity.cuspPair_order_five.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x₃ w : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair (x₃ ^ 2 * w) (x₃ ^ 5 * w ^ 3) = x₃ ^ 16 * w ^ 8 * ((w ^ 3 * x₃ ^ 4 - 1) * (w - 1))

Singularity.cuspPair_order_four.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x₂ w : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair (x₂ ^ 2 * w) (x₂ ^ 3 * w ^ 2) = x₂ ^ 12 * w ^ 7 * ((w - 1) * (1 - w * x₂ ^ 4))

Singularity.cuspPair_order_one.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair x (x * y₁) = x ^ 4 * ((y₁ ^ 2 - x) * (y₁ ^ 2 - x ^ 3))

Singularity.cuspPair_order_three.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y₂ x₃ : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair (y₂ * x₃) (y₂ ^ 3 * x₃ ^ 2) = y₂ ^ 8 * x₃ ^ 7 * ((y₂ ^ 3 * x₃ - 1) * (y₂ - x₃))

Singularity.cuspPair_order_two.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y₁ x₂ : R),
  Singularity.cuspPair (y₁ * x₂) (y₁ ^ 2 * x₂) = y₁ ^ 7 * x₂ ^ 4 * ((y₁ - x₂) * (1 - y₁ * x₂ ^ 3))

Singularity.dFour_order_z.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {x y₁ z₁ : R}, z₁ ^ 2 + x * y₁ * (1 + y₁) = 0 → x * z₁ * (y₁ * (1 + y₁)) = -z₁ ^ 3

Singularity.dFour_singular_origin.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {x y z : R},
  z ^ 2 + x * y * (x + y) = 0 → y * (2 * x + y) = 0 → x * (x + 2 * y) = 0 → 2 * z = 0 → x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ z = 0

Singularity.dFour_xChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ z₁ : R),
  (x * z₁) ^ 2 + x * (x * y₁) * (x + x * y₁) = x ^ 2 * (z₁ ^ 2 + x * y₁ * (1 + y₁))

Singularity.dFour_xChart_singular_iff.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {x y₁ z₁ : R},
  z₁ ^ 2 + x * y₁ * (1 + y₁) = 0 ∧ y₁ * (1 + y₁) = 0 ∧ x * (1 + 2 * y₁) = 0 ∧ 2 * z₁ = 0 ↔
    x = 0 ∧ z₁ = 0 ∧ (y₁ = 0 ∨ y₁ = -1)

Singularity.dFour_yChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y x₁ z₁ : R),
  (y * z₁) ^ 2 + y * x₁ * y * (y * x₁ + y) = y ^ 2 * (z₁ ^ 2 + y * x₁ * (1 + x₁))

Singularity.dFour_zChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (z x₁ y₁ : R),
  z ^ 2 + z * x₁ * (z * y₁) * (z * x₁ + z * y₁) = z ^ 2 * (1 + z * x₁ * y₁ * (x₁ + y₁))

Singularity.deJongAlteration_iff.type:
Singularity.deJongAlteration ↔
  ∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field k] (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k)
    [Singularity.IsVariety X f] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral X] (Z : Set ↥X),
    IsClosed Z → Z ≠ Set.univ → Singularity.DeJongSolution k X f Z

Singularity.degree_eq_add_degree_erase.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (j : σ) (c : σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree c = c j + Finsupp.degree (Finsupp.erase j c)

Singularity.degree_eq_none_add_degree_so.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (e : Option σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree e = e none + Finsupp.degree e.some

Singularity.degree_expStep_add_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {p : ℕ} (j : σ) {e : σ →₀ ℕ},
  p ≤ Finsupp.degree e → Finsupp.degree (Singularity.OriginRuns.expStep p j e) + p + e j = 2 * Finsupp.degree e

Singularity.degree_expansionCoeff_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → ∀ (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ), (Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j).degree < φ.degree

Singularity.degree_mono.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {N r : σ →₀ ℕ}, N ≤ r → Finsupp.degree N ≤ Finsupp.degree r

Singularity.degree_mul_divByMonic_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ a b : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → 0 < φ.natDegree → a.degree < φ.degree → b.degree < φ.degree → (a * b /ₘ φ).degree < φ.degree

Singularity.degree_optionElim.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (k : ℕ), Finsupp.degree (Finsupp.optionElim k d) = Finsupp.degree d + k

Singularity.degree_sub_lt_of_monic.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → (ψ - φ).degree < φ.degree

Singularity.degree_sum_lt_degree.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {α : Type u_4} {s : Finset α} {G : α → Polynomial K},
      (∀ x ∈ s, (G x).degree < φ.degree) → (∑ x ∈ s, G x).degree < φ.degree

Singularity.dehomogenize.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.dehomogenize_comp_chartRest.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.dehomogenize j).comp (Singularity.chartRest j t) = Singularity.chartRest j t

Singularity.dehomogenize_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.dehomogenize j) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) = (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.erase j a)) c

Singularity.delta_eq_sum_add.type:
∀ {δ m : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ i < n, δ i = m i * (m i - 1) / 2 + δ (i + 1)) → δ 0 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, m i * (m i - 1) / 2 + δ n

Singularity.delta_eq_sum_of_blowups.type:
∀ {δ m : ℕ → ℕ} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ i < n, δ i = m i * (m i - 1) / 2 + δ (i + 1)) → δ n = 0 → δ 0 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, m i * (m i - 1) / 2

Singularity.derivIdeal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R) → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.derivIdeal_iterate_le_chartC.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {S : Finset σ} {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ m →
    ∀ (l : ℕ), Singularity.derivIdeal^[l] I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ (m - l)

Singularity.derivIdeal_iterate_le_ordAtP.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] {a : σ → k} {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  I ≤ Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a m → ∀ (j : ℕ), Singularity.derivIdeal^[j] I ≤ Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a (m - j)

Singularity.derivIdeal_iterate_le_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {m : ℕ},
  I ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ m →
    ∀ (j : ℕ), Singularity.derivIdeal^[j] I ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ (m - j)

Singularity.derivIdeal_le_chartCenterIde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ n → Singularity.derivIdeal I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ (n - 1)

Singularity.derivIdeal_le_ordAtPointIdea.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] {a : σ → k} {n : ℕ} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  I ≤ Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a (n + 1) → Singularity.derivIdeal I ≤ Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a n

Singularity.derivIdeal_le_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ},
  I ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n → Singularity.derivIdeal I ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ (n - 1)

Singularity.derivIdeal_mono.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  I ≤ J → Singularity.derivIdeal I ≤ Singularity.derivIdeal J

Singularity.derivIdeal_span.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (S : Set (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.derivIdeal (Ideal.span S) = Ideal.span (S ∪ {g | ∃ i, ∃ f ∈ S, g = (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f})

Singularity.derivLogJacobian.type:
{k : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} →
    {ι : Type u_3} →
      [inst : CommRing k] →
        [inst_1 : CommRing R] → [inst_2 : Algebra k R] → (ι → Derivation k R R) → (ι → R) → Finset ι → R → Ideal R

Singularity.derivLogJacobian_algebraMap.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.derivLogJacobian Singularity.originDerivation
      (fun i => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k)) (MvPolynomial.X i)) Δ
      ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k)) g) =
    Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k)) (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g)

Singularity.derivLogJacobian_eq_bot_iff.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} [inst_4 : Fintype ι] [IsDomain R]
  [inst_6 : IsLocalRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p],
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (u : Rˣ) {a : ι → ℕ} {Δ : Finset ι},
      (∀ (i : ι), ¬p ∣ a i → i ∈ Δ) →
        ∀ {i₁ : ι},
          ¬p ∣ a i₁ →
            x i₁ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R →
              ∀ {f d : R},
                d ≠ 0 →
                  ∀ {s : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ → R},
                    d ^ p * f = ∑ i ∈ s, c i ^ p * (↑u * ∏ i, x i ^ a i) ^ i →
                      (Singularity.derivLogJacobian D x Δ f = ⊥ ↔
                        ∑ i ∈ s, ↑i * c i ^ p * (↑u * ∏ i, x i ^ a i) ^ (i - 1) = 0)

Singularity.derivLogJacobian_isPrincipal.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} [inst_4 : Fintype ι] [IsDomain R]
  [inst_6 : IsLocalRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p],
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (u : Rˣ) {a : ι → ℕ} {Δ : Finset ι},
      (∀ (i : ι), ¬p ∣ a i → i ∈ Δ) →
        ∀ {i₁ : ι},
          ¬p ∣ a i₁ →
            x i₁ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R →
              ∀ {f d : R},
                d ≠ 0 →
                  ∀ {s : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ → R},
                    d ^ p * f = ∑ i ∈ s, c i ^ p * (↑u * ∏ i, x i ^ a i) ^ i →
                      Submodule.IsPrincipal (Singularity.derivLogJacobian D x Δ f)

Singularity.derivLogJacobian_unit_mul_mo.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} [inst_4 : Fintype ι] [inst_5 : IsLocalRing R] (p : ℕ)
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p],
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (u : Rˣ) {a : ι → ℕ} {Δ : Finset ι},
      (∀ (i : ι), ¬p ∣ a i → i ∈ Δ) →
        ∀ {i₁ : ι},
          ¬p ∣ a i₁ →
            x i₁ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R →
              Singularity.derivLogJacobian D x Δ (↑u * ∏ i, x i ^ a i) = Ideal.span {↑u * ∏ i, x i ^ a i}

Singularity.derivationIdeal.type:
(k : Type u_1) →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing k] → [inst_1 : CommRing B] → [inst_2 : Algebra k B] → Submodule B (Derivation k B B) → B → Ideal B

Singularity.derivationIdeal_add_pow.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B] {p : ℕ} [CharP B p]
  (M : Submodule B (Derivation k B B)) (f h : B),
  Singularity.derivationIdeal k M (f + h ^ p) = Singularity.derivationIdeal k M f

Singularity.derivationIdeal_center.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] (Δ S : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.derivationIdeal k
      (Singularity.tangentDerivations k (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑Δ) ⊓
        Singularity.stableDerivations k (Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S)))
      g =
    Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g

Singularity.derivationIdeal_mono.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B]
  {M M' : Submodule B (Derivation k B B)},
  M ≤ M' → ∀ (f : B), Singularity.derivationIdeal k M f ≤ Singularity.derivationIdeal k M' f

Singularity.derivationIdeal_tangentDeriv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.derivationIdeal k (Singularity.tangentDerivations k (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑Δ)) g =
    Singularity.logJacobian Δ g

Singularity.derivation_eq_sum_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Fintype σ]
  (δ : Derivation k (MvPolynomial σ k) (MvPolynomial σ k)), δ = ∑ i, δ (MvPolynomial.X i) • MvPolynomial.pderiv i

Singularity.derivation_eq_zero_of_aeval_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_4 : Module A M] [inst_5 : Module k M] (D : Derivation k A M) {b : A}
  {Q : Polynomial k},
  (Polynomial.aeval b) Q = 0 → (∀ (m : M), (Polynomial.aeval b) (Polynomial.derivative Q) • m = 0 → m = 0) → D b = 0

Singularity.derivation_eq_zero_of_algebr.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra k L]
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_4 : Module L M] [inst_5 : Module k M] [Algebra.IsSeparable k L]
  (D : Derivation k L M), D = 0

Singularity.derivation_eq_zero_of_isSepa.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra k L]
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_4 : Module L M] [inst_5 : Module k M] (D : Derivation k L M) {x : L},
  IsSeparable k x → D x = 0

Singularity.derivation_finsetSum_pow_mul.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p]
  (δ : Derivation k R R) (s : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → R) (t : R),
  δ (∑ i ∈ s, c i ^ p * t ^ i) = (∑ i ∈ s, ↑i * c i ^ p * t ^ (i - 1)) * δ t

Singularity.derivation_mem_derivLogJacob.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  (D : ι → Derivation k R R) (x : ι → R) {Δ : Finset ι} {j : ι},
  j ∉ Δ → ∀ (f : R), (D j) f ∈ Singularity.derivLogJacobian D x Δ f

Singularity.derivation_mem_maximalIdeal_.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A]
  [inst_3 : IsLocalRing A] (D : Derivation R A A) (r : ℕ) {x : A},
  x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ (r + 1) → D x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ r

Singularity.derivation_mem_of_algebraMap.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra R T]
  (D : Derivation R T T) (M : Ideal T) [inst_3 : M.IsPrime] {p : ℕ},
  2 ≤ p →
    ∀ {h : T},
      (algebraMap T (Localization.AtPrime M)) h ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime M) ^ p → D h ∈ M

Singularity.derivation_mem_of_mem_pow.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra R T]
  (D : Derivation R T T) (M : Ideal T) [M.IsPrime] {p : ℕ}, 2 ≤ p → ∀ {h : T}, h ∈ M ^ p → D h ∈ M

Singularity.derivation_mem_of_mul_mem_po.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra R T]
  (D : Derivation R T T) (M : Ideal T) [M.IsPrime] {p : ℕ}, 2 ≤ p → ∀ {s h : T}, s ∉ M → s * h ∈ M ^ p → D h ∈ M

Singularity.derivation_mem_pow_of_mem_po.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A]
  (D : Derivation R A A) (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) {x : A}, x ∈ I ^ (r + 1) → D x ∈ I ^ r

Singularity.derivation_mem_pow_pred.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra R B]
  (D : Derivation R B B) (I : Ideal B) (e : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ I ^ e, D x ∈ I ^ (e - 1)

Singularity.derivation_mem_pow_smul_top_.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A]
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_4 : Module A M] [inst_5 : Module R M] (D : Derivation R A M) (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ),
  ∀ x ∈ I ^ (r + 1), D x ∈ I ^ r • ⊤

Singularity.derivation_mem_pow_succ.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra R B]
  (D : Derivation R B B) (I : Ideal B) (e : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ I ^ (e + 1), D x ∈ I ^ e

Singularity.derivation_monomial.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} [inst_4 : Fintype ι],
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (a : ι → ℕ) (i : ι), (D i) (∏ j, x j ^ a j) = (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, x j ^ a j) * (D i) (x i ^ a i)

Singularity.derivation_monomial_eq_zero.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} [inst_4 : Fintype ι] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p],
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) → ∀ {a : ι → ℕ} {i : ι}, p ∣ a i → (D i) (∏ j, x j ^ a j) = 0

Singularity.derivation_pow_apply_mem.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A] (δ : Derivation k A A)
  (B : Subalgebra k A), (∀ b ∈ B, δ b ∈ B) → ∀ (n : ℕ) {a : A}, a ∈ B → (↑δ ^ n) a ∈ B

Singularity.derivation_pow_apply_mul_of_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A] (δ : Derivation k A A)
  (n : ℕ) (x : A) {b : A}, δ b = 0 → (↑δ ^ n) (x * b) = (↑δ ^ n) x * b

Singularity.derivation_pow_apply_pow_of_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A] (δ : Derivation k A A)
  {y : A}, δ y = 1 → ∀ {i j : ℕ}, i < j → (↑δ ^ j) (y ^ i) = 0

Singularity.derivation_pow_apply_pow_sel.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A] (δ : Derivation k A A)
  {y : A}, δ y = 1 → ∀ (m : ℕ), (↑δ ^ m) (y ^ m) = ↑m.factorial

Singularity.derivation_pow_char.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B] {p : ℕ} [CharP B p]
  (δ : Derivation k B B) (h : B), δ (h ^ p) = 0

Singularity.derivation_pow_eq_zero_of_dv.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p]
  (δ : Derivation k R R) {n : ℕ}, p ∣ n → ∀ (y : R), δ (y ^ n) = 0

Singularity.derivation_sum_pow_mul_pow.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B] {p : ℕ} [CharP B p]
  (δ : Derivation k B B) (c : Fin p → B) (t : B), δ (∑ i, c i ^ p * t ^ ↑i) = (∑ i, ↑↑i * c i ^ p * t ^ (↑i - 1)) * δ t

Singularity.derivation_taylorMonomial_eq.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (δ : ι → Derivation k A A) (y : ι → A),
  (∀ (j l : ι), (δ j) (y l) = if j = l then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (c : ι → ℕ) (j : ι), c j = 0 → (δ j) (Singularity.taylorMonomial y c) = 0

Singularity.derivation_unit_mul_monomial.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} [inst_4 : Fintype ι] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p],
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (u : Rˣ) {a : ι → ℕ} {j : ι}, p ∣ a j → (D j) (↑u * ∏ i, x i ^ a i) = (↑u * ∏ i, x i ^ a i) * ((D j) ↑u * ↑u⁻¹)

Singularity.derivative_C_sub_X_pow_eq_ze.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (a : R) {n : ℕ},
  ↑n = 0 → Polynomial.derivative (Polynomial.C a - Polynomial.X ^ n) = 0

Singularity.derivative_one_add_X_pow_suc.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p],
  Polynomial.derivative (1 + Polynomial.X ^ (p + 1)) = Polynomial.X ^ p

Singularity.derivative_shiftT.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (b : σ → MvPolynomial σ R)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Polynomial.derivative ((Singularity.shiftT b) f) =
    ∑ i, Polynomial.C (b i) * (Singularity.shiftT b) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f)

Singularity.diag_eq_of_isPrincipalRelati.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {M M' : Matrix ι ι ℤ} {a g : ι → ℤ},
  (∀ (i j : ι), i ≠ j → M i j = M' i j) →
    Singularity.IsPrincipalRelation M a g → Singularity.IsPrincipalRelation M' a g → ∀ {i : ι}, a i ≠ 0 → M i i = M' i i

Singularity.directrix.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → MvPolynomial σ k → Submodule k (σ → k)

Singularity.directrixPolys.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → (σ → k) → Submodule k (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.directrix_homogeneousCompone.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {m : ℕ} {u ψ' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff u ≠ 0 →
    ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord ψ' →
      Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) (u * ψ')) =
        Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ')

Singularity.directrix_le_directrix_smul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (c : k) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.directrix F ≤ Singularity.directrix (c • F)

Singularity.directrix_smul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {c : k},
  c ≠ 0 → ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.directrix (c • F) = Singularity.directrix F

Singularity.directrix_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k], Singularity.directrix 0 = ⊤

Singularity.discr_ne_zero_of_isSeparable.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Field K]
  [inst_3 : Field L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] (e : Module.Basis ι K L),
  Algebra.discr K ⇑e ≠ 0

Singularity.divByMonic_X_eq_divX.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (f : Polynomial K), f /ₘ Polynomial.X = f.divX

Singularity.divOrd.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → R → Ideal R → ℕ

Singularity.divOrd_eq_of.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {t : R} {I : Ideal R} {c : ℕ},
  I ≤ Ideal.span {t ^ c} → ¬I ≤ Ideal.span {t ^ (c + 1)} → Singularity.divOrd t I = c

Singularity.divOrd_span_pow_mul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {t : R},
  t ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {B : Ideal R},
      Singularity.HasDivOrd t B → ∀ (g : ℕ), Singularity.divOrd t (Ideal.span {t ^ g} * B) = g + Singularity.divOrd t B

Singularity.divX_iterate_eq_zero.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (f : Polynomial R) {n : ℕ}, f.natDegree < n → Polynomial.divX^[n] f = 0

Singularity.div_eq_pow_of_eq_pow_mul.type: ∀ {n e f p ν : ℕ}, 0 < e * f → n = p ^ ν * (e * f) → n / (e * f) = p ^ ν

Singularity.div_mem_idealChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {f a : R},
  a ∈ I → (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)) a * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf f ∈ Singularity.idealChart I f

Singularity.div_pow_eq_of_eq_add.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {L : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra R L] {p : ℕ} [ExpChar L p]
  {f h w y : R},
  IsUnit w →
    f = h ^ p + w ^ p * y →
      ∀ {z : L}, z ^ p = (algebraMap R L) f → ((z - (algebraMap R L) h) / (algebraMap R L) w) ^ p = (algebraMap R L) y

Singularity.divisorDelta.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing k] → [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → σ → ℝ

Singularity.divisorDelta_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ]
  {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {x : σ → ℝ},
  x ∈ Singularity.projPolyhedron f → ∀ (j : σ), Singularity.divisorDelta f j ≤ x j

Singularity.divisorExponent.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → σ →₀ ℕ

Singularity.divisorExponent_apply.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k)
  (i : σ), (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) i = if i ∈ Δ then sInf ((fun d => d i) '' ↑F.support) else 0

Singularity.divisorExponent_cleanPart_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k} {g F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), ψ (φ h) = h) →
    (∀ l ∈ Δ, ∃ c, φ (MvPolynomial.X l) = MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X l) →
      g ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.IsClean p g →
          Singularity.logJacobian Δ F = Ideal.map φ (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g) →
            Singularity.divisorExponent Δ (Singularity.cleanPart p F) = Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g

Singularity.divisorExponent_eq_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {i : σ},
  i ∉ Δ → (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P) i = 0

Singularity.divisorExponent_eq_zero_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ i ∈ Δ, ∃ β ∈ P.support, β i = 0) → Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P = 0

Singularity.divisorExponent_eq_zero_of_n.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (P : MvPolynomial σ k),
  ∀ i ∉ Δ, (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P) i = 0

Singularity.divisorExponent_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {β : σ →₀ ℕ},

Singularity.divisorNodePoly.type: (k : Type u_1) → [inst : Field k] → {ι : Type u_2} → Finset ι → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Option ι) k)

Singularity.divisorNodePoly_mem_sq.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field k] {ι : Type u_2} [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} {i j : ι},

          Ideal.span
              {Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X none), Polynomial.X, Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X (some i)),
                Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X (some j))} ^
            2

Singularity.divisorNode_chart.type: ∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] (u' v t₁ g : A), u' * t₁ * v - t₁ * g = t₁ * (u' * v - g)

Singularity.dvd_apply_of_dvd_degree.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {q : ℕ} {α : σ →₀ ℕ} (j : σ),
  (∀ (i : σ), i ≠ j → q ∣ α i) → q ∣ Finsupp.degree α → ∀ (i : σ), q ∣ α i

Singularity.dvd_of_pderiv_eq_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ} [CharP k p] {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f = 0) → ∀ {a : σ →₀ ℕ}, a ∈ f.support → ∀ (i : σ), p ∣ a i

Singularity.dvd_of_pow_mul_eq_mul.type:
∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing B] [IsDomain B] {x F : B},
  Prime x → ¬x ∣ F → ∀ (k : ℕ) {b c : B}, x ^ k * b = F * c → F ∣ b

Singularity.dvd_pointChart_of_monomial_o.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : ℕ} {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 ∣ h →
    ↑(Finsupp.degree r + c) ≤ Singularity.ord h →
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ (Finsupp.degree r + c) * (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t r)) 1 ∣
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) h

Singularity.eEight_xChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ z₁ : R),
  (x * z₁) ^ 2 + x ^ 3 + (x * y₁) ^ 5 = x ^ 2 * (z₁ ^ 2 + x + x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 5)

Singularity.eEight_xChart_regular.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R],
  2 = 0 ∨ 3 = 0 ∨ 5 = 0 →
    ∀ (x y₁ z₁ : R), Ideal.span {z₁ ^ 2 + x + x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 5, 1 + 3 * x ^ 2 * y₁ ^ 5, 5 * x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 4, 2 * z₁} = ⊤

Singularity.eEight_xChart_regular_five.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R],
  5 = 0 →
    ∀ (x y₁ z₁ : R), Ideal.span {z₁ ^ 2 + x + x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 5, 1 + 3 * x ^ 2 * y₁ ^ 5, 5 * x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 4, 2 * z₁} = ⊤

Singularity.eEight_xChart_regular_three.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R],
  3 = 0 →
    ∀ (x y₁ z₁ : R), Ideal.span {z₁ ^ 2 + x + x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 5, 1 + 3 * x ^ 2 * y₁ ^ 5, 5 * x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 4, 2 * z₁} = ⊤

Singularity.eEight_xChart_regular_two.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R],
  2 = 0 →
    ∀ (x y₁ z₁ : R), Ideal.span {z₁ ^ 2 + x + x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 5, 1 + 3 * x ^ 2 * y₁ ^ 5, 5 * x ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 4, 2 * z₁} = ⊤

Singularity.eEight_yChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y x₁ z₁ : R),
  (y * z₁) ^ 2 + (y * x₁) ^ 3 + y ^ 5 = y ^ 2 * (z₁ ^ 2 + y * x₁ ^ 3 + y ^ 3)

Singularity.eEight_yChart_exceptional.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {y x₁ z₁ : R},
  y = 0 → z₁ ^ 2 + y * x₁ ^ 3 + y ^ 3 = 0 → x₁ ^ 3 + 3 * y ^ 2 = 0 → x₁ = 0 ∧ z₁ = 0

Singularity.eEight_zChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (z x₁ y₁ : R),
  z ^ 2 + (z * x₁) ^ 3 + (z * y₁) ^ 5 = z ^ 2 * (1 + z * x₁ ^ 3 + z ^ 3 * y₁ ^ 5)

Singularity.eSix_complete_square.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ι ζ v u : R},
  ι ^ 2 = -1 →
    ζ ^ 3 = 2 →
      v * ζ = 1 →
        2 * u = 1 →
          ∀ (y x₁ z₁ : R),
            (y + x₁ ^ 3 * u + ι * z₁) * (y + x₁ ^ 3 * u - ι * z₁) - (x₁ * v) ^ 6 = z₁ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + y * x₁ ^ 3

Singularity.eSix_complete_square_inverse.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ι ζ v u : R},
  v * ζ = 1 →
    2 * u = 1 →
      ∀ (y x₁ z₁ : R),
        ζ * (x₁ * v) = x₁ ∧
          y + x₁ ^ 3 * u + ι * z₁ - (y + x₁ ^ 3 * u - ι * z₁) = 2 * ι * z₁ ∧
            (y + x₁ ^ 3 * u + ι * z₁ + (y + x₁ ^ 3 * u - ι * z₁)) * u - ζ ^ 3 * (x₁ * v) ^ 3 * u = y

Singularity.eSix_exceptional_curve.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ζ v u : R},
  ζ ^ 3 = 2 → v * ζ = 1 → 2 * u = 1 → ∀ (x₁ : R), x₁ ^ 3 * u = (x₁ * v) ^ 3

Singularity.eSix_inv_cube.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {ζ v u : R}, ζ ^ 3 = 2 → v * ζ = 1 → 2 * u = 1 → v ^ 3 = u

Singularity.eSix_xChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ z₁ : R),
  (x * z₁) ^ 2 + x ^ 3 + (x * y₁) ^ 4 = x ^ 2 * (z₁ ^ 2 + x + x ^ 2 * y₁ ^ 4)

Singularity.eSix_xChart_regular.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y₁ z₁ : R),
  Ideal.span {z₁ ^ 2 + x + x ^ 2 * y₁ ^ 4, 1 + 2 * x * y₁ ^ 4, 2 * z₁} = ⊤

Singularity.eSix_yChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (y x₁ z₁ : R),
  (y * z₁) ^ 2 + (y * x₁) ^ 3 + y ^ 4 = y ^ 2 * (z₁ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + y * x₁ ^ 3)

Singularity.eSix_yChart_exceptional.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {y x₁ z₁ : R},
  y = 0 → z₁ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + y * x₁ ^ 3 = 0 → 2 * y + x₁ ^ 3 = 0 → x₁ = 0 ∧ z₁ = 0

Singularity.eSix_zChart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (z x₁ y₁ : R),
  z ^ 2 + (z * x₁) ^ 3 + (z * y₁) ^ 4 = z ^ 2 * (1 + z * x₁ ^ 3 + z ^ 2 * y₁ ^ 4)

Singularity.eq_centerIdeal_of_ofPrime_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {P : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime]
  (h : LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring), P = Singularity.centerIdeal V A ⋯

Singularity.eq_gradingProj_of_sum.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] {p : ℕ}
  [inst_3 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [inst_4 : CharP R p] (δ : Derivation k R R) {c : ZMod p → R},
  (∀ (i : ZMod p), c i ∈ Singularity.weightSpace δ i) →
    ∀ {g : R}, g = ∑ i, c i → ∀ (i : ZMod p), c i = (Singularity.gradingProj δ i) g

Singularity.eq_inv_smul_sum_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {w : σ → ℕ} {D : ℕ} {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w h D →
    ↑D ≠ 0 → h = (↑D)⁻¹ • ∑ i, ↑(w i) • (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.eq_nonmonoPart_of_mul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {t : R},
  t ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {I N' : Ideal R} {a : ℕ},
      I = Ideal.span {t ^ a} * N' → ¬N' ≤ Ideal.span {t} → Singularity.divOrd t I = a ∧ N' = Singularity.nonmonoPart t I

Singularity.eq_of_comap_eq_integralClosu.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
  [inst_3 : Field K] [inst_4 : Field M] [inst_5 : Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] [inst_7 : Algebra K M]
  [inst_8 : Algebra A M] [IsScalarTower A K M] [IsPurelyInseparable K M] (q : ℕ) [hq : ExpChar K q]
  {P Q : Ideal ↥(integralClosure A M)},
  P.IsPrime →
    Q.IsPrime →
      Ideal.comap (algebraMap A ↥(integralClosure A M)) P = Ideal.comap (algebraMap A ↥(integralClosure A M)) Q → P = Q

Singularity.eq_of_comap_eq_of_forall_exi.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S],
  (∀ (s : S), ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ ∃ r, (algebraMap R S) r = s ^ n) →
    ∀ {P Q : Ideal S}, P.IsPrime → Q.IsPrime → Ideal.comap (algebraMap R S) P = Ideal.comap (algebraMap R S) Q → P = Q

Singularity.eq_of_isMuMinimal.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f) →
    ∀ {φ : Polynomial K},
      φ.Monic →
        0 < φ.natDegree →
          Singularity.IsMuMinimal ν φ → (∀ (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < φ.degree → w a = ν a) → w φ = ν φ → w = ν

Singularity.eq_of_map_eq_zero_of_degree_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {D : WithBot ℕ},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < D → w f = ν f) → ∀ {a : Polynomial K}, a ≠ 0 → a.degree < D → ν a = 0 → w = ν

Singularity.eq_of_ofPrime_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {P Q : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime]
  [inst_2 : Q.IsPrime],
  LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring → LocalSubring.ofPrime A Q ≤ V.toLocalSubring → P = Q

Singularity.eq_of_specializes_of_isDiscr.type: ∀ {T : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace T] {s : Set T}, IsDiscrete s → ∀ {x y : T}, x ∈ s → y ∈ s → x ⤳ y → x = y

Singularity.eq_of_sum_commonWeightSpace.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] {p : ℕ}
  [inst_3 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p] (δ : ι → Derivation k R R) [inst_5 : Fintype ι] [inst_6 : DecidableEq ι],
  (∀ (l j : ι) (g : R), (δ l) ((δ j) g) = (δ j) ((δ l) g)) →
    (∀ (l : ι), ↑(δ l) ^ p = ↑(δ l)) →
      ∀ {c d : (ι → ZMod p) → R},
        (∀ (χ : ι → ZMod p), c χ ∈ Singularity.commonWeightSpace δ χ) →
          (∀ (χ : ι → ZMod p), d χ ∈ Singularity.commonWeightSpace δ χ) → ∑ χ, c χ = ∑ χ, d χ → c = d

Singularity.eq_of_valuation_mul_prod_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₁ : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) {ι : Type u_5} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ {c c' : Kˣ} {a b : ι →₀ ℕ},
      vL ((algebraMap K L) ↑c * a.prod fun i n => ↑(x i) ^ n) =
          vL ((algebraMap K L) ↑c' * b.prod fun i n => ↑(x i) ^ n) →
        a = b

Singularity.eq_or_eq_inv_symm.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {a b : K}, a = b ∨ a = b⁻¹ → b = a ∨ b = a⁻¹

Singularity.eq_purelyInseparableExtensio.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [inst_3 : ExpChar K p] [inst_4 : IsPurelyInseparable K L] (V : ValuationSubring K) (W : ValuationSubring L),
  W.comap (algebraMap K L) = V → W = Singularity.purelyInseparableExtension p V

Singularity.eq_sum_expansionCoeff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      ∀ (f : Polynomial K), f = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j * φ ^ j

Singularity.eq_sum_expansionCoeff_add.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f : Polynomial K) (N : ℕ),
  f = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j * φ ^ j + φ ^ N * (fun g => g /ₘ φ)^[N] f

Singularity.eq_sum_smul_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : CommSemiring k] (w : σ → k) {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ a ∈ h.support, ∑ i ∈ a.support, w i * ↑(a i) = 1) → h = ∑ i, w i • (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.eq_zero_of_X_mem_derivIdeal_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} {h : σ},
      MvPolynomial.X h ∈ Singularity.derivIdeal^[m - 1] I →
        ∀ {a : σ → k}, (∀ f ∈ I, ↑m ≤ Singularity.ordAtPoint a f) → a h = 0

Singularity.eq_zero_of_add_mul_X_one_eq_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [CharP k 2] {a b : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k},
  a ∈ Singularity.wildInvariants → b ∈ Singularity.wildInvariants → a + b * MvPolynomial.X 1 = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0

Singularity.eq_zero_of_directrix_eq_top.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff F = 0 → Singularity.directrix F = ⊤ → F = 0

Singularity.eq_zero_of_le_ord_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ},
  IsUnit ↑m →
    ∀ {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
      a (m - 1) = 0 →
        ∀ (b : Option σ → R),
          ↑m ≤
              Singularity.ord
                ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a)) →
            b none = 0

Singularity.eq_zero_of_sum_commonWeightS.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] {p : ℕ}
  [inst_3 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p] (δ : ι → Derivation k R R) [inst_5 : Fintype ι] [inst_6 : DecidableEq ι],
  (∀ (l j : ι) (g : R), (δ l) ((δ j) g) = (δ j) ((δ l) g)) →
    (∀ (l : ι), ↑(δ l) ^ p = ↑(δ l)) →
      ∀ {c : (ι → ZMod p) → R},
        (∀ (χ : ι → ZMod p), c χ ∈ Singularity.commonWeightSpace δ χ) → ∑ χ, c χ = 0 → ∀ (χ : ι → ZMod p), c χ = 0

Singularity.essFiniteType_of_trdeg_le_tr.type:
∀ {k K : Type u} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K],
  Singularity.IsFunctionField k K →
    ∀ (V : ValuationSubring K) [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K],
      Algebra.trdeg k K ≤ Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V) + 1 → Algebra.EssFiniteType k ↥V

Singularity.eulerTotal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.eulerVar.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.eulerVar_X_pow_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p]
  (j : σ) {e n : ℕ},
  n < p ^ e →
    ∀ (P : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (Singularity.eulerVar j n) (MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * P) =
        MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * (Singularity.eulerVar j n) P

Singularity.eulerVar_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (n : ℕ)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.eulerVar j n) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) P) =
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((Singularity.eulerTotal n) P)

Singularity.evalDerivation.type:
(k : Type u_1) →
  {B : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing k] → [inst_1 : CommRing B] → [inst_2 : Algebra k B] → B → Derivation k B B →ₗ[B] B

Singularity.evalDerivation_apply.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B] (f : B)
  (δ : Derivation k B B), (Singularity.evalDerivation k f) δ = δ f

Singularity.eval_aeval_line.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {σ : Type u_2} (p v : σ → K) (f : MvPolynomial σ K) (t : K),
  Polynomial.eval t ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => Polynomial.C (p i) + Polynomial.C (v i) * Polynomial.X) f) =
    (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => p i + t * v i) f

Singularity.eval_artinSchreierPoly.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : ℕ) (a x : R),
  Polynomial.eval x (Singularity.artinSchreierPoly p a) = x ^ p - x - a

Singularity.eval_eq_zero_of_eq_sum.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : CommSemiring k] (w : σ → k) {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  h = ∑ i, w i • (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h) →
    ∀ {v : σ → k},
      (∀ (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.eval v) (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h) = 0) →
        (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0

Singularity.eval_eq_zero_of_isCriticalPo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : CommSemiring k] (w : σ → k) {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  h = ∑ i, w i • (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h) →
    ∀ {v : σ → k}, Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v → (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : Field k] {w : σ → ℕ} {D : ℕ} {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w h D →
    ↑D ≠ 0 → ∀ {v : σ → k}, Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v → (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] [Fintype σ] {h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ¬Singularity.IsResonant p h.support → ∀ {v : σ → k}, Singularity.IsCriticalPoint h v → (MvPolynomial.eval v) h = 0

Singularity.eval_eq_zero_of_mem_derivIde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] {a : σ → k} {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →

            ∀ {s : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ → Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k},

                          ∏ i,

                                (MvPolynomial.X i) ^

                            (↑u *
                                ∏ i,

                                    a i) ^
                              (i - 1)) *

                                (MvPolynomial.X i) ^

            Singularity.IsSingularPoint (Singularity.purelyInseparable p ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c)) u

Singularity.exists_translate_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) (b : Option σ → R),
      ∃ a',
        (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a) =
            Singularity.zMonic m a' ∧
          a' (m - 1) =
            (MvPolynomial.aeval fun l => MvPolynomial.X l + MvPolynomial.C (b (some l))) (a (m - 1)) +
              ↑m * MvPolynomial.C (b none)

Singularity.exists_units_pow_mul_pow_eq.type: ∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid M] (u : Mˣ) {p m : ℕ}, p.Coprime m → ∃ v w, u = v ^ m * w ^ p

Singularity.exists_units_residues_of_ran.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type uL} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} {Γ₁ : Type uΓ}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vK : Valuation K Γ₀)
  (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL],
  ∃ s t x y,
    Cardinal.mk ↑s =
        Module.rank ℤ
          (Additive
            ↥(Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) (↑vL).valueGroup)) ∧
      Cardinal.mk ↑t =
          Algebra.trdeg (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vL.valuationSubring) ∧
        (LinearIndependent ℤ fun (i : ↑s) =>
            Additive.ofMul
              ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) ∧
          AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
            (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)

Singularity.exists_valuationSubring_of_i.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (A : Subring K) (P : Ideal ↥A) [inst_1 : P.IsPrime],
  ∃ V, LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring ∧ A ≤ V.toSubring ∧ ∀ (a : ↥A), a ∈ P ↔ V.valuation ↑a < 1

Singularity.exists_valuation_aeval_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {κ : Type u_5}
  (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
  (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
      (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
    ∀ (P : MvPolynomial κ K), P ≠ 0 → ∃ c, vL ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun j => ↑(y j)) P) = vL ((algebraMap K L) ↑c)

Singularity.exists_valuation_aeval_eq_of.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] (z : ↥vL.valuationSubring)
  {p : Polynomial K},
  p ≠ 0 →
    p.natDegree <
        (minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
            ((IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) z)).natDegree →
      ∃ i,
        p.coeff i ≠ 0 ∧
          (∀ (j : ℕ), vK (p.coeff j) ≤ vK (p.coeff i)) ∧
            vL ((Polynomial.aeval ↑z) p) = vL ((algebraMap K L) (p.coeff i))

Singularity.exists_valuation_aeval_sumEl.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
      (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
        ∀ (P : MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) K),
          P ≠ 0 →
            ∃ c a,
              vL ((MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) fun j => ↑(y j))) P) =
                vL ((algebraMap K L) ↑c * a.prod fun i n => ↑(x i) ^ n)

Singularity.exists_valuation_eq_laurentM.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] {V : ValuationSubring K} {x : ι → K} {y : κ → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0) →
      (∀ c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun j => Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x y) (Sum.inr j)),
          c ∈ V.comap (algebraMap (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x y)))) K)) →
        ∀ {c : ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x y)))},
          c ≠ 0 → ∃ a, V.valuation ↑c = V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a)

Singularity.exists_valuation_eq_of_mem_a.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
      (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
        ∀ {z : L},
          z ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) fun j => ↑(y j))) →
            z ≠ 0 →
              ∃ c a b,
                vL z * vL (b.prod fun i n => ↑(x i) ^ n) = vL ((algebraMap K L) ↑c) * vL (a.prod fun i n => ↑(x i) ^ n)

Singularity.exists_valuation_sum_eq_max.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (V : ValuationSubring L)
  {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : Fintype κ] [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ] {x : ι → L}
  {y : κ → L},
  (∀ (i i' : ι),
      i ≠ i' →
        ∀ (a a' : K),
          a ≠ 0 → a' ≠ 0 → V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) a * x i) ≠ V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) a' * x i')) →
    (∀ (j : κ), V.valuation (y j) ≤ 1) →
      (∀ (d : κ → K),
          (∀ (j : κ), V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (d j)) ≤ 1) →
            V.valuation (∑ j, (algebraMap K L) (d j) * y j) < 1 → ∀ (j : κ), V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (d j)) < 1) →
        ∀ (c : ι × κ → K),
          ∃ p,
            V.valuation (∑ q, (algebraMap K L) (c q) * (x q.1 * y q.2)) = V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (c p) * x p.1) ∧
              ∀ (q : ι × κ), V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (c q) * x q.1) ≤ V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (c p) * x p.1)

Singularity.exists_valuation_sum_mul_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (V : ValuationSubring L)
  {κ : Type u_3} [inst_3 : Fintype κ] [Nonempty κ] {y : κ → L},
  (∀ (j : κ), V.valuation (y j) ≤ 1) →
    (∀ (d : κ → K),
        (∀ (j : κ), V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (d j)) ≤ 1) →
          V.valuation (∑ j, (algebraMap K L) (d j) * y j) < 1 → ∀ (j : κ), V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (d j)) < 1) →
      ∀ (c : κ → K),
        ∃ j,
          V.valuation (∑ j, (algebraMap K L) (c j) * y j) = V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (c j)) ∧
            ∀ (j' : κ), V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (c j')) ≤ V.valuation ((algebraMap K L) (c j))

Singularity.exists_zShift_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (h : MvPolynomial σ R) {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R),
      ∃ a', (Singularity.zShift h) (Singularity.zMonic m a) = Singularity.zMonic m a' ∧ a' (m - 1) = a (m - 1) + ↑m * h

Singularity.expToReal_apply.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ), Singularity.expToReal d i = ↑(d i)

Singularity.expToReal_eq_smul_of_isUniqu.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {w : σ → ℝ}
  {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {y : σ → ℝ},
  Singularity.IsUniqueMinimizer w (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) y →
    ∀ {i : ℕ},
      1 ≤ i →
        i ≤ f.natDegree →
          ∀ {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
            (MvPowerSeries.coeff a) (f.coeff (f.natDegree - i)) ≠ 0 →
              Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a) = ↑i * Singularity.linWeight w y →
                Singularity.expToReal a = ↑i • y

Singularity.expToReal_mem_newtonPolyhedr.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  d ∈ f.support → Singularity.expToReal d ∈ Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f

Singularity.expToReal_nsmul.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (i : ℕ) (v : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.expToReal (i • v) = ↑i • Singularity.expToReal v

Singularity.expansionCoeff.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : Field K] → Polynomial K → Polynomial K → ℕ → Polynomial K

Singularity.expansionCoeff_X.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff Polynomial.X f j = Polynomial.C (f.coeff j)

Singularity.expansionCoeff_add.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f g : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (f + g) j = Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j + Singularity.expansionCoeff φ g j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_eq_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → 0 < φ.natDegree → ∀ {f : Polynomial K} {j : ℕ}, f.natDegree < j → Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j = 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_mul_left_succ.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ∀ (h : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ * h) (j + 1) = Singularity.expansionCoeff φ h j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_mul_left_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → ∀ (h : Polynomial K), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ * h) 0 = 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_neg.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (-f) j = -Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_pow_mul_add.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ∀ (h : Polynomial K) (n j : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ ^ n * h) (j + n) = Singularity.expansionCoeff φ h j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_pow_mul_of_de.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ∀ {c : Polynomial K},
      c.degree < φ.degree → ∀ (n k : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ ^ n * c) k = if k = n then c else 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_pow_mul_of_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic → ∀ (h : Polynomial K) {n j : ℕ}, j < n → Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (φ ^ n * h) j = 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_succ.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f (j + 1) = Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (f /ₘ φ) j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_sum.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (∑ i ∈ s, F i) j = ∑ i ∈ s, Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (F i) j

Singularity.expansionCoeff_sum_mul_pow.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ∀ {c : ℕ → Polynomial K} {N : ℕ},
      (∀ j < N, (c j).degree < φ.degree) →
        ∀ (k : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, c j * φ ^ j) k = if k < N then c k else 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_zero.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (j : ℕ), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ 0 j = 0

Singularity.expansionCoeff_zero_eq_modBy.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {φ : Polynomial K} (f : Polynomial K), Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f 0 = f %ₘ φ

Singularity.extremePoints_convexHull_add.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (S : Set (σ → ℝ)), Set.extremePoints ℝ ((convexHull ℝ) S + Singularity.orthant σ) ⊆ S

Singularity.extremePoints_projPolyhedron.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) ⊆ Singularity.projPoints f

Singularity.false_of_strictAnti.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
    ∀ {s : ℕ → Γ₀}, StrictAnti s → ∀ {c : Γ₀}, c ≠ 0 → (∀ (n : ℕ), c ≤ s n) → (∀ (n : ℕ), s n ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) → False

Singularity.false_of_strictAnti_of_noMax.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c d : Γ₀), c ≠ 0 → (Set.Icc c d ∩ Set.range ⇑ν).Finite) →
    ∀ {ι : Type u_3} [inst_2 : LinearOrder ι] [Nonempty ι] [NoMaxOrder ι] {s : ι → Γ₀},
      StrictAnti s → ∀ {c : Γ₀}, c ≠ 0 → (∀ (i : ι), c ≤ s i) → (∀ (i : ι), s i ∈ Set.range ⇑ν) → False

Singularity.fg_residueField_of_hasExtens.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} [Finite κ]
  (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
      (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
        ∀ (F : IntermediateField K L),
          F = IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) fun j => ↑(y j))) →
            ∀ [FiniteDimensional (↥F) L], ⊤.FG

Singularity.finSepDegree_eq_card_algEqui.type:
∀ (F : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] [Normal F E],
  Field.finSepDegree F E = Nat.card Gal(E/F)

Singularity.finiteDimensional_adjoin_of_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι],
  Singularity.IsFunctionField k K →
    ∀ {z : ι → K},
      AlgebraicIndependent k z →
        Algebra.trdeg k K ≤ ↑(Fintype.card ι) → FiniteDimensional (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range z))) K

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {m : Type u_3} [Finite m]
  {f : m → L},
  ⊤.FG →
    AlgebraicIndependent K f →
      Algebra.trdeg K L ≤ ↑(Nat.card m) → FiniteDimensional (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range f))) L

Singularity.finiteDimensional_adjoin_sum.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K}
  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K],
  Singularity.IsFunctionField k K →
    Singularity.IsAbhyankarValuation k V →
      ∀ {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4} [inst_5 : Fintype ι] [inst_6 : Fintype κ] {x : ι → K} {y : κ → ↥V},
        (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
          (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0) →
            (AlgebraicIndependent k fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y j)) →
              Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive V.ValueGroupˣ)) = ↑(Fintype.card ι) →
                Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V) = ↑(Fintype.card κ) →
                  FiniteDimensional (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j))))) K

Singularity.finiteDimensional_iff_isAlge.type:
∀ (K : Type u_2) (L : Type u_3) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L],
  ⊤.FG → (FiniteDimensional K L ↔ Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L)

Singularity.finiteDimensional_iff_trdeg_.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field k] {K L : Type u} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Field L] [inst_3 : Algebra k K]
  [inst_4 : Algebra k L] [inst_5 : Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L],
  ⊤.FG → Algebra.trdeg k K < Cardinal.aleph0 → (FiniteDimensional K L ↔ Algebra.trdeg k L = Algebra.trdeg k K)

Singularity.finiteDimensional_residueFie.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
      (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
        ∀ (F : IntermediateField K L),
          F = IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) fun j => ↑(y j))) →
            ∀ [FiniteDimensional (↥F) L],
              FiniteDimensional
                (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
                    (Set.range fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j))))
                (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vL.valuationSubring)

Singularity.hasRegularCenter_insert_of_r.type:

Singularity.idealChartAwayMap_invSelf_mu.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {f : R} {T : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra R T],
  (Singularity.idealChartAwayMap f T) (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf f) *

Singularity.idealChartLift.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →

        {T : Type u_2} →

Singularity.idealChart_eq_top_of_one_mem.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R}, 1 ∈ I → ∀ (f : R), Singularity.idealChart I f = ⊤

Singularity.idealChart_top_eq_top.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (f : R), Singularity.idealChart ⊤ f = ⊤

Singularity.idealOfSubgroup_subgroupOfId.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (P : Ideal ↥V) [inst_1 : P.IsPrime],
