Singularity.idealOrd.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R) → ℕ∞

Singularity.idealOrdAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R) → ℕ∞

Singularity.idealOrd_anti.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  I ≤ J → Singularity.idealOrd J ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I

Singularity.idealOrd_bot.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R], Singularity.idealOrd ⊥ = ⊤

Singularity.idealOrd_centerChartTransfor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] {h : σ} {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
      I ≤ Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X h} ^ m →
        MvPolynomial.X h ^ m ∈ I →
          I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal {h} ^ m ∧
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal {h} h m I) < ↑m

Singularity.idealOrd_chartTransformIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {m : ℕ}
  {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  Singularity.idealOrd I ≤ ↑m →
    ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I → Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.chartTransformIdeal j t m I) ≤ ↑m

Singularity.idealOrd_derivIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [Fintype σ] [CharZero k] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)),
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal I) = Singularity.idealOrd I - 1

Singularity.idealOrd_derivIdeal_iterate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [Fintype σ] [CharZero k] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) (j : ℕ),
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal^[j] I) = Singularity.idealOrd I - ↑j

Singularity.idealOrd_derivIdeal_of_eq_ze.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [Fintype σ] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  Singularity.idealOrd I = 0 ∨ Singularity.idealOrd I = ⊤ →
    Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal I) = Singularity.idealOrd I - 1

Singularity.idealOrd_derivIdeal_of_ne_ze.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [Fintype σ] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} {r : ℕ},
  Singularity.idealOrd I = ↑r → 1 ≤ r → ↑r ≠ 0 → Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal I) = ↑(r - 1)

Singularity.idealOrd_idealOfVars.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] [Nonempty σ],
  Singularity.idealOrd (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R) = 1

Singularity.idealOrd_le_idealOrd_map.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
    ∀ (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)), Singularity.idealOrd I ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.map φ I)

Singularity.idealOrd_le_ord.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ∈ I → Singularity.idealOrd I ≤ Singularity.ord f

Singularity.idealOrd_logJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g) =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g

Singularity.idealOrd_logJacobianTangent_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                ∀ {ψ f' : MvPolynomial σ k},
                  Singularity.ord ψ = ↑d →
                    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈
                        Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                      (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ) =
                          MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * f' →
                        f' ∈
                            Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g') →
                          Singularity.idealOrd
                              (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) ≤
                            ↑(Finsupp.degree
                                  (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                                d)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                  ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) ≠ 0 →
                    Singularity.idealOrd
                        (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                          (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                      ↑(Finsupp.degree
                            (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                          d)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
              Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                  ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                  (∀ i ∈ Δ, i ≠ j → t i = 0) →
                    Singularity.idealOrd
                        (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                          (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                      ↑(Finsupp.degree
                            (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                          d)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
              Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                  ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                  Singularity.ord
                        (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) j) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
                          MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) =
                      ↑d →
                    (∀ i ∈ Δ,
                        i ≠ j →
                          ↑d <
                            Singularity.ord
                              (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
                                MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))) →
                      Singularity.idealOrd
                          (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                            (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                        ↑(Finsupp.degree
                              (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                            d)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                ∀ {i : σ},
                  i ∈ Δ →
                    i ≠ j →
                      t i = 0 →
                        Singularity.ord
                              (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
                                MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) =
                            ↑d →
                          Singularity.idealOrd
                              (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                            ↑(Finsupp.degree
                                  (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                                d)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      (Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
          ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1 ↔
        Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1 = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      (Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
          ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ↔
        Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
        ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 → Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = Singularity.ord g

Singularity.idealOrd_logJacobian_ne_top.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 → Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g) ≠ ⊤

Singularity.idealOrd_map_eq_of_inverse.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), ψ (φ h) = h) →
    (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
      (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (ψ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
        ∀ (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)), Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.map φ I) = Singularity.idealOrd I

Singularity.idealOrd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.idealOrd (I * J) = Singularity.idealOrd I + Singularity.idealOrd J

Singularity.idealOrd_nonmonoPart_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (t : MvPolynomial σ R) (B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.nonmonoPart t B) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd B

Singularity.idealOrd_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R))
  (n : ℕ), Singularity.idealOrd (I ^ n) = n • Singularity.idealOrd I

Singularity.idealOrd_residualLogJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G) = 0 ↔
    (∃ i ∈ Δ, ↑(r i) * MvPolynomial.constantCoeff G ≠ 0) ∨
      ∃ j ∉ Δ, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G) ≠ 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} (r : σ →₀ ℕ) {G : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.ord G = ↑d →
    (Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G) < ↑d ↔
      ∃ j ∉ Δ, (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) G) ≠ 0)

Singularity.idealOrd_span_eq_zero_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.span S) = 0 ↔ ∃ s ∈ S, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff s ≠ 0

Singularity.idealOrd_span_singleton.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.span {f}) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.idealOrd_sup.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.idealOrd (I ⊔ J) = min (Singularity.idealOrd I) (Singularity.idealOrd J)

Singularity.image_mul_derivLogJacobian_e.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} (p : ℕ) [CharP R p] (Δ : Finset ι) {f d t : R} {s : Finset ℕ} {c : ℕ → R},
  d ^ p * f = ∑ i ∈ s, c i ^ p * t ^ i →
    Ideal.span ((fun x => d ^ p * x) '' ((fun i => x i * (D i) f) '' ↑Δ ∪ (fun j => (D j) f) '' (↑Δ)ᶜ)) =
      Ideal.span
        ((fun x => (∑ i ∈ s, ↑i * c i ^ p * t ^ (i - 1)) * x) ''
          ((fun i => x i * (D i) t) '' ↑Δ ∪ (fun j => (D j) t) '' (↑Δ)ᶜ))

Singularity.inftyChart_le.type:
∀ (F : Type u_1) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq (RatFunc F)],
  Singularity.inftyChart F ≤ (RatFunc.inftyValuation F).valuationSubring.toSubring

Singularity.inftyValuation_X_inv.type:
∀ (F : Type u_1) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq (RatFunc F)],
  (RatFunc.inftyValuation F) RatFunc.X⁻¹ = WithZero.exp (-1)

Singularity.inftyValuation_X_inv_lt_one.type: ∀ (F : Type u_1) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq (RatFunc F)], (RatFunc.inftyValuation F) RatFunc.X⁻¹ < 1

Singularity.inftyValuation_aeval_inv_X_l.type:
∀ (F : Type u_1) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq (RatFunc F)] (q : Polynomial F),
  (RatFunc.inftyValuation F) ((Polynomial.aeval RatFunc.X⁻¹) q) ≤ 1

∀ (F : Type u_1) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq (RatFunc F)] (q : Polynomial F),
  (RatFunc.inftyValuation F) ((Polynomial.aeval RatFunc.X⁻¹) q) < 1 ↔ Polynomial.X ∣ q

Singularity.inftyValuation_algebraMap_le.type:
∀ (F : Type u_1) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq (RatFunc F)] (a : F),
  (RatFunc.inftyValuation F) ((algebraMap F (RatFunc F)) a) ≤ 1

Singularity.initialForm.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.initialFormAt.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing k] → [Fintype σ] → (σ → ℝ) → ℝ → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)

Singularity.initialFormAt_isHomogeneous.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (w : σ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
  (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) {d : ℕ},
  d < f.natDegree →
    ∀ {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff a) ((Singularity.initialFormAt w δ f).coeff d) ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a) + ↑d * δ = ↑f.natDegree * δ

Singularity.initialForm_add_of_disjoint.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {P Q : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.weightedOrd w P = Singularity.weightedOrd w Q →
    (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), P.coeff d = 0 ∨ Q.coeff d = 0) →
      Singularity.initialForm w (P + Q) = Singularity.initialForm w P + Singularity.initialForm w Q

Singularity.initialForm_add_of_lt.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {P Q : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w P n →
    P ≠ 0 → ↑n < Singularity.weightedOrd w Q → Singularity.initialForm w (P + Q) = P

Singularity.initialForm_add_of_weightedO.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {P Q : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.weightedOrd w P < Singularity.weightedOrd w Q →
    Singularity.initialForm w (P + Q) = Singularity.initialForm w P

Singularity.initialForm_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.initialForm w (f * g) = Singularity.initialForm w f * Singularity.initialForm w g

Singularity.initialForm_ne_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ≠ 0 → Singularity.initialForm w f ≠ 0

Singularity.initialForm_nsmul.type:

  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {n : ℕ},
      Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n ≠ ν →
        Singularity.KeyPolynomial (Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n) (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n)

Singularity.keyPolynomial_macLaneKey.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  Singularity.MacLaneBelow ν μ → μ ≠ ν → Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ (Singularity.macLaneKey ν μ)

Singularity.keyPolynomial_of_map_le_of_n.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w f) →
    φ.Monic →
      ν φ < w φ →
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = w f) →
          ∀ {ψ : Polynomial K},
            ψ.Monic →
              ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree →
                ν ψ ≤ ν φ →
                  w ψ = w φ ∧
                    ν ψ < w ψ ∧ (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < ψ.degree → ν f = w f) ∧ Singularity.KeyPolynomial w ψ

Singularity.keyPolynomial_of_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ μ f) →
    φ.Monic → ν φ < μ φ → (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) → Singularity.KeyPolynomial μ φ

Singularity.killOutside.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.killOutside_X_of_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i : σ},
  i ∈ S → (Singularity.killOutside S) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X i

Singularity.killOutside_comp_centerChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k),
      (Singularity.killOutside S).comp (Singularity.centerChart S j t) =
        (Singularity.pointChart j fun i => if i ∈ S then t i else 0).comp (Singularity.killOutside S)

Singularity.killOutside_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.killOutside S) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) =
    if ∀ i ∈ a.support, i ∈ S then (MvPolynomial.monomial a) c else 0

Singularity.killVar.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.killVarOpt.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.killVarOpt_comp_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ),
  (Singularity.killVarOpt j).comp (MvPolynomial.rename some) = (MvPolynomial.rename some).comp (Singularity.killVar j)

Singularity.killVarOpt_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {w : σ → k},
  w j = 0 →
    (Singularity.killVarOpt j).comp (Singularity.translate w) = (Singularity.translate w).comp (Singularity.killVar j)

Singularity.killVarSwap.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.killVarSwap_comp_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ),
  (Singularity.killVarSwap i).comp (MvPolynomial.rename some) = Singularity.killVar i

Singularity.killVarSwap_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ),
  (Singularity.killVarSwap i).comp (Singularity.translate (Pi.single i 1)) = AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.killVar_chartTransform.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {m : ℕ}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f →
    (Singularity.killVar j) (Singularity.chartTransform j t m f) =
      (Singularity.chartRest j t) (∑ a ∈ f.support with Finsupp.degree a = m, (MvPolynomial.monomial a) (f.coeff a))

Singularity.killVar_comp_chartRest.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.killVar j).comp (Singularity.chartRest j t) = Singularity.chartRest j t

Singularity.killVar_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.killVar i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) = if a i = 0 then (MvPolynomial.monomial a) c else 0

Singularity.killVars.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.killVars_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (i : σ),
  (Singularity.killVars S) (MvPolynomial.X i) = if i ∈ S then 0 else MvPolynomial.X i

Singularity.krullDim_eq_natCard_sub_one.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder α] [Finite α] [Nonempty α],
  (∀ (a b : α), a ≤ b ∨ b ≤ a) → Order.krullDim α = ↑(Nat.card α - 1)

Singularity.latticeLemma.type:
∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι]
  (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ Γ) (D : Finset Γ),
  (∀ d ∈ D, 0 ≤ d) → ∃ m, (∀ (i : ι), 0 < m i) ∧ ∀ d ∈ D, ∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ (m.repr d) i

Singularity.latticeLemma_of_injective.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {G : Type u_3} [inst_2 : AddCommGroup G]
  [inst_3 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] (w : (ι → ℤ) →+ G),
  Function.Injective ⇑w →
    ∀ (E : Finset (ι → ℤ)),
      (∀ a ∈ E, 0 ≤ w a) →
        ∃ B C, B * C = 1 ∧ C * B = 1 ∧ (∀ (l : ι), 0 < w (B l)) ∧ ∀ a ∈ E, ∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ Matrix.vecMul a C l

Singularity.latticeLemma_real.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (γ : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), ∑ i, ↑(a i) * γ i = 0 → a = 0) →
    ∀ (E : Finset (ι → ℤ)),
      (∀ a ∈ E, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ↑(a i) * γ i) →
        ∃ B C,
          B * C = 1 ∧ C * B = 1 ∧ (∀ (l : ι), 0 < ∑ i, ↑(B l i) * γ i) ∧ ∀ a ∈ E, ∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ Matrix.vecMul a C l

Singularity.latticeLemma_real_of_pos.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (γ : ι → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 < γ i) →
    (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), ∑ i, ↑(a i) * γ i = 0 → a = 0) →
      ∀ (E : Finset (ι → ℤ)),
        (∀ a ∈ E, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ↑(a i) * γ i) →
          ∃ B C,
            B * C = 1 ∧ C * B = 1 ∧ (∀ (l : ι), 0 < ∑ i, ↑(B l i) * γ i) ∧ ∀ a ∈ E, ∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ Matrix.vecMul a C l

Singularity.laurentMonomial.type: {K : Type u_1} → [Field K] → {ι : Type u_2} → [Fintype ι] → (ι → K) → (ι → ℤ) → K

Singularity.laurentMonomial_add.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (a b : ι → ℤ),
      Singularity.laurentMonomial x (a + b) = Singularity.laurentMonomial x a * Singularity.laurentMonomial x b

Singularity.laurentMonomial_eq_units.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K} (hx : ∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) (a : ι → ℤ),
  Singularity.laurentMonomial x a = ↑(∏ i, Units.mk0 (x i) ⋯ ^ a i)

Singularity.laurentMonomial_natCast.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (x : ι → K) (β : ι →₀ ℕ),
  (Singularity.laurentMonomial x fun i => ↑(β i)) = ∏ i, x i ^ β i

Singularity.laurentMonomial_ne_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) → ∀ (a : ι → ℤ), Singularity.laurentMonomial x a ≠ 0

Singularity.laurentMonomial_single.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (x : ι → K) (i : ι),
  Singularity.laurentMonomial x (Pi.single i 1) = x i

Singularity.laurentMonomial_sub.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (a b : ι → ℤ),
      Singularity.laurentMonomial x (a - b) = Singularity.laurentMonomial x a / Singularity.laurentMonomial x b

Singularity.laurentMonomial_vecMul.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (n : ι → ℤ) (B : Matrix ι ι ℤ),
      Singularity.laurentMonomial x (Matrix.vecMul n B) =
        Singularity.laurentMonomial (fun l => Singularity.laurentMonomial x (B l)) n

Singularity.laurentMonomial_zero.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (x : ι → K), Singularity.laurentMonomial x 0 = 1

Singularity.le_augmentedValuationFun.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      ∀ (f : Polynomial K) (j : ℕ),
        μ (Singularity.expansionCoeff φ f j) * γ ^ j ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f

Singularity.le_awaySaturation.type: ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing B] (𝔞 : Ideal B) (g : B), 𝔞 ≤ Singularity.awaySaturation 𝔞 g

Singularity.le_card_rootSet_of_separable.type:
∀ {F : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra F L] {q : Polynomial F},
  q.Separable →
    (Polynomial.map (algebraMap F L) q).Splits → ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≤ q.natDegree → n ≤ Fintype.card ↑(q.rootSet L)

Singularity.le_centerSubring.type: ∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} (R : Subring K), R ≤ Singularity.centerSubring V R

Singularity.le_coarsening.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ), V ≤ Singularity.coarsening V H

Singularity.le_coarseningSubring.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ),
  V.toSubring ≤ Singularity.coarseningSubring V H

Singularity.le_degree_of_mem_support.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {m : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∀ {a : σ →₀ ℕ}, a ∈ f.support → m ≤ Finsupp.degree a

Singularity.le_derivIdeal.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)), I ≤ Singularity.derivIdeal I

Singularity.le_directrix_homogeneousComp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)} {n : ℕ},
  (∀ s ∈ S, ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord s) →
    ∀ {W : Submodule k (σ → k)},
      (∀ s ∈ S, W ≤ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) s)) →
        ∀ {f : MvPolynomial σ k}, f ∈ Ideal.span S → W ≤ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n) f)

Singularity.le_directrix_of_mem_span.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {W : Submodule k (σ → k)} {S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  (∀ s ∈ S, W ≤ Singularity.directrix s) →
    ∀ {F : MvPolynomial σ k}, F ∈ Submodule.span k S → W ≤ Singularity.directrix F

Singularity.le_divisorExponent.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {N : σ →₀ ℕ},
  P ≠ 0 → (∀ i ∉ Δ, N i = 0) → (∀ β ∈ P.support, N ≤ β) → N ≤ Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P

Singularity.le_divisorExponent_apply_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [DecidableEq σ] [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k},
  P ≠ 0 → ∀ {i : σ}, i ∈ Δ → ∀ {n : ℕ}, (∀ β ∈ P.support, n ≤ β i) → n ≤ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ P) i

Singularity.le_divisorExponent_of_logJac.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ∀ {s : σ →₀ ℕ},
        (∀ i ∉ Δ, s i = 0) →
          Singularity.logJacobian Δ g ≤ Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial s) 1} → s ≤ Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g

Singularity.le_height_isMaximal_mvPolyno.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (n : ℕ) (M : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) [M.IsMaximal], ↑n ≤ M.height

Singularity.le_idealOrd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ f ∈ I, n ≤ Singularity.ord f) → n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I

Singularity.le_idealOrd_derivIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I → ↑(n - 1) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal I)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_derivIdeal_itera.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} {m : ℕ},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I → ∀ (l : ℕ), ↑(m - l) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal^[l] I)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iSup_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_3} (I : ι → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) (n : ℕ),
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (⨆ j, I j) ↔ ∀ (j : ι), ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (I j)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iSup_pow_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type u_3}
  (B : ι → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) (c : ι → ℕ) {N : ℕ},
  1 ≤ N →
    (∀ (j : ι), c j ∣ N) →
      (↑N ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (⨆ j, B j ^ (N / c j)) ↔ ∀ (j : ι), ↑(c j) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (B j))

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I ↔ I ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iff_le_idealOrd_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] [CharZero k] (h : σ) (m : ℕ)
  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)),
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I ↔
    ↑m.factorial ≤
      Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.map (Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) (Singularity.coefficientIdeal m I))

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] {m s : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    m ∣ s →
      0 < s →
        ∀ (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)),
          ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I ↔ ↑s ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.tuningIdeal m s I)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iff_one_le_ideal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [Fintype σ] [CharZero k] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m → (↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I ↔ 1 ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.derivIdeal^[m - 1] I))

Singularity.le_idealOrd_iff_restrict_der.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] [CharZero k] (h : σ) (m : ℕ)
  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)),
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I ↔
    ∀ j < m,
      ↑(m - j) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.map (Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) (Singularity.derivIdeal^[j] I))

Singularity.le_idealOrd_logJacobianTange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord g → ↑n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)),
  Singularity.idealOrd I + Singularity.idealOrd J ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (I * J)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_of_restrict_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] [CharZero k] (h : σ) (m : ℕ)
  (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) (T : ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)),
  (∀ j < m, ↑(m - j) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (T j)) →
    (∀ l < m,
        Ideal.map (Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) (Singularity.derivIdeal^[l] I) ≤
          ⨆ j ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), Singularity.derivIdeal^[l - j] (T j)) →
      ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I

Singularity.le_idealOrd_span.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {S : Set (MvPolynomial σ k)} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ s ∈ S, n ≤ Singularity.ord s) → n ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.span S)

Singularity.le_idealOrd_sup_pow_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] {m s : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    1 ≤ s →
      ∀ (N I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)),
        ↑(m * s) ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (N ^ m ⊔ I ^ s) ↔ ↑s ≤ Singularity.idealOrd N ∧ ↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I

Singularity.le_linWeight_of_subset.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P Q : Set (σ → ℝ)},
  P ⊆ Q → ∀ (w : σ → ℝ) {c : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ Q, c ≤ Singularity.linWeight w x) → ∀ x ∈ P, c ≤ Singularity.linWeight w x

Singularity.le_linWeight_projPolyhedron_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k))
  {w : σ → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : σ), 0 ≤ w j) →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ Singularity.projPolyhedron f, c ≤ Singularity.linWeight w x) ↔
        ∀ (i : ℕ),
          1 ≤ i →
            i ≤ f.natDegree →
              ∀ (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
                (MvPowerSeries.coeff a) (f.coeff (f.natDegree - i)) ≠ 0 →
                  ↑i * c ≤ Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a)

Singularity.le_logJacobianDirectrix.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {W : Submodule k (σ → k)},
  (∀ ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrixSet Δ g,
      W ≤ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g).toNat) ψ)) →
    W ≤ Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix Δ g

Singularity.le_logJacobianFullDirectrix.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {W : Submodule k (σ → k)},
  (∀ ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrixSet Δ g,
      W ≤ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent (Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g).toNat) ψ)) →
    W ≤ Singularity.logJacobianFullDirectrix Δ g

Singularity.le_monomialValuationFun.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f : Polynomial K) (i : ℕ), v (f.coeff i) * γ ^ i ≤ Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f

Singularity.le_monomialWeight_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  {γ : σ → Γ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {c : WithTop Γ},
  c ≤ Singularity.monomialWeight γ f ↔ ∀ (a : σ →₀ ℕ), f.coeff a ≠ 0 → c ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight γ) a)

Singularity.le_nonmonoPart.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (t : R) (B : Ideal R), B ≤ Singularity.nonmonoPart t B

Singularity.le_of_mem_support_monomial_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {N β : σ →₀ ℕ} {Q : MvPolynomial σ k},
  β ∈ ((MvPolynomial.monomial N) 1 * Q).support → N ≤ β

Singularity.le_of_mem_support_of_pointCh.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {q d : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.ord (F.divMonomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) = ↑d →
    q ≤ Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ q * F' →
        ∀ {β : σ →₀ ℕ},
          β ∈ F'.support →
            (fun₀ | j => Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d - q) +
                Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) ≤
              β

Singularity.le_of_mul_pow_le_mul_pow.type: ∀ (k d N₀ : ℕ) (C A : ℝ), 0 < C → (∀ (N : ℕ), N₀ ≤ N → C * ↑N ^ k ≤ A * ↑N ^ d) → k ≤ d

Singularity.le_of_ofPrime_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {P : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime],
  LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring → A ≤ V.toSubring

Singularity.le_of_strictMono.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] {r : ℕ},
  Module.rank ℚ (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ (Additive G)) = ↑r →
    ∀ (t : ℕ) (f : Fin (t + 1) → Subgroup G),
      StrictMono f → (∀ (i : Fin (t + 1)), Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup (f i)) → t ≤ r

Singularity.le_ordAlong.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {n : ℕ∞}, (∀ d ∈ f.support, n ≤ ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)) → n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f

Singularity.le_ordAlong_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {n : ℕ∞}, n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f → n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S g → n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (f + g)

Singularity.le_ordAlong_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {n : ℕ∞}, n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f ↔ ∀ d ∈ f.support, n ≤ ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)

Singularity.le_ordAlong_iff_mem_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Nontrivial R] {S : Finset σ}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ}, ↑n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f ↔ f ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ n

Singularity.le_ordAlong_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ)
  (f g : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ordAlong S f + Singularity.ordAlong S g ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (f * g)

Singularity.le_ordAtPoint_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {a : σ → k} {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ordAtPoint a f ↔ f ∈ Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a n

Singularity.le_ordAtPoint_of_mem_varsIde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {S : Finset σ} {r : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ r → ∀ {a : σ → k}, (∀ i ∈ S, a i = 0) → ↑r ≤ Singularity.ordAtPoint a f

Singularity.le_ord_X_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ∞},
  n ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∀ (m : σ), n ≤ Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X m * f)

Singularity.le_ord_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  n ≤ Singularity.ord f → n ≤ Singularity.ord g → n ≤ Singularity.ord (f + g)

Singularity.le_ord_classicalF.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ} {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
  (∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑j ≤ Singularity.ord (a j)) → ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.classicalF m a)

Singularity.le_ord_classicalF_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ} {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.classicalF m a) ↔ ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑j ≤ Singularity.ord (a j)

Singularity.le_ord_coeff_of_le_ord_class.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ} {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.classicalF m a) → ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑j ≤ Singularity.ord (a j)

Singularity.le_ord_homogeneousComponent.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (m : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f)

Singularity.le_ord_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord f ↔ ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), Finsupp.degree d < n → f.coeff d = 0

Singularity.le_ord_iff_mem_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord f ↔ f ∈ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ^ n

Singularity.le_ord_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f + Singularity.ord g ≤ Singularity.ord (f * g)

Singularity.le_ord_of_hyperplaneRestrict.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] [CharZero k] (h : σ) (m : ℕ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (∀ j < m, ↑(m - j) ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) ((⇑(MvPolynomial.pderiv h))^[j] f))) →
    ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f

Singularity.le_ord_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {G : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  ↑d ≤ Singularity.ord G → ∀ (j : σ), ↑(d - 1) ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G)

Singularity.le_ord_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ),
  n • Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord (f ^ n)

Singularity.le_ord_smul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (a : R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord (a • f)

Singularity.le_ord_smul_add_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {G : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  ↑d ≤ Singularity.ord G →
    ∀ (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (i : σ), ↑d ≤ Singularity.ord (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
    ∀ {i : σ},
      i ∈ Δ →
        ↑d ≤
          Singularity.ord
            (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
              MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))

Singularity.le_ord_translate_zMonic_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ},
  IsUnit ↑m →
    ∀ {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
      a (m - 1) = 0 →
        ∀ (b : Option σ → R),
          ↑m ≤
              Singularity.ord
                ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a)) ↔
            b none = 0 ∧
              ∀ i < m,
                ↑(m - i) ≤
                  Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun l => MvPolynomial.X l + MvPolynomial.C (b (some l))) (a i))

Singularity.le_ord_zMonic_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m : ℕ} {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.zMonic m a) ↔ ∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a i)

Singularity.le_pow_iff_tuningIdeal_le_po.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] {m s : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    m ∣ s →
      0 < s →
        ∀ (S : Finset σ) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)),
          I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ m ↔ Singularity.tuningIdeal m s I ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ s

Singularity.le_span_pow_divOrd.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {t : R} {I : Ideal R},
  Singularity.HasDivOrd t I → I ≤ Ideal.span {t ^ Singularity.divOrd t I}

Singularity.le_weightedOrd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → f.coeff d = 0) → n ≤ Singularity.weightedOrd w f

Singularity.length_ker_eq_length_quotien.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {Q : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Q] [inst_2 : Module R Q],
  Module.length R Q ≠ ⊤ → ∀ (f : Q →ₗ[R] Q), Module.length R ↥f.ker = Module.length R (Q ⧸ f.range)

Singularity.length_quotient_smul_eq_add_.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (N : Submodule R M)
  (h : R), IsSMulRegular M h → Module.length R (M ⧸ h • N) = Module.length R (M ⧸ N) + Module.length R (M ⧸ h • ⊤)

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (N : Submodule R M)
  (h : R), Module.length R (M ⧸ h • N) = Module.length R (↥N ⧸ h • ⊤) + Module.length R (M ⧸ N)

Singularity.length_quotient_smul_eq_of_f.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {M : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (N : Submodule R M)
  (h : R), IsSMulRegular M h → Module.length R (M ⧸ N) ≠ ⊤ → Module.length R (↥N ⧸ h • ⊤) = Module.length R (M ⧸ h • ⊤)

Singularity.length_quotient_span_pair_eq.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] {f g : R},
  Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g}) = 0 ↔ IsUnit f ∨ IsUnit g

Singularity.length_quotient_span_pair_mu.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {f g₁ g₂ : R},
  (∀ (c : R), f ∣ g₁ * c → f ∣ c) →
    Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g₁ * g₂}) =
      Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g₁}) + Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g₂})

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] {f g₁ g₂ : R},
  f ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (p : R), Prime p → p ∣ f → p ∣ g₁ → False) →
      Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g₁ * g₂}) =
        Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g₁}) + Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g₂})

Singularity.lie_mem_stableDerivations.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B] {I : Ideal B}
  {δ δ' : Derivation k B B},
  δ ∈ Singularity.stableDerivations k I →
    δ' ∈ Singularity.stableDerivations k I → ⁅δ, δ'⁆ ∈ Singularity.stableDerivations k I

Singularity.lie_mem_tangentDerivations.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B] {G : Set B}
  {δ δ' : Derivation k B B},
  δ ∈ Singularity.tangentDerivations k G →
    δ' ∈ Singularity.tangentDerivations k G → ⁅δ, δ'⁆ ∈ Singularity.tangentDerivations k G

Singularity.lie_pderiv_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [DecidableEq σ] (i j : σ),
  ⁅MvPolynomial.pderiv i, MvPolynomial.pderiv j⁆ = 0

Singularity.linWeight.type: {σ : Type u_1} → [Fintype σ] → (σ → ℝ) → (σ → ℝ) → ℝ

Singularity.linWeight_expToReal_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (w : σ → ℝ) (a b : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal (a + b)) =
    Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a) + Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal b)

Singularity.linWeight_nonneg.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {w x : σ → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : σ), 0 ≤ w j) → x ∈ Singularity.orthant σ → 0 ≤ Singularity.linWeight w x

Singularity.linWeight_one_expToReal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.linWeight (fun x => 1) (Singularity.expToReal a) = ↑(∑ j, a j)

Singularity.linWeight_single.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (x : σ → ℝ),
  Singularity.linWeight (Pi.single j 1) x = x j

Singularity.linearChange.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → [Fintype σ] → Matrix σ σ R → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R

Singularity.linearChange_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R) (i : σ),
  (Singularity.linearChange A) (MvPolynomial.X i) = ∑ j, MvPolynomial.C (A i j) * MvPolynomial.X j

Singularity.linearChange_linearChange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (A B : Matrix σ σ R)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.linearChange A) ((Singularity.linearChange B) f) = (Singularity.linearChange (B * A)) f

Singularity.linearChange_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ]
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R), (Singularity.linearChange 1) f = f

Singularity.linearIndependent_and_disjoi.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₁ : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) {ι : Type u_5} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i => Additive.ofMul ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i))) ∧
      Disjoint (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup
        (Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun i => (Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))

Singularity.linearIndependent_logDerivat.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ),
  LinearIndependent (MvPolynomial σ k) (Singularity.logDerivation Δ)

Singularity.linearIndependent_of_linearI.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (V : ValuationSubring K)
  {E : IntermediateField k K} {F : Type u_3} [inst_3 : Field F] [inst_4 : Algebra F (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)],
  (∀ (c : ↥E) (hc : ↑c ∈ V), ∃ f, (algebraMap F (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)) f = (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) ⟨↑c, hc⟩) →
    ∀ {m : Type u_4} [Fintype m] {z : m → ↥V},
      (LinearIndependent F fun i => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (z i)) → LinearIndependent ↥E fun i => ↑(z i)

Singularity.linearIndependent_of_residue.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {E' : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field E'] [inst_2 : Algebra E E'] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
  (v₀ : Valuation E Γ₀) (v : Valuation E' Γ) [inst_5 : v₀.HasExtension v] {ι : Type u_5} (b : ι → ↥v.valuationSubring),
  (LinearIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥v₀.valuationSubring) fun i =>
      (IsLocalRing.residue ↥v.valuationSubring) (b i)) →
    LinearIndependent E fun i => ↑(b i)

Singularity.linearIndependent_of_valuati.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (V : ValuationSubring K)
  {E : IntermediateField k K} {m : Type u_3} [Fintype m] {z : m → K},
  (∀ (i : m), z i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (i j : m) (c d : ↥E), c ≠ 0 → d ≠ 0 → V.valuation (↑c * z i) = V.valuation (↑d * z j) → i = j) →
      LinearIndependent (↥E) z

Singularity.linearIndependent_taylorMono.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (δ : ι → Derivation k A A) (y : ι → A) (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  [CharP A p],
  (∀ (j l : ι), (δ j) (y l) = if j = l then 1 else 0) →
    LinearIndependent ↥(Singularity.constants δ) fun c => Singularity.taylorMonomial y fun l => ↑(c l)

Singularity.linearIndependent_valuation_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {ι : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (V : ValuationSubring K) {x : ι → K}
  (hx0 : ∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i => Additive.ofMul ((Units.map ↑V.valuation) (Units.mk0 (x i) ⋯))) ↔
    ∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0

Singularity.linearPartAt.type: {ι : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → [Fintype ι] → (ι → R) → MvPolynomial ι R → MvPolynomial ι R

Singularity.linearPartAt_mem.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (x : ι → R) (f : MvPolynomial ι R),
  Singularity.linearPartAt x f ∈ Singularity.pointIdeal x

Singularity.localPoint.type:

  {Δ S : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k}

                                    Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p]

                  ∃ q ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ s, f = (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * q) →
                ∀ {q : MvPolynomial σ k},

                        Singularity.cleanPart p g' ≠ 0 ∧
                          Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t)
                              (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                            ↑ρ

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {τ : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = ↑τ →
              ∀ {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
                f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                  ∀ {n : ℕ∞},
                    Singularity.ord ((Singularity.pointChart j t) f) ≤
                        ↑(τ + Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g))) + n →
                      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤ n

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {τ : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = ↑τ →
              ∀ {f ψ' : MvPolynomial σ k},
                f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                  (Singularity.pointChart j t) f =
                      MvPolynomial.X j ^ τ *
                        ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g))) 1 *
                          (Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) * ψ')) →
                    Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                      Singularity.ord ψ'

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                  Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m →
                    Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ) = ⊥ →
                      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') < ↑m

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)

  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →

            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + m + 1) →
              ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g →
                  Singularity.ord ψ = ↑m →
                    Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ) = ⊥ →
                      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') < ↑m

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              ∀ {ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
                ψ ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobianCaseIdeal Δ g →
                  Singularity.chartVector j t ∉ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) ψ) →
                    Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') < ↑m

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_eq_idealOrd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g = 0 →
    Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g)

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_eq_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    ∀ {d : ℕ},
      Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
        (Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d ↔
          ∀ j ∉ Δ, (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) = 0)

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_eq_or.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g ∨
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1 = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_eq_zero_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    (Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0 ↔
      (MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≠ 0 ∧
          ∃ i ∈ Δ, ¬p ∣ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) ∨
        MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = 0 ∧
          ∃ j ∉ Δ, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ≠ 0)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0 ↔
    (∃ i ∈ Δ,
        ↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) * MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≠ 0) ∨
      ∃ j ∉ Δ, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ≠ 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    (Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0 ↔
      (Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = 0 ∧ ∃ i ∈ Δ, ¬p ∣ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) ∨
        Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = 1 ∧
          ∃ j ∉ Δ, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ≠ 0)

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_eq_zero_of_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {j : σ},
  j ∉ Δ →
    MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ≠ 0 →
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {i : σ}, i ∈ Δ → ¬p ∣ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i → Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_eq_zero_typ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = 0 →
      Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0 ∧
        MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≠ 0 ∧
          ∃ i ∈ Δ, ¬p ∣ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_le_of_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} (p : ℕ) [CharP k p],
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ∀ {b : σ →₀ ℕ},
        (∀ i ∉ Δ, b i = 0) →
          Singularity.logJacobian Δ g ≤ Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1} →
            ∀ {φ : MvPolynomial σ k},
              φ ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g →
                ∀ {n : ℕ∞}, Singularity.ord φ ≤ ↑(Finsupp.degree b) + n → Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ≤ n

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_le_ord_of_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g →
    Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ≤ Singularity.ord ψ

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_le_residual.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ≤ Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k} {g F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), ψ (φ h) = h) →
    (∀ l ∈ Δ, ∃ c, φ (MvPolynomial.X l) = MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X l) →
      (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
        (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (ψ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
          g ≠ 0 →
            Singularity.IsClean p g →
              Singularity.logJacobian Δ F = Ideal.map φ (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g) →
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ≤ Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p F

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_lt_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) = ↑d →
    (Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g < ↑d ↔
      ∃ j ∉ Δ, (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ≠ 0)

Singularity.logJacobianOrder_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ), Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ 0 = ⊤

Singularity.logJacobianSeries.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → MvPowerSeries σ k → Ideal (MvPowerSeries σ k)

Singularity.logJacobianSeries_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (Δ : Finset σ) (g h : MvPowerSeries σ k),
  Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ (g + h ^ p) = Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ g

Singularity.logJacobianSeries_coe.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ ↑g = Ideal.map MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g)

Singularity.logJacobianSeries_mul_of_pde.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) {u : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (i : σ), (MvPowerSeries.pderiv i) u = 0) →
    ∀ (g : MvPowerSeries σ k),
      Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ (u * g) = Ideal.span {u} * Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ g

Singularity.logJacobianSeries_pow_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (Δ : Finset σ) (u g : MvPowerSeries σ k),
  Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ (u ^ p * g) = Ideal.span {u ^ p} * Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ g

Singularity.logJacobianSeries_pow_mul_co.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (Δ : Finset σ) {u : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  IsUnit u →
    ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
      Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ (u ^ p * ↑g) =
        Ideal.map MvPolynomial.coeToMvPowerSeries.ringHom (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g)

Singularity.logJacobianSeries_pow_mul_of.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (Δ : Finset σ) {u : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff u ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (g : MvPowerSeries σ k), Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ (u ^ p * g) = Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ g

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (Δ : Finset σ) {u : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  IsUnit u → ∀ (g : MvPowerSeries σ k), Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ (u ^ p * g) = Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ g

Singularity.logJacobianTangent.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.logJacobianTangent_eq_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g =
    Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1} *
      Singularity.residualLogJacobianTangent Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.logJacobianTangent_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g ≤ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g

Singularity.logJacobianTangent_monomial_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
    ∀ (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
      Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) =
        Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1} * Singularity.residualLogJacobianTangent Δ r G

Singularity.logJacobianType.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → Finset σ → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.logJacobianType_cleanPart_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) p g' =
              Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g + 1 →
