Singularity.map_pointChart_zero_logJacob.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  t j = 0 →
    (Singularity.pointChart j 0) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
      Ideal.map (Singularity.pointChart j 0) (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) ≤
        Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X j ^ p} * Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) g'

Singularity.map_pow_idealOfVars_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
    ∀ (n : ℕ), Ideal.map φ (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ k ^ n) ≤ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ k ^ n

Singularity.map_ringEquiv_eq_of_le.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (e : A ≃+* A) {I : Ideal A},
  Ideal.map e I ≤ I → Ideal.map e I = I

Singularity.map_span_monomial_eq_of_adap.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), ψ (φ h) = h) →
    (∀ l ∈ Δ, ∃ c, φ (MvPolynomial.X l) = MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X l) →
      ∀ (s : σ →₀ ℕ),
        (∀ i ∉ Δ, s i = 0) →
          Ideal.map φ (Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial s) 1}) = Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial s) 1}

Singularity.map_sub_le_of_map_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
      ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → ν φ ≤ ν ψ → μ (ψ - φ) ≤ ν ψ

Singularity.map_translateBy_logJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [DecidableEq σ] {Δ : Finset σ} {t : σ → k},
  (∀ i ∈ Δ, t i = 0) →
    ∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
      Ideal.map (Singularity.translateBy t) (Singularity.logJacobian Δ h) =
        Singularity.logJacobian Δ ((Singularity.translateBy t) h)

Singularity.map_translateBy_neg_map_poin.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k},
  t j = 0 →
    ∀ (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)),
      Ideal.map (Singularity.translateBy (-t)) (Ideal.map (Singularity.pointChart j t) I) =
        Ideal.map (Singularity.pointChart j 0) I

Singularity.map_translateBy_neg_span_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  t j = 0 →
    ∀ (a : MvPolynomial σ k),
      Ideal.map (Singularity.translateBy (-t))
          (Ideal.span {a} *
            Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) ((Singularity.translateBy t) g')) =
        Ideal.span {(Singularity.translateBy (-t)) a} * Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) g'

Singularity.markedTransform.type:
{P : Type u_1} →
  {Q : Type u_2} →
    {F : Type u_3} → [inst : CommRing P] → [inst_1 : CommRing Q] → [FunLike F P Q] → F → Q → ℕ → Ideal P → Ideal Q

Singularity.markedTransform_eq_of_map_eq.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  [IsDomain Q] {φ : F} {x : Q},
  x ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal P} {T : Ideal Q},
      Ideal.map φ I = Ideal.span {x ^ m} * T → Singularity.markedTransform φ x m I = T

Singularity.markedTransform_iSup_pow.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  [RingHomClass F P Q] [IsDomain Q] {ι : Type u_4} {φ : F} {x : Q},
  x ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (B : ι → Ideal P) (c : ι → ℕ) {N : ℕ},
      (∀ (i : ι), c i ∣ N) →
        (∀ (i : ι), Ideal.map φ (B i) ≤ Ideal.span {x ^ c i}) →
          Singularity.markedTransform φ x N (⨆ i, B i ^ (N / c i)) =
            ⨆ i, Singularity.markedTransform φ x (c i) (B i) ^ (N / c i)

Singularity.markedTransform_le_of_mark_l.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  [IsDomain Q] {φ : F} {x : Q},
  x ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {a a' : ℕ},
      a' ≤ a →
        ∀ {A : Ideal P},
          Ideal.map φ A ≤ Ideal.span {x ^ a} →
            Singularity.markedTransform φ x a' A ≤ Singularity.markedTransform φ x a A

Singularity.markedTransform_mono.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  (φ : F) (x : Q) (a : ℕ) {A B : Ideal P},
  A ≤ B → Singularity.markedTransform φ x a A ≤ Singularity.markedTransform φ x a B

Singularity.markedTransform_mul.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  [RingHomClass F P Q] [IsDomain Q] {φ : F} {x : Q},
  x ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {a b : ℕ} {A B : Ideal P},
      Ideal.map φ A ≤ Ideal.span {x ^ a} →
        Ideal.map φ B ≤ Ideal.span {x ^ b} →
          Singularity.markedTransform φ x (a + b) (A * B) =
            Singularity.markedTransform φ x a A * Singularity.markedTransform φ x b B

Singularity.markedTransform_of_mark_le.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  [IsDomain Q] {φ : F} {x : Q},
  x ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {a a' : ℕ},
      a' ≤ a →
        ∀ {A : Ideal P},
          Ideal.map φ A ≤ Ideal.span {x ^ a} →
            Singularity.markedTransform φ x a' A = Ideal.span {x ^ (a - a')} * Singularity.markedTransform φ x a A

Singularity.markedTransform_pow.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  [RingHomClass F P Q] [IsDomain Q] {φ : F} {x : Q},
  x ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {a : ℕ} {A : Ideal P},
      Ideal.map φ A ≤ Ideal.span {x ^ a} →
        ∀ (e : ℕ), Singularity.markedTransform φ x (a * e) (A ^ e) = Singularity.markedTransform φ x a A ^ e

Singularity.markedTransform_sup.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  [RingHomClass F P Q] [IsDomain Q] {φ : F} {x : Q},
  x ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {a : ℕ} {A B : Ideal P},
      Ideal.map φ A ≤ Ideal.span {x ^ a} →
        Ideal.map φ B ≤ Ideal.span {x ^ a} →
          Singularity.markedTransform φ x a (A ⊔ B) =
            Singularity.markedTransform φ x a A ⊔ Singularity.markedTransform φ x a B

Singularity.maximalContactCoord.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → {m : ℕ} → IsUnit ↑m → (ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) R

Singularity.maximalContact_change.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
  {I B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)},
  B * Singularity.derivIdeal I ≤ I →
    ∀ {j : σ} {c : MvPolynomial σ K},
      c ∈ B →
        ∀ (φ : MvPolynomial σ K ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial σ K),
          φ (MvPolynomial.X j) = MvPolynomial.X j + c →
            (∀ (i : σ), i ≠ j → φ (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X i) →
              Ideal.map φ I = I ∧
                Ideal.map φ (Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X j}) = Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X j + c} ∧
                  (∀ (i : σ), i ≠ j → Ideal.map φ (Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X i}) = Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X i}) ∧
                    ∀ (r : MvPolynomial σ K), φ r - r ∈ B

Singularity.maximalContact_coefficientId.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] [CharZero k] {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} {h : σ},
      MvPolynomial.X h ∈ Singularity.derivIdeal^[m - 1] I →
        (∀ (a : σ → k), (∀ f ∈ I, ↑m ≤ Singularity.ordAtPoint a f) → a h = 0) ∧
          (↑m ≤ Singularity.idealOrd I ↔
            ↑m.factorial ≤
              Singularity.idealOrd (Ideal.map (Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) (Singularity.coefficientIdeal m I)))

Singularity.maximalContact_small_multipl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (hm : IsUnit ↑m) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) (b : Option σ → R),
      Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a)) ≤
          ↑m ∧
        (Singularity.ord
              ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a)) =
            ↑m →
          (MvPolynomial.eval b) (Singularity.maximalContactCoord hm a) = 0)

Singularity.mem_alongIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ∞}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, f ∈ Singularity.alongIdeal S n ↔ n ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S f

Singularity.mem_awaySaturation.type: ∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing B] {𝔞 : Ideal B} {g b : B}, b ∈ Singularity.awaySaturation 𝔞 g ↔ ∃ k, g ^ k * b ∈ 𝔞

Singularity.mem_awaySaturation_iff_algeb.type:
∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing B] {𝔞 : Ideal B} {g b : B},
  b ∈ Singularity.awaySaturation 𝔞 g ↔
    (algebraMap (B ⧸ 𝔞) (Localization.Away ((Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔞) g))) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔞) b) = 0

Singularity.mem_awaySaturation_of_mul_me.type:
∀ {B : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing B] {𝔞 : Ideal B} {g b : B},
  g * b ∈ Singularity.awaySaturation 𝔞 g → b ∈ Singularity.awaySaturation 𝔞 g

Singularity.mem_blowupDivisor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {i : σ}, i ∈ Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t ↔ i = j ∨ i ∈ Δ ∧ i ≠ j ∧ t i = 0

Singularity.mem_boundedSubgroup.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [inst_2 : IsOrderedMonoid G] {a x : G},
  x ∈ Singularity.boundedSubgroup a ↔ ∃ n, |x|ₘ ≤ a ^ n

Singularity.mem_centerDegreeIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S n ↔ ∀ a ∈ f.support, n ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, a i

Singularity.mem_centerDivisor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k]
  {Δ S : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {i : σ},
  i ∈ Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t ↔ i = j ∨ i ∈ Δ ∧ i ≠ j ∧ (i ∉ S ∨ t i = 0)

Singularity.mem_centerIdeal.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {A : Subring K} {hA : A ≤ V.toSubring} {a : ↥A},
  a ∈ Singularity.centerIdeal V A hA ↔ V.valuation ↑a < 1

Singularity.mem_centerIdeal_inftyChart_i.type:
∀ (F : Type u_1) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : DecidableEq (RatFunc F)] (q : Polynomial F),
  ⟨(Polynomial.aeval RatFunc.X⁻¹) q, ⋯⟩ ∈
      Singularity.centerIdeal (RatFunc.inftyValuation F).valuationSubring (Singularity.inftyChart F) ⋯ ↔
    Polynomial.X ∣ q

Singularity.mem_centerIdeal_polynomialCh.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (P : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (Polynomial k)) (f : Polynomial k),
  ⟨(algebraMap (Polynomial k) (RatFunc k)) f, ⋯⟩ ∈
      Singularity.centerIdeal (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation (RatFunc k) P).valuationSubring
        (Singularity.polynomialChart k) ⋯ ↔
    f ∈ P.asIdeal

Singularity.mem_centerSubring.type:
∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R : Subring K} {z : K},
  z ∈ Singularity.centerSubring V R ↔ ∃ a ∈ R, ∃ c ∈ R, V.valuation c = 1 ∧ z * c = a

Singularity.mem_chartStrictTransform_iff.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {I J : Ideal R} {f : R} (b : ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)),
  b ∈ Singularity.chartStrictTransform I J f ↔ ↑b ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)) J

Singularity.mem_coarsening.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) {H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ} {x : K},
  x ∈ Singularity.coarsening V H ↔ ∃ h ∈ H, V.valuation x ≤ ↑h

Singularity.mem_coarseningSubring.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) {H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ} {x : K},
  x ∈ Singularity.coarseningSubring V H ↔ ∃ h ∈ H, V.valuation x ≤ ↑h

Singularity.mem_coarsening_and_inv_mem_i.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) {H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ},
  Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup H →
    ∀ {x : K}, x ≠ 0 → (x ∈ Singularity.coarsening V H ∧ x⁻¹ ∈ Singularity.coarsening V H ↔ ∃ γ ∈ H, V.valuation x = ↑γ)

Singularity.mem_comap_adjoin_sumElim_of_.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4}
  {V : ValuationSubring K} [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {x : ι → K} {y : κ → ↥V},
  (AlgebraicIndependent k fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y j)) →
    ∀
      c ∈
        IntermediateField.adjoin k
          (Set.range fun j => Singularity.adjoinRangeElem k (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j)) (Sum.inr j)),
      c ∈ V.comap (algebraMap (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j))))) K)

Singularity.mem_comap_of_derivation_eq.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra R T] {S : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : CommRing S] (φ : S →+* T) (D : Derivation R T T) (M : Ideal T) [inst_4 : M.IsPrime] {p : ℕ},
  2 ≤ p →
    ∀ {h : T} {f' : S},
      (algebraMap T (Localization.AtPrime M)) h ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime M) ^ p →
        D h = φ f' → f' ∈ Ideal.comap φ M

Singularity.mem_comap_of_derivation_eq_n.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommRing T] [inst_2 : Algebra R T] {S : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : CommRing S] (φ : S →+* T) (D : Derivation R T T) (M : Ideal T) [inst_4 : M.IsPrime] {p : ℕ},
  2 ≤ p →
    ∀ {h : T} {f' : S},
      (algebraMap T (Localization.AtPrime M)) h ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime M) ^ p →
        D h = -φ f' → f' ∈ Ideal.comap φ M

Singularity.mem_comap_of_mem_adjoin.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {κ : Type u_4}
  {V : ValuationSubring K} {K₀ : IntermediateField k K} {y : κ → ↥K₀},
  (∀ c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun j => ↑(y j)), c ∈ V) →
    ∀ c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range y), c ∈ V.comap (algebraMap (↥K₀) K)

Singularity.mem_constantsOn.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  {δ : ι → Derivation k A A} {T : Set ι} {a : A}, a ∈ Singularity.constantsOn δ T ↔ ∀ l ∈ T, (δ l) a = 0

Singularity.mem_derivationIdeal.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B]
  {M : Submodule B (Derivation k B B)} {f x : B}, x ∈ Singularity.derivationIdeal k M f ↔ ∃ δ ∈ M, δ f = x

Singularity.mem_directrixPolys_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {v : σ → k} {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  F ∈ Singularity.directrixPolys v ↔ v ∈ Singularity.directrix F

Singularity.mem_directrix_X_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {i : σ} {w : σ → k},
  w ∈ Singularity.directrix (MvPolynomial.X i) ↔ w i = 0

Singularity.mem_directrix_X_pow_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {i : σ} {n : ℕ},
  n ≠ 0 → ∀ {w : σ → k}, w ∈ Singularity.directrix (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n) ↔ w i = 0

Singularity.mem_directrix_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {v : σ → k},
  v ∈ Singularity.directrix g ↔ (Singularity.translate v) g = (MvPolynomial.rename some) g

Singularity.mem_directrix_killVar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {w : σ → k},
  w j = 0 →
    ∀ {F : MvPolynomial σ k}, w ∈ Singularity.directrix F → w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((Singularity.killVar j) F)

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_isHomogeneo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {m : ℕ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g.IsHomogeneous m →
    ((Singularity.chartRest j t) g).IsHomogeneous m → Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix g

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_le_ord_poin.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' →
      ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f' →
        Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f)

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_mem_directr.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t w : σ → k},
  w j = 0 →
    ∀ {F : MvPolynomial σ k}, w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((Singularity.chartLinear j t) F) → w ∈ Singularity.directrix F

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ},
  ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' →
      ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f' →
        ∀ {w : σ → k},
          w j = 0 →
            w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f') →
              w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f)

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_mem_logJaco.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {d : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) =
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) + d) →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑d →
                Singularity.idealOrd
                      (Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) =
                    ↑(Finsupp.degree
                          (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) +
                        d) →
                  ∀ {ψ f' : MvPolynomial σ k},
                    Singularity.ord ψ = ↑d →
                      (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈
                          Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                        (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ) =
                            MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * f' →
                          f' ∈
                              Singularity.logJacobianTangent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                (Singularity.cleanPart p g') →
                            ∀ {w : σ → k},
                              w ∈
                                  Singularity.logJacobianDirectrix (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g') →
                                w j = 0 → w ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) ψ)

Singularity.mem_directrix_of_ord_pointCh.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ},
  Singularity.ord f = ↑m →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' →
      Singularity.ord f' = ↑m →
        Singularity.chartVector j t ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f)

Singularity.mem_directrix_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {F : MvPolynomial σ k} {v : σ → k},
  v ∈ Singularity.directrix F → ∀ (i : σ), v ∈ Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) F)

Singularity.mem_idealOfSubgroup.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ) (x : ↥V),
  x ∈ Singularity.idealOfSubgroup V H ↔ ∀ h ∈ H, V.valuation ↑x < ↑h

Singularity.mem_idealOfVars_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ∈ MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R ↔ MvPolynomial.constantCoeff f = 0

Singularity.mem_iff_exists_mem_of_descen.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (R : ℕ → Subring K),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ r ∈ R n, r ∈ V) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ r ∈ R n, r⁻¹ ∉ R n → V.valuation r < 1) →
      (∀ (z : K), ∃ F ∈ R 0, ∃ G ∈ R 0, G ≠ 0 ∧ z = F / G) →
        ∀ (μ : ℕ → K → K → ℕ),
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (F G : K),
              F ∈ R n →
                G ∈ R n →
                  F ≠ 0 →
                    G ≠ 0 →
                      F⁻¹ ∉ R n →
                        G⁻¹ ∉ R n →
                          ∃ F' ∈ R (n + 1), ∃ G' ∈ R (n + 1), G' ≠ 0 ∧ F / G = F' / G' ∧ μ (n + 1) F' G' < μ n F G) →
            ∀ (z : K), z ∈ V ↔ ∃ n, z ∈ R n

Singularity.mem_iff_valuation_lt_one_of_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {A : Subring K} {P : Ideal ↥A} [inst_1 : P.IsPrime] {V : ValuationSubring K},
  LocalSubring.ofPrime A P ≤ V.toLocalSubring → ∀ (a : ↥A), a ∈ P ↔ V.valuation ↑a < 1

Singularity.mem_inertiaField_iff.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {W : ValuationSubring L}
  (x : L), x ∈ Singularity.inertiaField K W ↔ ∀ σ ∈ Singularity.inertiaGroup K W, σ x = x

Singularity.mem_inertiaGroup_iff.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {W : ValuationSubring L}
  {σ : Gal(L/K)}, σ ∈ Singularity.inertiaGroup K W ↔ (∀ (x : L), σ x ∈ W ↔ x ∈ W) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, W.valuation (σ x - x) < 1

Singularity.mem_integralClosure_and_fixe.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Field L]
  [inst_3 : Algebra A L] [inst_4 : Algebra K L] (H : Subgroup Gal(L/K)) (x : L),
  (x ∈ integralClosure A L ∧ ∀ σ ∈ H, σ x = x) ↔ x ∈ IntermediateField.fixedField H ∧ IsIntegral A x

Singularity.mem_intermediateField_of_eq_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {k : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field k] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] (E : IntermediateField k K)
  {a b : K}, a = b ∨ a = b⁻¹ → b ∈ E → a ∈ E

Singularity.mem_invariantSubring.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B] [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B]
  {b : B}, b ∈ Singularity.invariantSubring G B ↔ ∀ (g : G), g • b = b

Singularity.mem_markedTransform.type:
∀ {P : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing P] [inst_1 : CommRing Q] [inst_2 : FunLike F P Q]
  {φ : F} {x : Q} {m : ℕ} {I : Ideal P} {g : Q}, g ∈ Singularity.markedTransform φ x m I ↔ x ^ m * g ∈ Ideal.map φ I

Singularity.mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_comm.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] {p : ℕ}
  [inst_3 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p] (δ : ι → Derivation k R R) [inst_5 : IsLocalRing R],
  (∀ (l : ι) (g : R), (δ l) g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →
    ∀ {χ : ι → ZMod p}, χ ≠ 0 → ∀ {g : R}, g ∈ Singularity.commonWeightSpace δ χ → g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R

Singularity.mem_maximalIdeal_of_valuatio.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {R : Type u_2} [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : IsLocalRing R] [inst_3 : Algebra R K]
  (V : ValuationSubring K) (hRV : ∀ (r : R), (algebraMap R K) r ∈ V)
  [inst_4 : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)],
  (∀ (r : R),
      (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥V)) ((IsLocalRing.residue R) r) =
        (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) ⟨(algebraMap R K) r, ⋯⟩) →
    ∀ {n : Type u_3} [inst_5 : Fintype n] {z : n → R} {j : n},
      (algebraMap R K) (z j) ≠ 0 →
        ∀ {u : n → ↥V},
          (∀ (i : n), ↑(u i) * (algebraMap R K) (z j) = (algebraMap R K) (z i)) →
            (LinearIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) fun i => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (u i)) →
              ∀ (c : n → R),
                V.valuation ((algebraMap R K) (∑ i, c i * z i)) < V.valuation ((algebraMap R K) (z j)) →
                  ∀ (i : n), c i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R

Singularity.mem_maximalIdeal_valuationSu.type:
∀ {L : Type u_5} {Γ : Type u_6} [inst : Field L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] (w : Valuation L Γ)
  (b : ↥w.valuationSubring), b ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥w.valuationSubring ↔ w ↑b < 1

Singularity.mem_nonmonoPart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {t : R} {I : Ideal R} {x : R},
  x ∈ Singularity.nonmonoPart t I ↔ t ^ Singularity.divOrd t I * x ∈ I

Singularity.mem_nonunits_coarsening_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (H : Subgroup V.ValueGroupˣ) {x : K},
  x ∈ (Singularity.coarsening V H).nonunits ↔ ∀ h ∈ H, V.valuation x < ↑h

Singularity.mem_of_mem_adjoin_residue.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K}
  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {κ : Type u_3} {y : κ → ↥V},
  (AlgebraicIndependent k fun i => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y i)) →
    ∀ {c : K}, c ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun i => ↑(y i)) → c ∈ V

Singularity.mem_of_mem_centerSubring'.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {R : Subring K},
  (∀ a ∈ R, a ∈ V) → ∀ {z : K}, z ∈ Singularity.centerSubring V R → z ∈ V

Singularity.mem_of_mem_support_of_degree.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ} {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Finsupp.degree a = n → n ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, a i → ∀ i ∈ a.support, i ∈ S

Singularity.mem_originIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.originIdeal σ k ↔ MvPolynomial.constantCoeff f = 0

Singularity.mem_pointIdeal_sq_iff.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Fintype ι] (x : ι → R) (f : MvPolynomial ι R),
  f ∈ Singularity.pointIdeal x ^ 2 ↔
    (MvPolynomial.eval x) f = 0 ∧ ∀ (i : ι), (MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f) = 0

Singularity.mem_purelyInseparableExtensi.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ)
  [inst_3 : ExpChar K p] [inst_4 : IsPurelyInseparable K L] (V : ValuationSubring K) (b : L),
  b ∈ Singularity.purelyInseparableExtension p V ↔ ∃ n, ∃ y ∈ V, (algebraMap K L) y = b ^ p ^ n

Singularity.mem_regularLocus_Spec_iff.type:
∀ (R : CommRingCat) (x : ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Spec R)),
  x ∈ Singularity.regularLocus (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec R) ↔ x ∈ Singularity.Algebra.regularLocus ↑R

Singularity.mem_regularLocus_iff_of_isAf.type:
∀ {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {U : X.Opens} (hU : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U) (x : ↥U),
  ↑x ∈ Singularity.regularLocus X ↔
    hU.primeIdealOf x ∈ Singularity.Algebra.regularLocus ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))

Singularity.mem_residualLogJacobianTange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
    ψ ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobianTangent Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.mem_residualLogJacobian_of_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g →
    ψ ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.mem_reynoldsIdeal.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B] (hG : IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G)) (I : Ideal ↥(Singularity.invariantSubring G B))
  {y : B}, y ∈ Singularity.reynoldsIdeal hG I ↔ ∀ (b : B), ⟨Singularity.reynolds hG (b * y), ⋯⟩ ∈ I

Singularity.mem_saturation_of_mul_mem_id.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {I J : Ideal R} {f : R} {b : ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)},
  (∃ k,
      (algebraMap R ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)) f ^ k * ((algebraMap R ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)) f * b) ∈
        Ideal.map (algebraMap R ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)) J) →
    ∃ k,
      (algebraMap R ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)) f ^ k * b ∈ Ideal.map (algebraMap R ↥(Singularity.idealChart I f)) J

Singularity.mem_stableDerivations.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B] {I : Ideal B}
  {δ : Derivation k B B}, δ ∈ Singularity.stableDerivations k I ↔ ∀ b ∈ I, δ b ∈ I

Singularity.mem_stableDerivations_span_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {S : Set σ}
  {δ : Derivation k (MvPolynomial σ k) (MvPolynomial σ k)},
  δ ∈ Singularity.stableDerivations k (Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' S)) ↔
    ∀ l ∈ S, δ (MvPolynomial.X l) ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' S)

Singularity.mem_subgroupOfIdeal.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) (P : Ideal ↥V) [inst_1 : P.IsPrime] (γ : V.ValueGroupˣ),
  γ ∈ Singularity.subgroupOfIdeal V P ↔ ∃ x ∉ P, V.valuation ↑x ≤ ↑γ ∧ V.valuation ↑x ≤ ↑γ⁻¹

Singularity.mem_subgroupToIntSubmodule.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] (H : Subgroup G) {y : Additive G},
  y ∈ Singularity.subgroupToIntSubmodule H ↔ Additive.toMul y ∈ H

Singularity.mem_support_initialForm.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f ≠ 0 →
    (d ∈ (Singularity.initialForm w f).support ↔ d ∈ f.support ∧ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) = Singularity.weightedOrd w f)

Singularity.mem_support_monomial_add_lef.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {a b : σ →₀ ℕ},
  a ≠ b → a ∈ ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) 1 + (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1).support

Singularity.mem_support_monomial_add_rig.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {a b : σ →₀ ℕ},
  a ≠ b → b ∈ ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) 1 + (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1).support

Singularity.mem_support_of_mem_support_c.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {q : ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {β : σ →₀ ℕ},
  β ∈ (Singularity.cleanPart q P).support → β ∈ P.support

Singularity.mem_tangentDerivations.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra k B] {G : Set B}
  {δ : Derivation k B B}, δ ∈ Singularity.tangentDerivations k G ↔ ∀ g ∈ G, ∀ b ∈ Ideal.span {g}, δ b ∈ Ideal.span {g}

Singularity.mem_valuationCenter_iff'.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K}
  {A : Subalgebra k K} {h : ∀ (a : ↥A), ↑a ∈ V} {b : ↥A}, b ∈ Singularity.valuationCenter V A h ↔ V.valuation ↑b < 1

Singularity.mem_valuationSubring_iff_of_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar K p]
  (V : ValuationSubring K) (W : ValuationSubring L),
  W.comap (algebraMap K L) = V → ∀ {b : L} {n : ℕ} {y : K}, (algebraMap K L) y = b ^ p ^ n → (b ∈ W ↔ y ∈ V)

Singularity.mem_valuationSubring_of_isIn.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {L : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra k L] {W : ValuationSubring L}
  {A : Subalgebra k L}, (∀ (a : ↥A), ↑a ∈ W) → ∀ {x : L}, IsIntegral (↥A) x → x ∈ W

Singularity.mem_valuationSubring_of_pow_.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {L : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field L]
  [inst_2 : Algebra K L] (V : ValuationSubring K) (W : ValuationSubring L),
  W.comap (algebraMap K L) = V → ∀ {x : K}, x ∈ V → ∀ {θ : L}, θ ^ p = (algebraMap K L) x → θ ∈ W

Singularity.mem_valueGroup_valuation_iff.type:
∀ {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field L] {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vL : Valuation L Γ₁)
  (γ : Γ₁ˣ), γ ∈ (↑vL).valueGroup ↔ ∃ z, vL z = ↑γ

Singularity.mem_varsIdeal_of_eval_eq_zer.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] [Infinite k] {S : Finset σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (a : σ → k), (∀ i ∈ S, a i = 0) → (MvPolynomial.eval a) f = 0) → f ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S

Singularity.mem_varsIdeal_pow_of_le_ordA.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] [CharZero k] (S : Finset σ) (r : ℕ)
  {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (a : σ → k), (∀ i ∈ S, a i = 0) → ↑r ≤ Singularity.ordAtPoint a f) → f ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ r

Singularity.mem_varsIdeal_pow_succ_of_pd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] [CharZero k] {S : Finset σ} {r : ℕ}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S →
    (∀ i ∈ S, (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ r) → f ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ (r + 1)

Singularity.mem_weightSpace.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] {p : ℕ}
  {δ : Derivation k R R} {i : ZMod p} {g : R}, g ∈ Singularity.weightSpace δ i ↔ δ g = i.cast * g

Singularity.mem_wildDecomp.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k},
  f ∈ Singularity.wildDecomp ↔
    ∃ a ∈ Singularity.wildInvariants, ∃ b ∈ Singularity.wildInvariants, f = a + b * MvPolynomial.X 1

Singularity.min_le_ordAlong_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ)
  (f g : MvPolynomial σ R), min (Singularity.ordAlong S f) (Singularity.ordAlong S g) ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (f + g)

Singularity.min_monomialWeight_le_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  (γ : σ → Γ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  min (Singularity.monomialWeight γ f) (Singularity.monomialWeight γ g) ≤ Singularity.monomialWeight γ (f + g)

Singularity.min_ord_le_ord_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  min (Singularity.ord f) (Singularity.ord g) ≤ Singularity.ord (f + g)

Singularity.minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {p : ℕ},
  Nat.Prime p →
    ∀ [CharP L p] {c : L} {a : K},
      c ^ p = (algebraMap K L) a → c ∉ Set.range ⇑(algebraMap K L) → minpoly K c = Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C a

Singularity.minpoly_eq_X_pow_sub_C_of_po.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] (p : ℕ)
  [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP E p] {y : E} {c : F},
  (algebraMap F E) c = y ^ p → y ∉ (algebraMap F E).range → minpoly F y = Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C c

Singularity.moduleFinite_integralClosure.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} {L : Type u_4} [inst : Field k] [CharZero k] [inst_2 : CommRing A]
  [IsDomain A] [inst_4 : Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [inst : Field K] [inst_5 : Algebra A K]
  [IsFractionRing A K] [inst_7 : Field L] [inst_8 : Algebra K L] [inst_9 : Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L], Module.Finite A ↥(integralClosure A L)

∀ {P : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} {L : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing P] [IsDomain P] [IsIntegrallyClosed P]
  [IsNoetherianRing P] [inst_4 : CommRing A] [inst_5 : Field F] [inst_6 : Field L] [inst_7 : Algebra P A]
  [inst_8 : Algebra P F] [IsFractionRing P F] [inst_10 : Algebra A L] [inst_11 : Algebra P L] [inst_12 : Algebra F L]
  [IsScalarTower P A L] [IsScalarTower P F L] [Module.Finite P A] [FiniteDimensional F L] [Algebra.IsSeparable F L],
  Module.Finite A ↥(integralClosure A L)

Singularity.monoPart.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → R → Ideal R → Ideal R

Singularity.monoPart_mul_nonmonoPart.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {t : R} {I : Ideal R},
  Singularity.HasDivOrd t I → Singularity.monoPart t I * Singularity.nonmonoPart t I = I

Singularity.monomialAddValuationFrac.con.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [inst_3 : IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] [inst_4 : IsDomain k] (γ γ_1 : σ → Γ),

Singularity.monomialAddValuationFrac_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]

    (Singularity.monomialAddValuationFrac γ)
        ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k))) (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      0

Singularity.monomialAddValuationFrac_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [inst_3 : IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] [inst_4 : IsDomain k] (γ : σ → Γ) (i : σ),

      ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k))) (MvPolynomial.X i)) =

Singularity.monomialAddValuationFrac_alg.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [inst_3 : IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] [inst_4 : IsDomain k] (γ : σ → Γ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.monomialAddValuationFrac γ) ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k))) f) =

Singularity.monomialAddValuationFrac_mk'.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [inst_3 : IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] [inst_4 : IsDomain k] (γ : σ → Γ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k)
  (g : ↥(nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ k))),
  (Singularity.monomialAddValuationFrac γ) (IsLocalization.mk' (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k)) f g) =
    Singularity.monomialWeight γ f - Singularity.monomialWeight γ ↑g

Singularity.monomialAddValuation_apply.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]

Singularity.monomialAddValuation_supp.type:

  [inst_3 : IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] [inst_4 : IsDomain k] (γ : σ → Γ), (Singularity.monomialAddValuation γ).supp = ⊥

Singularity.monomialStep_lt_mark.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a : ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ) [DecidableEq ι] {S A B : Finset ι},
  A ⊆ S →
    B ⊆ S →
      (∀ P ⊆ S, P.card < B.card → ∑ i ∈ P, a i < m) →
        m ≤ ∑ i ∈ B, a i → A.card + 1 < B.card → ∑ i ∈ B, a i - m + ∑ i ∈ A, a i < m

Singularity.monomialStep_lt_mu.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (a : ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ) {S A B : Finset ι},
  A ⊆ S →
    (∀ P ⊆ S, P.card < B.card → ∑ i ∈ P, a i < m) →
      m ≤ ∑ i ∈ B, a i → A.card < B.card → ∑ i ∈ B, a i - m + ∑ i ∈ A, a i < ∑ i ∈ B, a i

  [inst : Field K] →

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (a : K), Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ (Polynomial.C a) = v a

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_X.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ Polynomial.X = γ

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_add_le_.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f g : Polynomial K),
  Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ (f + g) ≤
    max (Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f) (Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ g)

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_mul.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f g : Polynomial K),
  Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ (f * g) =
    Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f * Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ g

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_mul_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f g : Polynomial K),
  Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ (f * g) ≤
    Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f * Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ g

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_one.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ 1 = 1

Singularity.monomialValuationFun_zero.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ 0 = 0

Singularity.monomialValuation_C.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (a : K), (Singularity.monomialValuation v γ) (Polynomial.C a) = v a

Singularity.monomialValuation_X.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}

Singularity.monomialValuation_apply.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} (f : Polynomial K), (Singularity.monomialValuation v γ) f = Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f

Singularity.monomialValuation_eq_zero_if.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀}, γ ≠ 0 → ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, (Singularity.monomialValuation v γ) f = 0 ↔ f = 0

Singularity.monomialWeight.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing k] → {Γ : Type u_3} → [AddCommGroup Γ] → [LinearOrder Γ] → (σ → Γ) → MvPolynomial σ k → WithTop Γ

Singularity.monomialWeight_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  (γ : σ → Γ) {c : k}, c ≠ 0 → Singularity.monomialWeight γ (MvPolynomial.C c) = 0

Singularity.monomialWeight_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [Nontrivial k] (γ : σ → Γ) (i : σ), Singularity.monomialWeight γ (MvPolynomial.X i) = ↑(γ i)

Singularity.monomialWeight_eq_top_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  {γ : σ → Γ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k}, Singularity.monomialWeight γ f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

Singularity.monomialWeight_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  {γ : σ → Γ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f.coeff a ≠ 0 → Singularity.monomialWeight γ f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight γ) a)

Singularity.monomialWeight_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] [IsDomain k] (γ : σ → Γ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.monomialWeight γ (f * g) = Singularity.monomialWeight γ f + Singularity.monomialWeight γ g

Singularity.monomialWeight_mul_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] [IsDomain k] (γ : σ → Γ) {f g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ≠ 0 → g ≠ 0 → Singularity.monomialWeight γ (f * g) ≤ Singularity.monomialWeight γ f + Singularity.monomialWeight γ g

Singularity.monomialWeight_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [Nontrivial k] (γ : σ → Γ), Singularity.monomialWeight γ 1 = 0

Singularity.monomialWeight_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  (γ : σ → Γ), Singularity.monomialWeight γ 0 = ⊤

Singularity.monomial_mem_pow_varsIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (n : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : R),
  n ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, d i → (MvPolynomial.monomial d) c ∈ Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ n

Singularity.monomial_mul_chartUnit_mul_m.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {τ : ℕ},
            Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = ↑τ →
              ∀ {f ψ' : MvPolynomial σ k},
                f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                  (Singularity.pointChart j t) f =
                      MvPolynomial.X j ^ τ *
                        ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g))) 1 *
                          (Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) * ψ')) →
                    ∀ {m : ℕ},
                      Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                        Singularity.ord ψ' = ↑m →
                          (MvPolynomial.monomial
                                  (Singularity.divisorExponent (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t)
                                    (Singularity.cleanPart p g')))
                                1 *
                              (Singularity.chartUnit j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) * ψ') ∈
                            Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

Singularity.monomial_mul_divMonomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ β ∈ P.support, r ≤ β) → (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * P.divMonomial r = P

Singularity.monomial_mul_mem_logJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g ψ : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ψ ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobianCaseIdeal Δ g →
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * ψ ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCaseIdeal Δ g

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
        ∀ {τ : ℕ},
          Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g) = ↑τ →
            ∀ {f W : MvPolynomial σ k},
              f ∈ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g →
                (Singularity.pointChart j t) f =
                    MvPolynomial.X j ^ τ *
                      ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g))) 1 *
                        W) →
                  (∀ i ∉ Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t,
                      ((fun₀ | j => τ - p) + Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) i = 0) ∧
                    Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') ≤
                        Ideal.span
                          {(MvPolynomial.monomial
                                ((fun₀ | j => τ - p) + Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)))
                              1} ∧
                      (MvPolynomial.monomial
                              ((fun₀ | j => τ - p) + Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)))
                            1 *
                          W ∈
                        Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')

Singularity.monomial_mul_residualFactor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 * Singularity.residualFactor Δ g = g

Singularity.monomial_mul_smul_add_X_mul_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {i : σ},
  i ∈ Δ →
    (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 *
        (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
          MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ∈
      Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g

Singularity.monomial_mul_sum_smul_add_X_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) 1 *
      ∑ i,
        (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) i) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
          MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) ∈
    Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g

Singularity.monomial_one_dvd_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {b : σ →₀ ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1 ∣ f ↔ ∀ a ∈ f.support, b ≤ a

Singularity.monomial_one_dvd_of_dvd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {b : σ →₀ ℕ} {u f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff u ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1 ∣ u * f → (MvPolynomial.monomial b) 1 ∣ f

Singularity.muDvd_X_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {γ : Γ₀} {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), μ f = Singularity.monomialValuationFun v γ f) →
    ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, Singularity.MuDvd μ Polynomial.X f ↔ v (f.coeff 0) < μ f

Singularity.muDvd_iff_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ μ f) →
    φ.Monic →
      ν φ < μ φ →
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
          ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, Singularity.MuDvd μ φ f ↔ ν f < μ f

Singularity.muDvd_iff_of_forall_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K} {γ : Γ₀},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      ∀ {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f = Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ γ f) →
          ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, Singularity.MuDvd ν φ f ↔ μ (f %ₘ φ) < ν f

Singularity.muDvd_mul_self.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ h : Polynomial K}, μ (φ * h) ≠ 0 → Singularity.MuDvd μ φ (φ * h)

Singularity.muDvd_of_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ : Polynomial K},
  (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ μ f) →
    φ.Monic →
      ν φ < μ φ →
        (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
          ∀ {f : Polynomial K}, ν f < μ f → Singularity.MuDvd μ φ f

Singularity.muDvd_one_one.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀}, Singularity.MuDvd μ 1 1

Singularity.muEquiv_iff_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    ν φ < μ φ →
      (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
        ψ.Monic → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree → (Singularity.MuEquiv μ φ ψ ↔ ν ψ < μ ψ)

Singularity.muEquiv_macLaneChainKey_iff.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {n : ℕ},
      Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n ≠ ν →
        ∀ {ψ : Polynomial K},
          ψ.Monic →
            ψ.natDegree = (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n).natDegree →
              (Singularity.MuEquiv (Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n) (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n) ψ ↔
                ν ψ < (Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n) ψ)

Singularity.mulQuotientSpanPair.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → (f g₁ g₂ : R) → R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g₂} →ₗ[R] R ⧸ Ideal.span {f, g₁ * g₂}

Singularity.mulQuotientSpanPair_injectiv.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {f g₁ g₂ : R},
  (∀ (c : R), f ∣ g₁ * c → f ∣ c) → Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.mulQuotientSpanPair f g₁ g₂)

Singularity.mulQuotientSpanPair_mk.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (f g₁ g₂ b : R),
  (Singularity.mulQuotientSpanPair f g₁ g₂) (Submodule.Quotient.mk b) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (g₁ * b)

Singularity.mulVec_inv_mulVec.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K},
  M.det ≠ 0 → ∀ (v : Fin 2 → K), M⁻¹.mulVec (M.mulVec v) = v

Singularity.mul_derivIdeal_derivIdeal_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {J B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  B * Singularity.derivIdeal J ≤ J → B * Singularity.derivIdeal (Singularity.derivIdeal J) ≤ Singularity.derivIdeal J

Singularity.mul_derivIdeal_iterate_succ_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I B : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)},
  B * Singularity.derivIdeal I ≤ I → ∀ (a : ℕ), B * Singularity.derivIdeal^[a + 1] I ≤ Singularity.derivIdeal^[a] I

Singularity.mul_derivation_monomial.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} [inst_4 : Fintype ι],
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (a : ι → ℕ) (i : ι), x i * (D i) (∏ j, x j ^ a j) = ↑(a i) * ∏ j, x j ^ a j

Singularity.mul_derivation_pow_self.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R},
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) → ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ), x i * (D i) (x i ^ n) = ↑n * x i ^ n

Singularity.mul_derivation_unit_mul_mono.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] {D : ι → Derivation k R R} {x : ι → R} [inst_4 : Fintype ι],
  (∀ (i j : ι), (D i) (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (u : Rˣ) (a : ι → ℕ) (i : ι),
      x i * (D i) (↑u * ∏ j, x j ^ a j) = (↑u * ∏ j, x j ^ a j) * (↑(a i) + x i * (D i) ↑u * ↑u⁻¹)

Singularity.mul_eq_of_eq_pow_mul.type: ∀ {n e f p ν : ℕ}, p = 1 ∨ Nat.Prime p ∧ ¬p ∣ n → n = p ^ ν * (e * f) → e * f = n

Singularity.mul_mem_centerDegreeIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n m : ℕ}
  {f g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S n →
    g ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S m → f * g ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S (n + m)

Singularity.mul_mem_commonWeightSpace.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] {p : ℕ}
  [inst_3 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p] (δ : ι → Derivation k R R) {χ ψ : ι → ZMod p} {g h : R},
  g ∈ Singularity.commonWeightSpace δ χ →
    h ∈ Singularity.commonWeightSpace δ ψ → g * h ∈ Singularity.commonWeightSpace δ (χ + ψ)

Singularity.mul_mem_derivLogJacobian.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R]
  (D : ι → Derivation k R R) (x : ι → R) {Δ : Finset ι} {i : ι},
  i ∈ Δ → ∀ (f : R), x i * (D i) f ∈ Singularity.derivLogJacobian D x Δ f

Singularity.naiveCoeff.eq_def.type:
∀ (m x : ℕ),
  Singularity.naiveCoeff m x =
    match x with
    | 0 => m
    | 1 => m + 1
    | i.succ.succ => Singularity.naiveCoeff m i + Singularity.naiveCoeff m (i + 1) - m

Singularity.naiveCoeff_add.type: ∀ (m i : ℕ), Singularity.naiveCoeff m i + Singularity.naiveCoeff m (i + 1) = 2 * m + Nat.fib (i + 2)

Singularity.naiveCoeff_add_two.type: ∀ (m i : ℕ), Singularity.naiveCoeff m (i + 2) = Singularity.naiveCoeff m i + Singularity.naiveCoeff m (i + 1) - m

Singularity.naiveCoeff_eq.type: ∀ (m i : ℕ), Singularity.naiveCoeff m i = m + Nat.fib i

Singularity.naiveCoeff_one_two_three.type: ∀ (m : ℕ), Singularity.naiveCoeff m 1 = m + 1 ∧ Singularity.naiveCoeff m 2 = m + 1 ∧ Singularity.naiveCoeff m 3 = m + 2

Singularity.narasimhanCoeff.type: (K : Type u_1) → [inst : Field K] → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) K

Singularity.narasimhan_le_ord_translate.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharP K 2],
  ↑2 ≤
    Singularity.ord
      ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C ((fun x => 1) o))
        (Singularity.zMonic 2 (Singularity.narasimhanCoeff K)))

Singularity.natCast_eq_zero_mvPowerSerie.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p], ↑p = 0

Singularity.natCast_mul_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (a : ℕ) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (MvPolynomial.monomial β) c * ↑a = (MvPolynomial.monomial β) (↑a * c)

Singularity.natCast_pow_char.type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {E : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing E] [CharP E p] (n : ℕ), ↑n ^ p = ↑n

Singularity.natCast_succ_le_ord_X_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ},
  ↑n ≤ Singularity.ord f → ∀ (m : σ), ↑(n + 1) ≤ Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X m * f)

Singularity.natCast_succ_le_ord_X_mul_pd.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
    ∀ {l : σ},
      l ∉ Δ →
        ∀ (m : σ),
          ↑(d + 1) ≤ Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))

Singularity.natCast_succ_le_ord_smul_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑d →
    ∀ {l : σ},
      l ∉ Δ →
        ↑(d + 1) ≤
          Singularity.ord
            (↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) l) • Singularity.residualFactor Δ g +
              MvPolynomial.X l * (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g))

Singularity.natDegree_add_natTrailingDeg.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring K] {f : Polynomial K},
  f ≠ 0 → ∀ {b : ℕ}, f.natDegree ≤ b → f.natDegree + (Polynomial.reflect b f).natTrailingDegree = b

Singularity.natDegree_eq_of_map_lt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  ν φ < μ φ →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
      ν ψ < μ ψ → (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < ψ.degree → ν f = μ f) → ψ.natDegree = φ.natDegree

Singularity.natDegree_le_of_map_lt_augme.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {μ ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {φ ψ : Polynomial K},
  φ.Monic →
    0 < φ.natDegree →
      (∀ (f : Polynomial K), f.degree < φ.degree → ν f = μ f) →
        ν ψ < Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ φ (ν φ) ψ → φ.natDegree ≤ ψ.natDegree

Singularity.natDegree_macLaneChainKey_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {F : Polynomial K},
      F ≠ 0 →
        ν F = 0 →
          ∀ {n : ℕ}, Singularity.macLaneChain v ν n ≠ ν → (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n).natDegree ≤ F.natDegree

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {v : Valuation K Γ₀}
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {n : ℕ},
      Singularity.macLaneChain v ν (n + 1) ≠ ν →
        (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν n).natDegree ≤ (Singularity.macLaneChainKey v ν (n + 1)).natDegree

Singularity.natTrailingDegree_reflect_of.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ {n : ℕ}, p.natDegree ≤ n → (Polynomial.reflect n p).natTrailingDegree = n - p.natDegree

Singularity.ncard_primesOver_le_finrank.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [inst_3 : Algebra R S]
  [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Flat R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], (p.primesOver S).ncard ≤ Module.finrank R S

Singularity.ncard_primesOver_le_finrank_.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] [inst_2 : CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
  [inst_4 : Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] (K : Type u_3) (L : Type u_4) [inst_7 : Field K]
  [inst_8 : Field L] [inst_9 : Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] [inst_11 : Algebra S L] [IsFractionRing S L]
  [inst_13 : Algebra K L] [inst_14 : Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower R S L] [IsScalarTower R K L] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
  (p.primesOver S).ncard ≤ Module.finrank K L

Singularity.ne_pow_of_isReduced.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CharP R p] (g : R),
  IsReduced (Polynomial R ⧸ Ideal.span {Polynomial.X ^ p + Polynomial.C g}) → ∀ (a : R), a ^ p ≠ g

Singularity.ne_zero_of_logJacobianOrder_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g ≠ ⊤ → g ≠ 0

Singularity.ne_zero_of_pointChart_eq_X_p.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ}, f ≠ 0 → (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' → f' ≠ 0

Singularity.ne_zero_of_valuation_eq_one.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {V : ValuationSubring K} {s : K}, V.valuation s = 1 → s ≠ 0

Singularity.nearPointExample_hyp.type:
MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4 ≠ 0 ∧
  Singularity.IsClean 3 (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) ∧
    ↑3 ≤ Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4)

Singularity.nearPointExample_not_mem_dir.type:
Singularity.logJacobianOrder {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) = 1 ∧
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor {0} 1 0)
        (Singularity.cleanPart 3
          (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4 * MvPolynomial.X 1)) =
      1 ∧
    (MvPolynomial.monomial
              (Singularity.divisorExponent {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4)))
            1 *
          (2 * MvPolynomial.X 1) ∈
        Singularity.logJacobian {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) ∧
      Singularity.ord (2 * MvPolynomial.X 1) = 1 ∧
        Singularity.chartVector 1 0 ∉
          Singularity.directrix ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent 1) (2 * MvPolynomial.X 1))

Singularity.nearPointExample_pointChart.type:
(Singularity.pointChart 1 0) (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) =
  MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 3 * (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4 * MvPolynomial.X 1)

Singularity.nearPointExample_tangent.type:
(MvPolynomial.monomial
          (Singularity.divisorExponent {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4)))
        1 *
      MvPolynomial.X 0 ∈
    Singularity.logJacobianTangent {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4) ∧
  Singularity.idealOrd
      (Singularity.logJacobianTangent {0} (MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 3 * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 + MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 4)) =
    ↑4

Singularity.neg_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_blo.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k}, t j = 0 → ∀ {i : σ}, i ∈ Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t → (-t) i = 0

Singularity.neg_apply_self_eq_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {j : σ} {t : σ → k}, t j = 0 → (-t) j = 0

Singularity.neg_nextCoeff_pow_sub_of_dvd.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP F p] {a : F} {g : Polynomial F},
  g.Monic → g ∣ Singularity.artinSchreierPoly p a → (-g.nextCoeff) ^ p - -g.nextCoeff = ↑g.natDegree * a

Singularity.newtonNondegenerate_purelyIn.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing K] [IsReduced K] [Nontrivial K] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  [CharP K p] [PerfectRing K p] {g : MvPolynomial σ K},
  g ≠ 0 →
    MvPolynomial.constantCoeff g = 0 →
      (Singularity.NewtonNondegenerate (Singularity.purelyInseparable p g) ↔
        ∀ (w : σ → ℕ),
          (∀ (i : σ), 0 < w i) →
            ∀ (v : σ → K), (∀ (i : σ), v i ≠ 0) → ¬Singularity.IsCriticalPoint (Singularity.initialForm w g) v)

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP K p] {a : K},
  a ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (b : K), b ^ p ≠ -a) →
      Singularity.NewtonNondegenerate (Singularity.purelyInseparable p ((MvPolynomial.monomial fun₀ | () => p) a))

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing K] [IsReduced K] [Nontrivial K] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  [CharP K p] {g : MvPolynomial σ K},
  g ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (w : σ → ℕ),
        (∀ (i : σ), 0 < w i) →
          ∀ (v : σ → K), (∀ (i : σ), v i ≠ 0) → ¬Singularity.IsCriticalPoint (Singularity.initialForm w g) v) →
      Singularity.NewtonNondegenerate (Singularity.purelyInseparable p g)

Singularity.newtonNondegenerate_ratFunc_.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  Singularity.NewtonNondegenerate (Singularity.purelyInseparable p ((MvPolynomial.monomial fun₀ | () => p) RatFunc.X)) ∧
    ∀ (w : Unit → ℕ) (v : Unit → RatFunc (ZMod p)),
      Singularity.IsCriticalPoint (Singularity.initialForm w ((MvPolynomial.monomial fun₀ | () => p) RatFunc.X)) v

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Set (σ → ℝ)

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_add_orthant.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_add_subset.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.newtonPolyhedron (f + g) ⊆
    (convexHull ℝ) (Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f ∪ Singularity.newtonPolyhedron g)

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_eq_convexHu.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f = (convexHull ℝ) (⇑Singularity.expToReal '' ↑f.support + Singularity.orthant σ)

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : R},
  c ≠ 0 → Singularity.newtonPolyhedron ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) c) = {Singularity.expToReal d} + Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_mul_subset.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.newtonPolyhedron (f * g) ⊆ Singularity.newtonPolyhedron f + Singularity.newtonPolyhedron g

Singularity.newtonPolyhedron_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R], Singularity.newtonPolyhedron 0 = ∅

Singularity.nodeBlowupQOneEquiv.type: (R : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing R] → Singularity.Algebra.NodeBlowupQ 1 ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R

Singularity.nodeBlowupQOneHom.type: (R : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing R] → Singularity.Algebra.NodeBlowupQ 1 →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R

Singularity.nodeBlowupQOneHom_X.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (i : Singularity.Algebra.NodeBlowupQVar),
  (Singularity.nodeBlowupQOneHom R) (Singularity.Algebra.nodeBlowupQX 1 i) = Singularity.nodeBlowupQOneImage R i

Singularity.nodeBlowupQOneImage.type: (R : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing R] → Singularity.Algebra.NodeBlowupQVar → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R

Singularity.nodeBlowupQOneInv.type: (R : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing R] → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) R →ₐ[R] Singularity.Algebra.NodeBlowupQ 1

Singularity.noether_inequality_of_branch.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [DecidableEq ι] (s I T : Finset ι),
  I ⊆ s →
    T ⊆ I →
      ∀ (e e' d vx vy vf vf' : ι → ℕ) (a b iR iR₁ : ℕ),
        iR = ∑ i ∈ s, e i * vf i →
          iR₁ = ∑ i ∈ T, e' i * vf' i →
            ∑ i ∈ s, e i * min (vx i) (vy i) = b →
              (∀ i ∈ I, vx i ≤ vy i) →
                (∀ i ∈ I, vf i = a * vx i + vf' i) →
                  (∀ i ∈ s, i ∉ I → vy i ≤ vx i ∧ a * vy i ≤ vf i) →
                    (∀ i ∈ T, e i = d i * e' i) → (∀ i ∈ T, 1 ≤ d i) → iR₁ + a * b ≤ iR

Singularity.nonZeroDivisors_le_primeComp.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Γ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_2 : LinearOrder Γ]
  [inst_3 : IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] [inst_4 : IsDomain k] (γ : σ → Γ),
  nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ k) ≤ (Singularity.monomialAddValuation γ).supp.primeCompl

Singularity.nonempty_orderMonoidIso_mult.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G] (f : G ≃* Multiplicative ℤ),
  Nonempty (G ≃*o Multiplicative ℤ)

Singularity.nonempty_orderMonoidIso_of_b.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedMonoid G]
  (b : Module.Basis (Fin 1) ℤ (Additive G)), Nonempty (G ≃*o Multiplicative ℤ)

Singularity.nonmonoPart.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing R] → R → Ideal R → Ideal R

Singularity.nonmonoPart_span_pow_mul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {t : R},
  t ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {B : Ideal R},
      Singularity.HasDivOrd t B →
        ∀ (g : ℕ), Singularity.nonmonoPart t (Ideal.span {t ^ g} * B) = Singularity.nonmonoPart t B

Singularity.notMem_charPolyhedron_of_isS.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : k},
