∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {d : σ →₀ ℕ}, f.coeff d ≠ 0 → Singularity.ordAlong S f ≤ ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)

Singularity.ordAlong_le_cleanOrdAlong.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {p : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (S : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ordAlong S g ≤ Singularity.cleanOrdAlong p S g

Singularity.ordAlong_le_ordAlong_X_mul_p.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (j : σ)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ordAlong S F ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) F) + 1

Singularity.ordAlong_le_ordAlong_mul_lef.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ)
  (a f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ordAlong S f ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S (a * f)

Singularity.ordAlong_le_ordAlong_pderiv_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (j : σ)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ordAlong S F ≤ Singularity.ordAlong S ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) F) + 1

Singularity.ordAlong_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : R},
  c ≠ 0 → Singularity.ordAlong S ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) c) = ↑(∑ i ∈ S, d i)

Singularity.ordAlong_monomial_mul_add_po.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (S : Finset σ)
  {Δ : Finset σ} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
    ∀ (G h : MvPolynomial σ k) {e : MvPolynomial σ k},
      e ∈
          (fun i => ↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G) '' ↑Δ ∪
            (fun j => (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G) '' (↑Δ)ᶜ →
        Singularity.ordAlong S ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G + h ^ p) ≤
          ↑(∑ i ∈ S, r i) + Singularity.ordAlong S e + 1

Singularity.ordAlong_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [NoZeroDivisors R] (S : Finset σ)
  (f g : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ordAlong S (f * g) = Singularity.ordAlong S f + Singularity.ordAlong S g

Singularity.ordAlong_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k) (n : ℕ),
  Singularity.ordAlong S (f ^ n) = ↑n * Singularity.ordAlong S f

Singularity.ordAlong_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ),
  Singularity.ordAlong S 0 = ⊤

Singularity.ordAtPoint.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → (σ → k) → ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal_anti.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (a : σ → k) {n n' : ℕ},
  n ≤ n' → Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a n' ≤ Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a n

Singularity.ordAtPoint_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (f : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ordAtPoint 0 f = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_C.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {c : R}, c ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.C c) = 0

Singularity.ord_X.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (i : σ), Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X i) = 1

Singularity.ord_X_mul_X_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (i j : σ) (n : ℕ),
  Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X i * MvPolynomial.X j ^ n) = ↑(n + 1)

Singularity.ord_X_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (i : σ) (n : ℕ),
  Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n) = ↑n

Singularity.ord_X_pow_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {i : σ} {n : ℕ} {q : MvPolynomial σ k},
  ↑n < Singularity.ord q → Singularity.ord (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n + q) = ↑n

Singularity.ord_add_of_lt.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.ord f < Singularity.ord g → Singularity.ord (f + g) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_add_of_ord_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.ord f ≠ Singularity.ord g → Singularity.ord (f + g) = min (Singularity.ord f) (Singularity.ord g)

Singularity.ord_add_pow_le_ord_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord (F + h ^ p ^ e) ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F)

Singularity.ord_add_pow_le_ord_of_isClea.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F → ∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ord (F + h ^ p ^ e) ≤ Singularity.ord F

Singularity.ord_add_pow_le_residualOrder.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord (F + h ^ q) ≤ Singularity.residualOrder q F

Singularity.ord_algEquiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_3} (e : MvPolynomial σ R ≃ₐ[R] MvPolynomial τ R),
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (e (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
    (∀ (i : τ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (e.symm (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
      ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord (e f) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_centerChartUnit.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (S : Finset σ)
  (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (r : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.ord (Singularity.centerChartUnit S j t r) = 0

Singularity.ord_chartRest_monomial_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (r : σ →₀ ℕ),
  Singularity.ord ((Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1)) =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t r))

Singularity.ord_chartTransform_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {m : ℕ}
  {f : MvPolynomial σ k}, Singularity.ord f = ↑m → Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartTransform j t m f) ≤ ↑m

Singularity.ord_chartUnit.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (r : σ →₀ ℕ), Singularity.ord (Singularity.chartUnit j t r) = 0

Singularity.ord_classicalF_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] {m : ℕ} {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R},
  (∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 m, ↑j ≤ Singularity.ord (a j)) → Singularity.ord (Singularity.classicalF m a) = ↑m

Singularity.ord_cleanPart_add_le_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {e d : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k} {α : σ →₀ ℕ},
  F.coeff α ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.ord F = ↑(Finsupp.degree α) →
      Finsupp.degree α = Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
        ∀ {i : σ},
          i ≠ j →
            ¬p ^ e ∣ α i →
              (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
                ∃ v < e,
                  Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F') + ↑(p ^ e) ≤
                    ↑(p ^ v +
                        (Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) +
                              Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) +
                            d +
                          d))

Singularity.ord_cleanPart_add_le_of_not_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {e d : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k} {α : σ →₀ ℕ},
  F.coeff α ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.ord F = ↑(Finsupp.degree α) →
      Finsupp.degree α = Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
        ¬p ^ e ∣ Finsupp.degree α →
          (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F') + ↑(p ^ e) ≤
              ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) +
                      Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) +
                    d +
                  d)

Singularity.ord_def.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord f = (↑f).order

Singularity.ord_divMonomial_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ β ∈ P.support, r ≤ β) → Singularity.ord (P.divMonomial r) + ↑(Finsupp.degree r) = Singularity.ord P

Singularity.ord_eq_degree_divisorExponen.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord g =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g)) + Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord f =
    ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ f)) + Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ f)

Singularity.ord_eq_iInf_degree.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f = ⨅ d ∈ f.support, ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.ord_eq_one_of_constantCoeff_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {G : MvPolynomial σ k},
  MvPolynomial.constantCoeff G = 0 →
    ∀ {j : σ}, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G) ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord G = 1

Singularity.ord_eq_order_idealOfVars.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f = Singularity.Algebra.order (MvPolynomial.idealOfVars σ R) f

Singularity.ord_eq_top_iff.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, Singularity.ord f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

Singularity.ord_eq_zero_iff_constantCoef.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.ord f = 0 ↔ MvPolynomial.constantCoeff f ≠ 0

Singularity.ord_killOutside.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {s : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ s →
    Singularity.ord f = ↑s → Singularity.ord ((Singularity.killOutside S) f) = ↑s

Singularity.ord_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f.coeff d ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord f ≤ ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.ord_le_idealOrd_residualLogJ.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord G ≤ Singularity.idealOrd (Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G) + 1

Singularity.ord_le_of_centerChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ {t : σ → k} {s : ℕ} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k},
      f ∈ Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ s →
        Singularity.ord f = ↑s → (Singularity.centerChart S j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ s * f' → Singularity.ord f' ≤ ↑s

Singularity.ord_le_of_homogeneousCompone.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {f : MvPolynomial σ k} {m : ℕ},
  (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) f ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord f ≤ ↑m

Singularity.ord_le_of_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f f' : MvPolynomial σ k}
  {m : ℕ}, Singularity.ord f = ↑m → (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * f' → Singularity.ord f' ≤ ↑m

Singularity.ord_le_ord_aeval.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_3} (φ : σ → MvPolynomial τ R),
  (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ i) = 0) →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.aeval φ) f)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord F ≤ Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart q F)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_hyperplaneRestric.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] (h : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.hyperplaneRestrict h) f)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_killOutside.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.killOutside S) f)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_killVar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord g ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.killVar j) g)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_linearChange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord f ≤ Singularity.ord ((Singularity.linearChange A) f)

Singularity.ord_le_ord_rename_some.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord g ≤ Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.rename some) g)

Singularity.ord_le_residualOrder.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {q : ℕ},
  q ≠ 0 → ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ord F ≤ Singularity.residualOrder q F

Singularity.ord_le_totalDegree.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {p : MvPolynomial σ k}, p ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord p ≤ ↑p.totalDegree

Singularity.ord_linearChange.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq σ] (A : Matrix σ σ R)
  [Invertible A] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord ((Singularity.linearChange A) f) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_map_eq_of_inverse.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), ψ (φ h) = h) →
    (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
      (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (ψ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
        ∀ (q : MvPolynomial σ k), Singularity.ord (φ q) = Singularity.ord q

Singularity.ord_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : R},
  c ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) c) = ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.ord_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.ord (f * g) = Singularity.ord f + Singularity.ord g

Singularity.ord_ne_top.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, f ≠ 0 → Singularity.ord f ≠ ⊤

Singularity.ord_neg.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord (-f) = Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_one.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R], Singularity.ord 1 = 0

Singularity.ord_pointChart_diag_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {F : MvPolynomial σ k} {S : MvPolynomial σ k →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ k} {w : (σ →₀ ℕ) → k},
  Singularity.IsDiag S w →
    ∀ {α : σ →₀ ℕ} {d : ℕ},
      F.coeff α ≠ 0 →
        Singularity.ord F = ↑(Finsupp.degree α) →
          w α ≠ 0 →
            Finsupp.degree α = Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
              Singularity.ord ((Singularity.pointChart j t) (S F)) ≤
                ↑(Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) +
                        Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) +
                      d +
                    d)

Singularity.ord_pointChart_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {P : MvPolynomial σ k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {d : ℕ},
  (∀ β ∈ P.support, r ≤ β) →
    Singularity.ord P = ↑(Finsupp.degree r + d) →
      Singularity.ord ((Singularity.pointChart j t) P) ≤
        ↑(Finsupp.degree r + Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t r) + d + d)

Singularity.ord_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R)
  (n : ℕ), Singularity.ord (f ^ n) = n • Singularity.ord f

Singularity.ord_prod.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R), Singularity.ord (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, Singularity.ord (f i)

Singularity.ord_residualFactor_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p]
  {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
        Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g')) ≤
          Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) + 1

Singularity.ord_residualFactor_le_cpOmeg.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≤ Singularity.cpOmega Δ g + 1

Singularity.ord_residualFactor_le_logJac.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≤ Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1

Singularity.ord_residualFactor_le_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = 0 → Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) ≤ 1

Singularity.ord_residualFactor_originTra.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
      ∀ {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
        a ∈ g.support →
          Singularity.ord g = ↑(Finsupp.degree a) →
            Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor (insert j Δ) (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g)) +
                ↑(a j) ≤
              Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) + ↑((Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) j)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  j ∉ Δ →
    g ≠ 0 →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        ∀ {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
          a ∈ g.support →
            Singularity.ord g = ↑(Finsupp.degree a) →
              Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor (insert j Δ) (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g)) +
                  ↑(a j) ≤
                Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [inst : DecidableEq σ] [inst_1 : Field k] {p : ℕ} {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ}
  {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
      Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor (insert j Δ) (Singularity.OriginRuns.originTransform p j g)) ≤
        Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)

Singularity.ord_residualFactor_sub_one_l.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.ord (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g) - 1 ≤ Singularity.cpOmega Δ g

Singularity.ord_sum_smul_add_X_mul_pderi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {G : MvPolynomial σ k} {d : ℕ},
  Singularity.ord G = ↑d →
    ↑(Finsupp.degree r + d) ≠ 0 →
      Singularity.ord (∑ i, (↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G)) = ↑d

Singularity.ord_translate_zMonic_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) (b : Option σ → R),
      Singularity.ord ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => MvPolynomial.X o + MvPolynomial.C (b o)) (Singularity.zMonic m a)) ≤
        ↑m

Singularity.ord_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R], Singularity.ord 0 = ⊤

Singularity.orderGAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → ℕ → Finset σ → Finset σ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.orderGAlong_le_idealOrdAlong.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (Δ S : Finset σ)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.orderGAlong p Δ S g ≤
    Singularity.idealOrdAlong S
        (Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ g) (Singularity.residualFactor Δ g)) +
      1

Singularity.order_eval_sq_add_X_pow_thre.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (φ : PowerSeries k),
  (((Polynomial.taylor φ) (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (PowerSeries.X ^ 3))).coeff 0).order ≤ 3

Singularity.originDehom.type: (k : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing k] → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k

Singularity.originDerivation.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field k] →
      σ → Derivation k (Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k) (Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k)

Singularity.originDerivation_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i j : σ),
  (Singularity.originDerivation i)
      ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k)) (MvPolynomial.X j)) =
    if i = j then 1 else 0

Singularity.originDerivation_algebraMap.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (i : σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.originDerivation i) ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k)) g) =
    (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (Singularity.Algebra.OriginLocalRing σ k)) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g)

Singularity.originIdeal.type: (σ : Type u_1) → (k : Type u_2) → [inst : Field k] → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.originIdeal_isPrime.type: ∀ (σ : Type u_1) (k : Type u_2) [inst : Field k], (Singularity.originIdeal σ k).IsPrime

Singularity.originRestrict.type: (k : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing k] → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k

Singularity.originRestrict_originDehom.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k] (P : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k),
  (Singularity.originRestrict k) ((Singularity.originDehom k) P) = (Singularity.originDehom k) P

Singularity.originRestrict_originStrict.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k] (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k) {m : ℕ},
  (∀ d < m, (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) F = 0) →
    (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) F ≠ 0 →
      (Singularity.originRestrict k) (Singularity.originStrict F m) =
        (Singularity.originDehom k) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent m) F)

Singularity.originStrict.type: {k : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing k] → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k → ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k

Singularity.originXChart.type: (k : Type u_1) → [inst : CommRing k] → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k

Singularity.originXChartInv.type: {k : Type u_1} → [inst : CommRing k] → [IsDomain k] → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k →+* FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k)

Singularity.originXChartInv_comp.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : IsDomain k],
  Singularity.originXChartInv.comp (Singularity.originXChart k).toRingHom =
    algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k))

Singularity.originXChart_eq_pow_mul_orig.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k] (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k) {m : ℕ},
  (∀ d < m, (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent d) F = 0) →
    (Singularity.originXChart k) F = MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ m * Singularity.originStrict F m

Singularity.originXChart_injective.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k] [IsDomain k], Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.originXChart k)

Singularity.originXChart_monomial.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k] (s : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.originXChart k) ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) c) =
    MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (s 0 + s 1 + s 2) * (Singularity.originDehom k) ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) c)

Singularity.originXChart_of_isHomogeneou.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k] {P : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k} {d : ℕ},
  P.IsHomogeneous d → (Singularity.originXChart k) P = MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ d * (Singularity.originDehom k) P

Singularity.orthant_add_orthant.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1}, Singularity.orthant σ + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.p1Bracket.type: {K : Type u_1} → [Field K] → (Fin 2 → K) → (Fin 2 → K) → K

Singularity.p1Bracket_mulVec.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) (p q : Fin 2 → K),
  Singularity.p1Bracket (M.mulVec p) (M.mulVec q) = M.det * Singularity.p1Bracket p q

Singularity.p1Bracket_plucker.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (a b c d : Fin 2 → K),
  Singularity.p1Bracket a b * Singularity.p1Bracket c d - Singularity.p1Bracket a c * Singularity.p1Bracket b d +
      Singularity.p1Bracket a d * Singularity.p1Bracket b c =
    0

Singularity.p1Bracket_swap.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (p q : Fin 2 → K), Singularity.p1Bracket q p = -Singularity.p1Bracket p q

Singularity.p1Bracket_swap_ne_zero.type: ∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {p q : Fin 2 → K}, Singularity.p1Bracket p q ≠ 0 → Singularity.p1Bracket q p ≠ 0

Singularity.p1Structure.type:
(k : Type u) →
  [inst : Field k] →
    (p n : ℕ) → (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) → Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec ↧k

Singularity.p1_equation_ne_zero.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), MvPolynomial.X none ^ p + (MvPolynomial.rename some) g ≠ 0

Singularity.pderiv_C_mul_X_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (c : k) {j l : σ},
  j ≠ l → (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X l) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_X_pow_mul_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {i j : σ},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (MvPolynomial.X j ^ n * u) = MvPolynomial.X j ^ n * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) u

Singularity.pderiv_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (j : σ) (g h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (g + h ^ p) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) g

Singularity.pderiv_aeval_eq_sum.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (φ : σ → MvPolynomial σ R) (j : σ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.aeval φ) f) =
    ∑ i, (MvPolynomial.aeval φ) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f) * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (φ i)

Singularity.pderiv_algHom.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (φ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
  (i : σ) (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (φ h) = ∑ l, φ ((MvPolynomial.pderiv l) h) * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (φ (MvPolynomial.X l))

Singularity.pderiv_centerChart_of_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ},
  i ∈ S →
    i ≠ j →
      ∀ (t : σ → k) (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
        (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) h) =
          MvPolynomial.X j * (Singularity.centerChart S j t) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pderiv_centerChart_of_notMem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {i j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    i ∉ S →
      ∀ (t : σ → k) (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
        (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) h) =
          (Singularity.centerChart S j t) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pderiv_chartImage.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (c j i : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) (Singularity.chartImage S c i) =
    if i ∈ S.erase c then (if j = i then MvPolynomial.X c else 0) + if j = c then MvPolynomial.X i else 0
    else if j = i then 1 else 0

Singularity.pderiv_chartSubst_center.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] (S : Finset σ) (c : σ)
  (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv c) ((Singularity.chartSubst S c) f) =
    (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv c) f) +
      ∑ l ∈ S.erase c, MvPolynomial.X l * (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv l) f)

Singularity.pderiv_chartSubst_of_mem_era.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] {S : Finset σ} {c j : σ},
  j ∈ S.erase c →
    ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((Singularity.chartSubst S c) f) =
        (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) f) * MvPolynomial.X c

Singularity.pderiv_chartSubst_of_not_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Fintype σ] {S : Finset σ} {c j : σ},
  c ∈ S →
    j ∉ S →
      ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
        (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((Singularity.chartSubst S c) f) =
          (Singularity.chartSubst S c) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) f)

Singularity.pderiv_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (i : σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (Singularity.cleanPart p g) = (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g

Singularity.pderiv_eq_zero_of_mem_direct.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {F : MvPolynomial σ k} {v : σ → k} {i : σ} (c : k),
  v ∈ Singularity.directrix F →
    v ∈ Singularity.directrix (c • F + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) F) →
      v i ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) F = 0

Singularity.pderiv_homogeneousComponent_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (j : σ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent 1) G) ≠ 0 ↔ (G.coeff fun₀ | j => 1) ≠ 0

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (j : σ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent 0) G) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_iterate_mem_derivIdea.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} (i : σ) {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ∈ I → ∀ (j : ℕ), (⇑(MvPolynomial.pderiv i))^[j] f ∈ Singularity.derivIdeal^[j] I

Singularity.pderiv_mem_centerDegreeIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {S : Finset σ} {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S n →
    ∀ (l : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) f ∈ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S (n - if l ∈ S then 1 else 0)

Singularity.pderiv_mem_centerIdeal_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (S : Finset σ) (i : σ) {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ∈ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ (n + 1) → (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f ∈ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ n

Singularity.pderiv_mem_derivIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)} {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  f ∈ I → ∀ (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f ∈ Singularity.derivIdeal I

Singularity.pderiv_mem_logJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∉ Δ → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ k), (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) g ∈ Singularity.logJacobian Δ g

Singularity.pderiv_mem_logJacobianCenter.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ S : Finset σ} {l : σ},
  l ∉ Δ → l ∉ S → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial σ k), (MvPolynomial.pderiv l) g ∈ Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g

Singularity.pderiv_mem_logJacobianSeries.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∉ Δ → ∀ (g : MvPowerSeries σ k), (MvPowerSeries.pderiv j) g ∈ Singularity.logJacobianSeries Δ g

Singularity.pderiv_mem_ordAtPointIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] {a : σ → k} {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ∈ Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a (n + 1) → ∀ (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f ∈ Singularity.ordAtPointIdeal a n

Singularity.pderiv_mem_pow_of_mem_pow_su.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) (i : σ) (n : ℕ)
  {f : MvPolynomial σ R}, f ∈ I ^ (n + 1) → (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f ∈ I ^ n

Singularity.pderiv_mem_residualLogJacobi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ},
  j ∉ Δ → ∀ (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k), (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G

Singularity.pderiv_mem_tangentDerivation.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {Δ : Set σ} {j : σ},
  j ∉ Δ → MvPolynomial.pderiv j ∈ Singularity.tangentDerivations k (MvPolynomial.X '' Δ)

Singularity.pderiv_monomial_eq_zero_of_d.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {a : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ (i : σ), p ∣ a i) → ∀ (c : k) (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_monomial_mul_of_eq_ze.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {j : σ},
  r j = 0 →
    ∀ (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) =
        (MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) G

Singularity.pderiv_ne_zero_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (F : MvPolynomial σ k) (j : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) F ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ a ∈ F.support, ¬p ∣ a j

Singularity.pderiv_none_purelyInseparabl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv none) (Singularity.purelyInseparable p h) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_none_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv none) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) h) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_pointChart_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {i j : σ},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) h) =
        MvPolynomial.X j * (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pderiv_pow_char.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (i : σ) (h : MvPowerSeries σ k),
  (MvPowerSeries.pderiv i) (h ^ p) = 0

Singularity.pderiv_some_purelyInseparabl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial σ k) (i : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv (some i)) (Singularity.purelyInseparable q h) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pderiv_some_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (v : σ → k) (i : σ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv (some i)) ((Singularity.translate v) F) = (Singularity.translate v) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) F)

Singularity.pderiv_translateBy.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [DecidableEq σ] (t : σ → k) (i : σ) (h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((Singularity.translateBy t) h) = (Singularity.translateBy t) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) h)

Singularity.pointChart.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k

Singularity.pointChartZ.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.pointChartZ_purelyInseparabl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {q : ℕ}
  {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ q * F' →
    (Singularity.pointChartZ j t) (Singularity.purelyInseparable q F) =
      MvPolynomial.X (some j) ^ q * Singularity.purelyInseparable q F'

Singularity.pointChartZ_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k)
  (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.pointChartZ j t) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) F) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) F)

Singularity.pointChart_X_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (i : σ),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X j * (Singularity.chartRest j t) (MvPolynomial.X i)

Singularity.pointChart_X_mul_pderiv_mem.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ]
  (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k) (m : σ),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) ∈
    Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) g)

Singularity.pointChart_X_mul_pderiv_of_n.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {m j : σ},
  m ≠ j →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X m * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) g) =
        (MvPolynomial.X m + MvPolynomial.C (t m)) * (MvPolynomial.pderiv m) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k} {i : σ},
  i ≠ j →
    t i = 0 →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g) =
          MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * (MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g')

Singularity.pointChart_X_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j i : σ} (t : σ → k),
  i ≠ j → (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X i) = MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (t i))

Singularity.pointChart_X_self.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) (MvPolynomial.X j) = MvPolynomial.X j

Singularity.pointChart_eq_X_pow_mul_tran.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  t j = 0 →
    (Singularity.pointChart j 0) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * (Singularity.translateBy t) g'

Singularity.pointChart_eq_sum.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (f : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) f =
    ∑ a ∈ f.support,
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ Finsupp.degree a * (Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) (f.coeff a))

Singularity.pointChart_eq_translateBy_co.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k},
  t j = 0 → Singularity.pointChart j t = (Singularity.translateBy t).comp (Singularity.pointChart j 0)

Singularity.pointChart_injective.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.pointChart j t)

Singularity.pointChart_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (a : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c) =
    MvPolynomial.X j ^ Finsupp.degree a * (Singularity.chartRest j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) c)

Singularity.pointChart_monomial_mul_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {j : σ} {t : σ → k}
  {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {m : ℕ} {ψ ψ' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) ψ = MvPolynomial.X j ^ m * ψ' →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * ψ) =
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ (Finsupp.degree r + m) *
        ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Singularity.chartExponent j t r)) 1 * (Singularity.chartUnit j t r * ψ'))

Singularity.pointChart_ne_zero.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {f : MvPolynomial σ k},
  f ≠ 0 → (Singularity.pointChart j t) f ≠ 0

Singularity.pointChart_pderiv_of_ne.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {i j : σ},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) {n : ℕ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ k},
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) f = MvPolynomial.X j ^ (n + 1) * g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) f) = MvPolynomial.X j ^ n * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g

Singularity.pointChart_quadricCone_x.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing k],
  (Singularity.pointChart 0 0) (Singularity.quadricCone k) =
    MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ 2 * (MvPolynomial.X 1 - MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ 2)

Singularity.pointChart_quadricCone_y.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing k],
  (Singularity.pointChart 1 0) (Singularity.quadricCone k) =
    MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 * (MvPolynomial.X 0 - MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ 2)

Singularity.pointChart_quadricCone_z.type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing k],
  (Singularity.pointChart 2 0) (Singularity.quadricCone k) =
    MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ 2 * (MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 - 1)

Singularity.pointChart_some_eq_pointChar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) {t : Option σ → k},
  t none = 0 → Singularity.pointChart (some j) t = Singularity.pointChartZ j fun l => t (some l)

Singularity.pointChart_some_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : Option σ → k)
  (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.pointChart (some j) t) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) g) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((Singularity.pointChart j fun l => t (some l)) g)

Singularity.pointChart_sum_X_mul_pderiv.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : Fintype σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p]
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
    (Singularity.pointChart j t) (∑ i, MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) g) =
      MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * (MvPolynomial.X j * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j) g')

Singularity.pointChart_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {m : ℕ} {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a i)) →
    ∀ (j : σ) {t : Option σ → k},
      t none = 0 →
        (Singularity.pointChart (some j) t) (Singularity.zMonic m a) =
          MvPolynomial.X (some j) ^ m *
            Singularity.zMonic m fun i => Singularity.chartTransform j (fun l => t (some l)) (m - i) (a i)

Singularity.pointChart_zero_comp_chartLi.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k),
  (Singularity.pointChart j 0).comp (Singularity.chartLinear j t) = Singularity.pointChart j t

Singularity.pointIdeal.type: {ι : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → (ι → R) → Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)

Singularity.polyDelta.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing k] → [Fintype σ] → (σ → ℝ) → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → ℝ

Singularity.polyDelta_X_pow_add_C_two.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] [inst_2 : Fintype σ] {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ {a b : σ →₀ ℕ},
      a ≠ b →
        ∀ {w : σ → ℝ},
          (∀ (j : σ), 0 ≤ w j) →
            Singularity.polyDelta w
                (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C ((MvPowerSeries.monomial a) 1 + (MvPowerSeries.monomial b) 1)) =
              min (Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a) / ↑n)
                (Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal b) / ↑n)

Singularity.polyDelta_eq_of_isUniqueMini.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {w : σ → ℝ}
  {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {y : σ → ℝ},
  Singularity.IsUniqueMinimizer w (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) y →
    Singularity.polyDelta w f = Singularity.linWeight w y

Singularity.polyDelta_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)}
  {w : σ → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : σ), 0 ≤ w j) →
    ∀ {x : σ → ℝ}, x ∈ Singularity.projPolyhedron f → Singularity.polyDelta w f ≤ Singularity.linWeight w x

Singularity.polyDelta_pos_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)},
  (Singularity.projPolyhedron f).Nonempty →
    (0 < Singularity.polyDelta (fun x => 1) f ↔
      ∀ (i : ℕ), 1 ≤ i → i ≤ f.natDegree → MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (f.coeff (f.natDegree - i)) = 0)

Singularity.polyDelta_pos_iff_of_isMinim.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)},
  f.Monic →
    Singularity.IsMinimalCoord f →
      (Singularity.projPolyhedron f).Nonempty →
        (0 < Singularity.polyDelta (fun x => 1) f ↔
          ∃ c, Polynomial.map MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff f = (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c) ^ f.natDegree)

Singularity.polynomialChart.type: (k : Type u_2) → [inst : Field k] → Subring (RatFunc k)

Singularity.polynomialChart_le.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (P : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (Polynomial k)),

    (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation (RatFunc k) P).valuationSubring.toSubring

Singularity.pow_div_pow_le_one_iff.type: ∀ {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] {a : Γ}, 1 < a → ∀ (m n : ℕ), a ^ m / a ^ n ≤ 1 ↔ m ≤ n

Singularity.pow_eq_zero_of_isClean.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F h : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F → Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) → h ^ p ^ e = 0

Singularity.pow_le_tuningIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] {m s : ℕ},
  m ∣ s → ∀ (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)), I ^ (s / m) ≤ Singularity.tuningIdeal m s I

Singularity.pow_mul_chain_le.type:
∀ {A : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] {I : ℕ → Ideal A} {B : Ideal A},
  (∀ (a : ℕ), B * I (a + 1) ≤ I a) → ∀ (k a : ℕ), B ^ k * I (a + k) ≤ I a

Singularity.pow_mul_mem_span_taylorMonom.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (δ : ι → Derivation k A A) (y : ι → A) (p : ℕ) {S : Finset ι} {j : ι},
  j ∉ S →
    ∀ {i : ℕ},
      i < p →
        ∀ {x : A},
          x ∈ Submodule.span (↥(Singularity.constants δ)) (Singularity.taylorMonomials y p S) →
            y j ^ i * x ∈ Submodule.span (↥(Singularity.constants δ)) (Singularity.taylorMonomials y p (insert j S))

Singularity.pow_ne_X_mul_C_X.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {p : ℕ},
  2 ≤ p →
    ∀ (w : FractionRing (Polynomial (Polynomial k))),
      w ^ p ≠
        (algebraMap (Polynomial (Polynomial k)) (FractionRing (Polynomial (Polynomial k))))
          (Polynomial.X * Polynomial.C Polynomial.X)

Singularity.pow_sub_castHom_apply_of_mem.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing R] [inst_2 : Algebra k R] {p : ℕ}
  [inst_3 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [inst_4 : CharP R p] (δ : Derivation k R R) {j : ZMod p} {g : R},
  g ∈ Singularity.weightSpace δ j →
    ∀ (i : ZMod p) (n : ℕ), ((↑δ - (ZMod.castHom ⋯ (Module.End k R)) i) ^ n) g = ((j - i) ^ n).cast * g

Singularity.pow_varsIdeal_le_alongIdeal.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [Nontrivial R] (S : Finset σ) (n : ℕ),
  Singularity.varsIdeal S ^ n ≤ Singularity.alongIdeal S ↑n

Singularity.primeSpectrumEquivConvexSubg.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] → (V : ValuationSubring K) → PrimeSpectrum ↥V ≃ { H // Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup H }

Singularity.prime_C_mul_X_sub_C_of_not_d.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R] {a b : R},
  Irreducible a → ¬a ∣ b → Prime (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C b)

Singularity.prime_curveNodePoly.type: ∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field k] (n : ℕ), Prime (Singularity.curveNodePoly k n)

Singularity.prime_divisorNodePoly.type: ∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field k] {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι), Prime (Singularity.divisorNodePoly k s)

Singularity.principal_monomial_orderRedu.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] {k : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Field k] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : σ},
  c ∈ d.support →
    Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial d) 1} ≤ Singularity.chartCenterIdeal d.support ^ Finsupp.degree d ∧
      Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal d.support c (Finsupp.degree d) (Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial d) 1}) =
          Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.erase c d)) 1} ∧
        Singularity.idealOrd
            (Singularity.centerChartTransformIdeal d.support c (Finsupp.degree d)
              (Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial d) 1})) <
          ↑(Finsupp.degree d)

Singularity.principalization_chartCenter.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [IsDomain R] {S : Finset σ} {c : σ},
  c ∈ S →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      Singularity.IsChartSeqOfOrder n [(S, c)] (Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ n) ∧
        Singularity.chartSeqTransform n [(S, c)] (Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ n) = ⊤ ∧
          Ideal.map (Singularity.chartSeqMap [(S, c)]) (Singularity.chartCenterIdeal S ^ n) =
            Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.monomial fun₀ | c => n) 1}

Singularity.prod_changeParam_pow.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : CommMonoid R] (x : ι → R) (i : ι)
  (v : R) (a : ι → ℕ), ∏ j, Singularity.changeParam x i v j ^ a j = v ^ a i * ∏ j, x j ^ a j

Singularity.projPoints.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → Set (σ → ℝ)

Singularity.projPoints_X_pow_add_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (G : MvPowerSeries σ k),
      Singularity.projPoints (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C G) =
        {u | ∃ α, (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) G ≠ 0 ∧ u = (↑n)⁻¹ • Singularity.expToReal α}

Singularity.projPoints_subset_projPolyhe.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.projPoints f ⊆ Singularity.projPolyhedron f

Singularity.projPoints_taylor_monomial_s.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  Singularity.projPoints ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial β) c)) f) ⊆
    (convexHull ℝ) (Singularity.projPolyhedron f ∪ ({Singularity.expToReal β} + Singularity.orthant σ))

Singularity.projPolyhedron.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → Set (σ → ℝ)

Singularity.projPolyhedron_X_pow_add_C_c.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
      Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C ↑F) = (↑n)⁻¹ • Singularity.newtonPolyhedron F

Singularity.projPolyhedron_X_pow_add_C_n.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ {G : MvPowerSeries σ k} {α : σ →₀ ℕ},
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) G ≠ 0 → (Singularity.projPolyhedron (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C G)).Nonempty

Singularity.projPolyhedron_add_orthant.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.projPolyhedron f + Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.projPolyhedron f

Singularity.projPolyhedron_eq_empty_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.projPolyhedron f = ∅ ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ), 1 ≤ i → i ≤ f.natDegree → f.coeff (f.natDegree - i) = 0

Singularity.projPolyhedron_eq_empty_iff_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)},
  f.Monic → (Singularity.projPolyhedron f = ∅ ↔ f = Polynomial.X ^ f.natDegree)

Singularity.projPolyhedron_subset_orthan.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),
  Singularity.projPolyhedron f ⊆ Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.projPolyhedron_subset_taylor.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [Nontrivial k] (e : ℕ)
  {F : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (α : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff α) F ≠ 0 → ¬∀ (i : σ), p ^ e ∣ α i) →
    ∀ (φ : MvPowerSeries σ k),

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type uL} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} {Γ₁ : Type uΓ}

        φ.Monic →
          0 < φ.natDegree → Singularity.IsMuMinimal ν φ → Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ ν

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w₀ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c : K), ν (Polynomial.C c) = w₀ (Polynomial.C c)) →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w₀ f) →
      ∀ {F : Polynomial K}, F ≠ 0 → ν F = 0 → Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ ν

∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν w₀ : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀},
  (∀ (c : K), ν (Polynomial.C c) = w₀ (Polynomial.C c)) →
    (∀ (f : Polynomial K), ν f ≤ w₀ f) →
      Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ ν ∨
        (∀ (φ : Polynomial K), ¬Singularity.KeyPolynomial ν φ) ∧
          ((∃ w,
              w 0 = w₀ ∧
                (∀ (n : ℕ), Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) (w n) (w (n + 1))) ∧
                  (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Polynomial K), f.natDegree ≤ n → (w n) f = ν f) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), w n ≠ ν) ∨
            ∃ μ,
              Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) w₀ μ ∧
                μ ≠ ν ∧
                  ∃ ι x,
                    ∃ (_ : Nonempty ι) (_ : NoMaxOrder ι),
                      ∃ F,
                        (∀ (i : ι) (f : Polynomial K),
                            ν f ≤ Singularity.augmentedValuationFun μ (F.key i) (F.value i) f) ∧
                          (∀ (i : ι) (a : Polynomial K), a.degree < (F.key i).degree → ν a = μ a) ∧
                            ∀ (f : Polynomial K), F.IsStable f ∧ F.stableValue f = ν f)

Singularity.reflTransGen_monomialValuati.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {Γ₀ : Type uV} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
  {ν : Valuation (Polynomial K) Γ₀} {v : Valuation K Γ₀},
  (∀ (a : K), ν (Polynomial.C a) = v a) →
    ∀ {F : Polynomial K},
      F ≠ 0 →
        ν F = 0 →
          Relation.ReflTransGen (Singularity.MacLaneVaquieStep ν) (Singularity.monomialValuation v (ν Polynomial.X)) ν

Singularity.residualLogJacobian_not_le_s.type:

      ∀ {i : σ},
        i ∈ Δ →

Singularity.residualOrder.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.residualOrderAlong.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Finset σ → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k → ℕ∞

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_add_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {Δ' : Finset σ} {q B : ℕ} {F' : MvPolynomial σ k} {N : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ', N i = 0) →
    (∀ β ∈ F'.support, N ≤ β) →
      Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart q F') + ↑q ≤ ↑B →
        Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ' q F' + ↑(Finsupp.degree N + q) ≤ ↑B

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (Δ : Finset σ) (e : ℕ)
  (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e) = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) F

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_cleanPart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (q : ℕ) (Δ : Finset σ) (P : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ q (Singularity.cleanPart q P) = Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ q P

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          ∀ {m : ℕ},
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g = ↑m →
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') = ↑m →
                (∀ i ∈ Δ, i ≠ j → t i = 0) →
                  Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) p g' ≤
                    Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_empty.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (q : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {q : ℕ} {r : σ →₀ ℕ} {G : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean q ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) →
    (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
      (∀ i ∈ Δ, ∃ d ∈ G.support, d i = 0) →
        Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ q ((MvPolynomial.monomial r) 1 * G) = Singularity.ord G

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_eq_logJac.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g →
    Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g = Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + Singularity.logJacobianType Δ p g

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_le_logJac.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g ≤ Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq σ] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ}
  {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k} {g F : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (h : MvPolynomial σ k), ψ (φ h) = h) →
    (∀ l ∈ Δ, ∃ c, φ (MvPolynomial.X l) = MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X l) →
      (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
        (∀ (i : σ), MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (ψ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = 0) →
          g ≠ 0 →
            Singularity.IsClean p g →
              Singularity.logJacobian Δ F = Ideal.map φ (Singularity.logJacobian Δ g) →
                Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p F ≤ Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_le_of_bou.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {e d n : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F →
    Singularity.ord (F.divMonomial (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) = ↑d →
      p ^ e ≤ Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) + d →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
          Singularity.ord (Singularity.cleanPart (p ^ e) F') + ↑(p ^ e) ≤
              ↑(n +
                  (Finsupp.degree (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F) +
                        Finsupp.degree (Singularity.chartExponent j t (Singularity.divisorExponent Δ F)) +
                      d +
                    d)) →
            Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (p ^ e) F' ≤
              Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) F + ↑n

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_ne_top.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (p : ℕ) {Δ : Finset σ} {g : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 → Singularity.IsClean p g → Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g ≠ ⊤

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_pointChar.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {e : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F →
    ↑(p ^ e) ≤ Singularity.ord F →
      (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
        Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (p ^ e) F' ≤
          Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) F + ↑(p ^ (e - 1))

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) p g' ≤
            Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g + 1

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  g ≠ 0 →
    Singularity.IsClean p g →
      ↑p ≤ Singularity.ord g →
        (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
          Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) p g' ≤
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') + 1 ∧
            Singularity.logJacobianOrder (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (Singularity.cleanPart p g') + 1 ≤
                Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1 ∧
              Singularity.logJacobianOrder Δ g + 1 ≤ Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ p g + 1

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP k p] (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k) {e m : ℕ} {F F' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  Singularity.IsClean (p ^ e) F →
    ↑(p ^ e) ≤ Singularity.ord F →
      Singularity.ord F = ↑m →
        ¬p ^ e ∣ m →
          (Singularity.pointChart j t) F = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p ^ e * F' →
            Singularity.residualOrderAlong (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) (p ^ e) F' ≤
              Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ (p ^ e) F

Singularity.residualOrderAlong_zero.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (Δ : Finset σ) (q : ℕ), Singularity.residualOrderAlong Δ q 0 = ⊤

Singularity.residualOrder_add_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (F h : MvPolynomial σ k),

Singularity.residualOrder_eq_ord_cleanPa.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [PerfectRing k p] (e : ℕ)

Singularity.residualOrder_eq_ord_of_add_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F h : MvPolynomial σ k},

Singularity.residualOrder_eq_ord_of_isCl.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) {F : MvPolynomial σ k},

Singularity.residualOrder_le_ord_cleanPa.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial σ k),
