Singularity.residueIntermediateField.type:
{K : Type u_1} →
  {L : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field K] →
      [inst_1 : Field L] →
        [inst_2 : Algebra K L] →
          {Γ₀ : Type u_3} →
            {Γ₁ : Type u_4} →
              [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] →
                [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] →
                  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) →
                    (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) →
                      [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] →
                        IntermediateField K L →
                          IntermediateField (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
                            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vL.valuationSubring)

Singularity.residueIntermediateField_adj.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
      (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
        Singularity.residueIntermediateField vK vL
            (IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) fun j => ↑(y j)))) =
          IntermediateField.adjoin (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
            (Set.range fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j))

Singularity.residue_aeval_eq_aeval_map_r.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] (z : ↥vL.valuationSubring)
  (p : Polynomial ↥vK.valuationSubring),
  (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) ((Polynomial.aeval z) p) =
    (Polynomial.aeval ((IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) z))
      (Polynomial.map (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vK.valuationSubring) p)

Singularity.residue_mem_adjoin_of_hasExt.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
      (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
        ∀ (z : ↥vL.valuationSubring),
          ↑z ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) fun j => ↑(y j))) →
            (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) z ∈
              IntermediateField.adjoin (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
                (Set.range fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j))

Singularity.residue_mem_adjoin_of_mem_ad.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {V : ValuationSubring K}
  [inst_3 : Algebra k ↥V] [IsScalarTower k (↥V) K] {ι : Type u_3} {κ : Type u_4} [inst_5 : Fintype ι] {x : ι → K}
  {y : κ → ↥V},
  (∀ (i : ι), x i ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (a : ι → ℤ), V.valuation (Singularity.laurentMonomial x a) = 1 → a = 0) →
      (AlgebraicIndependent k fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y j)) →
        ∀ (c : ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x fun j => ↑(y j))))) (hc : ↑c ∈ V),
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) ⟨↑c, hc⟩ ∈
            IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range fun j => (IsLocalRing.residue ↥V) (y j))

Singularity.reynolds.type:
{G : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Group G] →
      [inst_1 : Fintype G] → [inst_2 : CommRing B] → [MulSemiringAction G B] → IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G) → B → B

Singularity.reynoldsIdeal.type:
{G : Type u_1} →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Group G] →
      [inst_1 : Fintype G] →
        [inst_2 : CommRing B] →
          [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B] →
            IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G) → Ideal ↥(Singularity.invariantSubring G B) → Ideal B

Singularity.reynolds_add.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B] (hG : IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G)) (x y : B),
  Singularity.reynolds hG (x + y) = Singularity.reynolds hG x + Singularity.reynolds hG y

Singularity.reynolds_mem.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B] (hG : IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G)) (b : B),
  Singularity.reynolds hG b ∈ Singularity.invariantSubring G B

Singularity.reynolds_mul_of_mem.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B] (hG : IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G)) {a : B},
  a ∈ Singularity.invariantSubring G B → ∀ (b : B), Singularity.reynolds hG (a * b) = a * Singularity.reynolds hG b

Singularity.reynolds_of_mem.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B] (hG : IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G)) {a : B},
  a ∈ Singularity.invariantSubring G B → Singularity.reynolds hG a = a

Singularity.reynolds_smul_inv_card.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B] (hG : IsUnit ↑(Fintype.card G)) (g : G), g • ↑hG.unit⁻¹ = ↑hG.unit⁻¹

Singularity.reynolds_smul_natCast.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B] [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B]
  (g : G) (n : ℕ), g • ↑n = ↑n

Singularity.reynolds_smul_sum.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] [inst_2 : CommRing B]
  [inst_3 : MulSemiringAction G B] (g : G) (b : B), g • ∑ h, h • b = ∑ h, h • b

Singularity.rid_comp_lTensor_comp_tensor.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra A B] (M : Type u_3)
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_4 : Module A M] {s : B →ₗ[A] A},
  (∀ (a : A), s ((algebraMap A B) a) = a) →
    ↑(TensorProduct.rid A M) ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor M s ∘ₗ Singularity.tensorOneMap A B M = LinearMap.id

Singularity.ringKrullDim_eq_natCard_conv.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) [Finite { H // Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup H }],
  ringKrullDim ↥V = ↑(Nat.card { H // Singularity.IsConvexSubgroup H } - 1)

Singularity.ringKrullDim_integralClosure.type:
∀ (B : Type u_2) (L : Type u_3) [inst : CommRing B] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra B L],
  ringKrullDim ↥(integralClosure B L) ≤ ringKrullDim B

Singularity.ringKrullDim_le_of_isIntegra.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) (S : Type u_2) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  [Algebra.IsIntegral R S], ringKrullDim S ≤ ringKrullDim R

Singularity.ringKrullDim_le_of_trdeg_le.type:
∀ {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [inst_4 : Field K] [inst_5 : Algebra k K] (f : A →ₐ[k] K),
  Function.Injective ⇑f → ∀ {n : ℕ}, Algebra.trdeg k K ≤ ↑n → ringKrullDim A ≤ ↑n

Singularity.ringKrullDim_p1Ring_le.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), ringKrullDim (Singularity.P1Ring k p n g) ≤ ↑n

Singularity.rootHom.type:
{E : Type u_1} →
  {E' : Type u_2} →
    [inst : Field E] →
      [inst_1 : Field E'] →
        [inst_2 : Algebra E E'] →
          (R : Subring E) →
            {p : ℕ} →
              {y : ↥R} → {z : E'} → (algebraMap E E') ↑y = z ^ p → AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C y) →+* E'

Singularity.rootHom_mem.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {E' : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Field E']
  [inst_3 : Algebra k E] [inst_4 : Algebra E E'] {W : ValuationSubring E'} {A : Subalgebra k E},
  (∀ a ∈ A, a ∈ W.comap (algebraMap E E')) →
    ∀ {R : Subring E},
      R ≤ Singularity.centerSubring (W.comap (algebraMap E E')) A.toSubring →
        ∀ {p : ℕ},
          p ≠ 0 →
            ∀ {y : ↥R} {z : E'} (hy : (algebraMap E E') ↑y = z ^ p)
              (b : AdjoinRoot (Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C y)), (Singularity.rootHom R hy) b ∈ W

Singularity.rootHom_mk.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {E' : Type u_2} [inst : Field E] [inst_1 : Field E'] [inst_2 : Algebra E E'] (R : Subring E) {p : ℕ}
  {y : ↥R} {z : E'} (hy : (algebraMap E E') ↑y = z ^ p) (q : Polynomial ↥R),
  (Singularity.rootHom R hy) ((AdjoinRoot.mk (Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C y)) q) =
    (Polynomial.aeval z) (Polynomial.map R.subtype q)

Singularity.root_pow_inseparableField.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  AdjoinRoot.root (Singularity.inseparablePoly p) ^ p = (AdjoinRoot.of (Singularity.inseparablePoly p)) RatFunc.X

Singularity.sInf_linWeight_projPolyhedro.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k))
  {w : σ → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : σ), 0 ≤ w j) →
    (Singularity.projPolyhedron f).Nonempty →
      sInf (Singularity.linWeight w '' Singularity.projPolyhedron f) = sInf (Singularity.projWeights f w)

Singularity.scaleAll.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.scaleAll_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  Singularity.scaleAll ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) c) =
    Polynomial.C ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) c) * (1 + Polynomial.X) ^ Finsupp.degree β

Singularity.scaleVar.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.scaleVar_comp_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (c : k),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X none) fun i => MvPolynomial.X (some i)).comp
      (MvPolynomial.rename some) =
    MvPolynomial.rename some

Singularity.scaleVar_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (c : k) (v : σ → k),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o => o.elim (MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X none) fun i => MvPolynomial.X (some i)).comp
      (Singularity.translate v) =
    Singularity.translate (c • v)

Singularity.scaleVar_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.scaleVar j) ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) c) =
    Polynomial.C ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) c) * (1 + Polynomial.X) ^ β j

Singularity.scaleVar_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (P : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.scaleVar j) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) P) =
    Polynomial.map (↑(Singularity.pointChart j t)) (Singularity.scaleAll P)

Singularity.separable_distillation.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) (L : Type u_2) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L],
  FiniteDimensional L ↥(IntermediateField.normalClosure K L (AlgebraicClosure L)) ∧
    IsPurelyInseparable K ↥(IntermediateField.fixedField ⊤) ∧
      IsGalois ↥(IntermediateField.fixedField ⊤) ↥(IntermediateField.normalClosure K L (AlgebraicClosure L))

Singularity.separable_one_add_X_pow_four.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {u : R}, 2 * u = 1 → (1 + Polynomial.X ^ 4).Separable

Singularity.separable_one_add_X_pow_succ.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p], (1 + Polynomial.X ^ (p + 1)).Separable

Singularity.shiftT.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → (σ → MvPolynomial σ R) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ R)

Singularity.shiftT_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (b : σ → MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ),
  (Singularity.shiftT b) (MvPolynomial.X i) = Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X i) + Polynomial.C (b i) * Polynomial.X

Singularity.shiftVar_comp_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (w : σ → k),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o =>
          o.elim (MvPolynomial.X none) fun i =>
            MvPolynomial.X (some i) + MvPolynomial.C (w i) * MvPolynomial.X none).comp
      (MvPolynomial.rename some) =
    Singularity.translate w

Singularity.shiftVar_comp_translate.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] (v w : σ → k),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval fun o =>
          o.elim (MvPolynomial.X none) fun i =>
            MvPolynomial.X (some i) + MvPolynomial.C (w i) * MvPolynomial.X none).comp
      (Singularity.translate v) =
    Singularity.translate (v + w)

Singularity.single_add_centerExponent_eq.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] {Δ S : Finset σ}
  {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {r : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (∀ i ∉ Δ, r i = 0) →
    ∀ (c : ℕ) {i : σ},
      i ∉ Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t → ((fun₀ | j => c) + Singularity.centerExponent S j t r) i = 0

Singularity.single_nonneg.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (j l : σ), 0 ≤ Pi.single j 1 l

Singularity.smul_add_X_mul_pderiv_mem_re.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {Δ : Finset σ} {i : σ},
  i ∈ Δ →
    ∀ (r : σ →₀ ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial σ k),
      ↑(r i) • G + MvPolynomial.X i * (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) G ∈ Singularity.residualLogJacobian Δ r G

Singularity.smul_orthant.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {c : ℝ}, 0 < c → c • Singularity.orthant σ = Singularity.orthant σ

Singularity.smul_pderiv_X.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (c : MvPolynomial σ k) (i l : σ),
  (c • MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (MvPolynomial.X l) = if l = i then c else 0

Singularity.some_optionElim.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (i : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.optionElim i d).some = d

Singularity.span_X_mul_logJacobian_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ S : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) * Singularity.logJacobian Δ g ≤ Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g

Singularity.span_X_pow_le_centerDegreeId.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (n : ℕ),
  Ideal.span (MvPolynomial.X '' ↑S) ^ n ≤ Singularity.centerDegreeIdeal S n

Singularity.span_eq_top_of_span_eq_span_.type:
∀ {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing B] [IsDomain B] {S : Set B} {m : B},
  m ≠ 0 → Ideal.span S = Ideal.span {m} → Ideal.span {c | m * c ∈ S} = ⊤

Singularity.span_four_eq_top_of_comb.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {a b c d r s t w : R},
  r * a + s * b + t * c + w * d = 1 → Ideal.span {a, b, c, d} = ⊤

Singularity.span_image_mul.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (r : R) (S : Set R),
  Ideal.span ((fun x => r * x) '' S) = Submodule.map (LinearMap.mulLeft R r) (Ideal.span S)

Singularity.span_inseparableCurve_point.type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)],
  Ideal.span
      {(AdjoinRoot.of (Singularity.inseparableCurvePoly p)) (Singularity.inseparablePoly p),
        AdjoinRoot.root (Singularity.inseparableCurvePoly p)} =
    Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root (Singularity.inseparableCurvePoly p)}

Singularity.span_mul_logJacobian_centerC.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (Δ S : Finset σ)
  {j : σ},
  j ∈ S →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
      Ideal.span {Singularity.centerUnit Δ S j t} *
          Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t) ((Singularity.centerChart S j t) g) ≤
        Ideal.map (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g)

Singularity.span_mul_logJacobian_le_map_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ S : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  j ∈ S →
    (Singularity.centerChart S j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * Singularity.centerUnit Δ S j t} *
          Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.centerDivisor Δ S j t) g' ≤
        Ideal.map (Singularity.centerChart S j t) (Singularity.logJacobianCenter Δ S g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ]
  (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  (Singularity.pointChart j t) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
    Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * Singularity.blowupUnit Δ j t} *
        Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) g' ≤
      Ideal.map (Singularity.pointChart j t) (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g)

∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ] (p : ℕ)
  [CharP k p] {Δ : Finset σ} {j : σ} {t : σ → k} {g g' : MvPolynomial σ k},
  t j = 0 →
    (Singularity.pointChart j 0) g = MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * g' →
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X j ^ p * (Singularity.translateBy (-t)) (Singularity.blowupUnit Δ j t)} *
          Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) g' ≤
        Ideal.map (Singularity.pointChart j 0) (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g)

Singularity.span_mul_logJacobian_pointCh.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k] [Fintype σ]
  (Δ : Finset σ) (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Ideal.span {Singularity.blowupUnit Δ j t} *
      Singularity.logJacobian (Singularity.blowupDivisor Δ j t) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) g) ≤
    Ideal.map (Singularity.pointChart j t) (Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g)

Singularity.span_pow_le_span_pow.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (t : R) {a b : ℕ}, a ≤ b → Ideal.span {t ^ b} ≤ Ideal.span {t ^ a}

Singularity.span_range_X_mul_logJacobian.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (Δ : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ k),
  Ideal.span (Set.range MvPolynomial.X) * Singularity.logJacobian Δ g ≤ Singularity.logJacobianTangent Δ g

Singularity.span_range_changeParam.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : CommSemiring R] (x : ι → R) (i : ι) {v : R},
  IsUnit v → Ideal.span (Set.range (Singularity.changeParam x i v)) = Ideal.span (Set.range x)

Singularity.span_singleton_le_directrix_.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {i : σ} {n : ℕ},
  n ≠ 0 → ∀ {w : σ → k}, w i = 0 → k ∙ w ≤ Singularity.directrix (MvPolynomial.X i ^ n)

Singularity.span_taylorMonomial.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (δ : ι → Derivation k A A) (y : ι → A) (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  [CharP A p],
  (∀ (l j : ι) (a : A), (δ l) ((δ j) a) = (δ j) ((δ l) a)) →
    (∀ (l : ι), ↑(δ l) ^ p = 0) →
      (∀ (j l : ι), (δ j) (y l) = if j = l then 1 else 0) →
        Submodule.span (↥(Singularity.constants δ)) (Set.range fun c => Singularity.taylorMonomial y fun l => ↑(c l)) =
          ⊤

Singularity.sq_mul_one_add_sq_of_mul_one.type: ∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [CharP R 2] {x θ : R}, θ * (1 + x) = x → θ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2) = x ^ 2

Singularity.stableDerivations.type:
(k : Type u_1) →
  {B : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing k] → [inst_1 : CommRing B] → [inst_2 : Algebra k B] → Ideal B → Submodule B (Derivation k B B)

Singularity.stable_of_valuationSubring_u.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {E : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra K E] {Γ : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] (w : Valuation E Γ),
  (∀ (B : ValuationSubring E),
      B.comap (algebraMap K E) = (Valuation.comap (algebraMap K E) w).valuationSubring → B = w.valuationSubring) →

Singularity.taylorBasis.type:
{k : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} →
    {ι : Type u_3} →
      [inst : CommRing k] →
        [inst_1 : CommRing A] →
          [inst_2 : Algebra k A] →
            [Fintype ι] →
              [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] →
                (δ : ι → Derivation k A A) →
                  (y : ι → A) →
                    (p : ℕ) →
                      [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] →
                        [CharP A p] →
                          (∀ (l j : ι) (a : A), (δ l) ((δ j) a) = (δ j) ((δ l) a)) →
                            (∀ (l : ι), ↑(δ l) ^ p = 0) →
                              (∀ (j l : ι), (δ j) (y l) = if j = l then 1 else 0) →
                                Module.Basis (ι → Fin p) (↥(Singularity.constants δ)) A

Singularity.taylorBasis_apply.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (δ : ι → Derivation k A A) (y : ι → A) (p : ℕ)
  [inst_5 : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [inst_6 : CharP A p] (hcomm : ∀ (l j : ι) (a : A), (δ l) ((δ j) a) = (δ j) ((δ l) a))
  (hδ : ∀ (l : ι), ↑(δ l) ^ p = 0) (hy : ∀ (j l : ι), (δ j) (y l) = if j = l then 1 else 0) (c : ι → Fin p),
  (Singularity.taylorBasis δ y p hcomm hδ hy) c = Singularity.taylorMonomial y fun l => ↑(c l)

Singularity.taylorMonomial.type: {A : Type u_2} → {ι : Type u_3} → [CommRing A] → [Fintype ι] → (ι → A) → (ι → ℕ) → A

Singularity.taylorMonomial_eq_mul.type:
∀ {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (y : ι → A)
  (c : ι → ℕ) (j : ι), Singularity.taylorMonomial y c = y j ^ c j * Singularity.taylorMonomial y (Function.update c j 0)

Singularity.taylorMonomial_update.type:
∀ {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (y : ι → A)
  (c : ι → ℕ) (j : ι) (i : ℕ),
  c j = 0 → Singularity.taylorMonomial y (Function.update c j i) = y j ^ i * Singularity.taylorMonomial y c

Singularity.taylorMonomials.type: {A : Type u_2} → {ι : Type u_3} → [CommRing A] → [Fintype ι] → (ι → A) → ℕ → Finset ι → Set A

Singularity.taylorVar.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} → [inst : Field k] → [DecidableEq σ] → σ → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] Polynomial (MvPolynomial σ k)

Singularity.taylorVar_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (β : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  (Singularity.taylorVar i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial β) c) =
    Polynomial.C ((MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.erase i β)) c) *
      (Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X i) + Polynomial.X) ^ β i

Singularity.taylorVar_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {i j : σ},
  i ≠ j →
    ∀ (t : σ → k) (P : MvPolynomial σ k),
      (Singularity.taylorVar i) ((Singularity.pointChart j t) P) =
        (Polynomial.map (↑(Singularity.pointChart j t)) ((Singularity.taylorVar i) P)).comp
          (Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X j) * Polynomial.X)

Singularity.taylor_X_pow_add_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (φ F : MvPowerSeries σ k),
  (Polynomial.taylor φ) (Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C F) = Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e + Polynomial.C (φ ^ p ^ e + F)

Singularity.taylor_X_pow_sub_C_char.type:
∀ {p : ℕ} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing R] [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP R p] (θ f : R),
  (Polynomial.taylor θ) (Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C f) = Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.C (f - θ ^ p)

Singularity.taylor_X_sq_add_C_sq_add.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [CharP k 2] (φ G : MvPowerSeries σ k),
  (Polynomial.taylor φ) (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (φ ^ 2 + G)) = Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C G

Singularity.taylor_coeff_eq_zero.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A] (δ : Derivation k A A)
  (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP A p] {y : A},
  δ y = 1 → ∀ m ≤ p, ∀ (b : ℕ → A), (∀ (i : ℕ), δ (b i) = 0) → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, y ^ i * b i = 0 → ∀ i < m, b i = 0

Singularity.taylor_coeff_unique.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A] (δ : Derivation k A A)
  (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP A p] {y : A},
  δ y = 1 →
    ∀ {a b : ℕ → A},
      (∀ (i : ℕ), δ (a i) = 0) →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), δ (b i) = 0) →
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, y ^ i * a i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, y ^ i * b i → ∀ i < p, a i = b i

Singularity.taylor_example_3_1_7.type:
∀ {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [CharP k 2],
  (Polynomial.taylor (MvPowerSeries.X 0))
      (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.X 0 ^ 2 + MvPowerSeries.X 1 ^ 3)) =
    Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C (MvPowerSeries.X 1 ^ 3)

Singularity.taylor_indep_aux.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (δ : ι → Derivation k A A) (y : ι → A) (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  [CharP A p],
  (∀ (j l : ι), (δ j) (y l) = if j = l then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (T : Type u_4) (S : Finset ι) (F : Finset T) (e : T → ι → ℕ) (g : T → A),
      Set.InjOn e ↑F →
        (∀ t ∈ F, ∀ (l : ι), e t l < p) →
          (∀ t ∈ F, ∀ l ∉ S, e t l = 0) →
            (∀ t ∈ F, ∀ (l : ι), (δ l) (g t) = 0) →
              ∑ t ∈ F, g t * Singularity.taylorMonomial y (e t) = 0 → ∀ t ∈ F, g t = 0

Singularity.taylor_span_aux.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra k A]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (δ : ι → Derivation k A A) (y : ι → A) (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  [CharP A p],
  (∀ (l j : ι) (a : A), (δ l) ((δ j) a) = (δ j) ((δ l) a)) →
    (∀ (l : ι), ↑(δ l) ^ p = 0) →
      (∀ (j l : ι), (δ j) (y l) = if j = l then 1 else 0) →
        ∀ (S : Finset ι) (a : A),
          (∀ l ∉ S, (δ l) a = 0) → a ∈ Submodule.span (↥(Singularity.constants δ)) (Singularity.taylorMonomials y p S)

Singularity.tensorOneMap.type:
(A : Type u_1) →
  (B : Type u_2) →
    [inst : CommRing A] →
      [inst_1 : CommRing B] →
        [inst_2 : Algebra A B] →
          (M : Type u_3) → [inst_3 : AddCommGroup M] → [inst_4 : Module A M] → M →ₗ[A] TensorProduct A M B

Singularity.tensorOneMap_apply.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : CommRing B] [inst_2 : Algebra A B] (M : Type u_3)
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_4 : Module A M] (m : M), (Singularity.tensorOneMap A B M) m = m ⊗ₜ[A] 1

Singularity.toLex_le_toLex_of_or.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : Preorder β] {a a' : α} {b b' : β},
  a < a' ∨ a = a' ∧ b ≤ b' → toLex (a, b) ≤ toLex (a', b')

Singularity.toLex_lt_toLex_of_lt.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : Preorder β] {a a' : α} (b b' : β),
  a < a' → toLex (a, b) < toLex (a', b')

Singularity.toLocalSubring_eq_ofPrime_ce.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] (P : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (Polynomial k)),
  (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation (RatFunc k) P).valuationSubring.toLocalSubring =
    LocalSubring.ofPrime (Singularity.polynomialChart k)
      (Singularity.centerIdeal (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation (RatFunc k) P).valuationSubring
        (Singularity.polynomialChart k) ⋯)

Singularity.toNat_weightedOrd_nsmul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (w : σ → ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.weightedOrd (n • w) g).toNat = n * (Singularity.weightedOrd w g).toNat

Singularity.topologicalKrullDim_p1Hypers.type:
∀ {k : Type u} [inst : Field k] {p n : ℕ},
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k), topologicalKrullDim ↥(Singularity.P1Hypersurface k p n g) ≤ ↑n

Singularity.toricChar.type: {n : ℕ} → {G : Type u_1} → [inst : CommGroup G] → (Fin n → G) → (Fin n → ℤ) →+ Additive G

Singularity.toricChar_apply.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] (y : Fin n → G) (a : Fin n → ℤ),
  Additive.toMul ((Singularity.toricChar y) a) = Singularity.toricMonomial y a

Singularity.toricExample_monomials.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] {z x₁ x₂ : K},
  z ≠ 0 → z ^ 3 = x₁ * x₂ → z = x₁ * (x₂ / z ^ 2) ∧ x₂ = x₁ ^ 2 * (x₂ / z ^ 2) ^ 3

Singularity.toricMonomial.type: {n : ℕ} → {G : Type u_1} → [CommGroup G] → (Fin n → G) → (Fin n → ℤ) → G

Singularity.toricMonomial_eq_prod_pow.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] (y : Fin n → G) {B C : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ},
  C * B = 1 →
    ∀ {a : Fin n → ℤ},
      (∀ (l : Fin n), 0 ≤ Matrix.vecMul a C l) →
        Singularity.toricMonomial y a = ∏ l, Singularity.toricMonomial y (B l) ^ (Matrix.vecMul a C l).toNat

Singularity.toricMonomial_single.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] (y : Fin n → G) (j : Fin n),
  Singularity.toricMonomial y (Pi.single j 1) = y j

Singularity.toricMonomial_toricParamVec.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] {p : ℕ} {r : Fin n → ℕ} {z₀ : Fin n} {x : Fin n → G} {z : G},
  z ^ p = x z₀ * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase z₀, x j ^ r j →
    ∀ (i : Fin n), Singularity.toricMonomial (Function.update x z₀ z) (Singularity.toricParamVec p r z₀ i) = x i

Singularity.toricMonomial_vecMul.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G] (y : Fin n → G) (c : Fin n → ℤ) (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ),
  Singularity.toricMonomial y (Matrix.vecMul c B) = ∏ l, Singularity.toricMonomial y (B l) ^ c l

Singularity.toricOrderHom.type: {n : ℕ} → {Γ : Type u_1} → [inst : AddCommGroup Γ] → ((Fin n → ℤ) →+ Γ) → (Fin n → ℤ) →+ Lex (Γ × Lex (Fin n → ℤ))

Singularity.toricOrderHom_injective.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup Γ] (ℓ : (Fin n → ℤ) →+ Γ),
  Function.Injective ⇑(Singularity.toricOrderHom ℓ)

Singularity.toricOrderHom_pos_iff.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] (ℓ : (Fin n → ℤ) →+ Γ)
  (a : Fin n → ℤ), 0 < (Singularity.toricOrderHom ℓ) a ↔ 0 < ℓ a ∨ ℓ a = 0 ∧ 0 < toLex a

Singularity.toricParamVec.type: {n : ℕ} → ℕ → (Fin n → ℕ) → Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℤ

Singularity.toricParamVec_of_ne.type: ∀ {n p : ℕ} {r : Fin n → ℕ} {z₀ i : Fin n}, i ≠ z₀ → Singularity.toricParamVec p r z₀ i = Pi.single i 1

Singularity.toricParamVec_self.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (r : Fin n → ℕ) (z₀ : Fin n),
  Singularity.toricParamVec p r z₀ z₀ = p • Pi.single z₀ 1 - ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase z₀, r j • Pi.single j 1

Singularity.toric_pos_single.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup Γ] [inst_1 : LinearOrder Γ] [IsOrderedAddMonoid Γ] {p : ℕ} (r : Fin n → ℕ)
  (z₀ : Fin n) (ℓ : (Fin n → ℤ) →+ Γ),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < ℓ (Singularity.toricParamVec p r z₀ i)) → 0 < ℓ (Pi.single z₀ 1)

Singularity.toric_prod_eq_of_sum_eq_one.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (Y : Fin n → R) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin n)),
  ∑ j ∈ J, c j = 1 → ∃ j₀ ∈ J, ∏ j, Y j ^ c j = (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ \ J, Y j ^ c j) * Y j₀

Singularity.toric_prod_mem_sq.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} (Y : Fin n → R) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin n)),
  (∀ j ∈ J, Y j ∈ I) → 2 ≤ ∑ j ∈ J, c j → ∏ j, Y j ^ c j ∈ I ^ 2

Singularity.toric_sum_pos_of_prod_mem.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {Q : Ideal R},
  Q.IsPrime →
    ∀ (Y : Fin n → R) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ j ∉ J, Y j ∉ Q) → ∏ j, Y j ^ c j ∈ Q → 0 < ∑ j ∈ J, c j

Singularity.totalDegree_aeval_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] {φ : σ → MvPolynomial σ k},
  (∀ (i : σ), (φ i).totalDegree ≤ 1) → ∀ (p : MvPolynomial σ k), ((MvPolynomial.aeval φ) p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree

Singularity.totalDegree_chartRest_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k),
  ((Singularity.chartRest j t) p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree

Singularity.totalDegree_chartShift_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (t : σ → k) (p : MvPolynomial σ k),
  ((Singularity.chartShift j t) p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree

    1 ≤ f.natDegree →

        ↑f.natDegree * u = 1 →
          ∀ {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
            Singularity.expToReal v ∈
                Set.extremePoints ℝ
                  (Singularity.projPolyhedron
                    ((Polynomial.taylor (-(f.coeff (f.natDegree - 1) * MvPowerSeries.C u))) f)) →
              ∀ (c : k),

                    v c

Singularity.tschirnhausen_pointChart.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] {m : ℕ},
  ↑m ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k},
      a (m - 1) = 0 →
        (∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a i)) →
          ∀ {c : Option σ} {t : Option σ → k} {f' : MvPolynomial (Option σ) k},
            (Singularity.pointChart c t) (Singularity.zMonic m a) = MvPolynomial.X c ^ m * f' →
              ↑m ≤ Singularity.ord f' →
                ∃ j,
                  c = some j ∧
                    t none = 0 ∧
                      ∃ a',
                        f' = Singularity.zMonic m a' ∧
                          a' (m - 1) = 0 ∧
                            (∀ i < m, ↑(m - i) ≤ Singularity.ord (a' i)) ∧
                              ∀ i < m,
                                (Singularity.pointChart j fun l => t (some l)) (a i) = MvPolynomial.X j ^ (m - i) * a' i

  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) {ι : Type u_5} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>

                vL ((algebraMap K L) c') * ↑(b.prod fun i n => (Units.map ↑vL) (x i) ^ n) →

  (∀ (c : k), c ≠ 0 → v ((algebraMap k (RatFunc k)) c) = 1) →
    v RatFunc.X⁻¹ < 1 → ∀ (x : RatFunc k), v x ≤ 1 ↔ x = 0 ∨ x.num.natDegree ≤ x.denom.natDegree

Singularity.valuation_le_one_iff_not_den.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] {Γ : Type u_2} [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
  (v : Valuation (RatFunc k) Γ),
  (∀ (f : Polynomial k), v ((algebraMap (Polynomial k) (RatFunc k)) f) ≤ 1) →
    ∀ (x : RatFunc k), v x ≤ 1 ↔ ¬v ((algebraMap (Polynomial k) (RatFunc k)) x.denom) < 1

Singularity.valuation_lt_one_iff_eq_zero.type: ∀ {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field L] (W : ValuationSubring L) (x : L), W.valuation x < 1 ↔ x = 0 ∨ x⁻¹ ∉ W

Singularity.valuation_ne_of_sq_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (w : Valuation L Γ),
  (Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) w).IsEquiv v →
    ∀ {t : K} {m : ℤ},
      Odd m → v t = WithZero.exp m → ∀ {s : L}, s ^ 2 = (algebraMap K L) t → ∀ (a : K), w s ≠ w ((algebraMap K L) a)

Singularity.valuation_ne_zero_of_ne_zero.type: ∀ {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (V : ValuationSubring K) {z : K}, z ≠ 0 → V.valuation z ≠ 0

Singularity.valuation_pow_eq_of_one_lt_v.type:
∀ {L : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Ring L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation L Γ₀)
  {n : ℕ}, 2 ≤ n → ∀ {η : L}, 1 < v (η ^ n - η) → v η ^ n = v (η ^ n - η)

Singularity.valuation_pow_sub_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {w : Valuation L Γ₀} {z : L},
  z ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {l m : ℕ},
      l < m →
        ∀ {a b : K},
          a ≠ 0 →
            w ((algebraMap K L) a * z ^ m) = w ((algebraMap K L) b * z ^ l) →
              w (z ^ (m - l)) = w ((algebraMap K L) (b / a))

Singularity.valuation_pow_sub_self_le_on.type:
∀ {L : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Ring L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation L Γ₀)
  {n : ℕ} {η : L}, v η ≤ 1 → v (η ^ n - η) ≤ 1

Singularity.valuation_pow_sub_self_of_on.type:
∀ {L : Type u_1} {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : Ring L] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] (v : Valuation L Γ₀)
  {n : ℕ}, 2 ≤ n → ∀ {η : L}, 1 < v η → v (η ^ n - η) = v η ^ n

Singularity.valuation_prod_sub_one_lt_on.type:
∀ {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field L] {ι : Type u_3} (W : ValuationSubring L) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → L),
  (∀ i ∈ s, W.valuation (f i - 1) < 1) → W.valuation (∏ i ∈ s, f i - 1) < 1

Singularity.valuation_sub_eq_one_of_sq_e.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra k L] {Γ : Type u_3}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] (w : Valuation L Γ),
  (∀ (c : k), c ≠ 0 → w ((algebraMap k L) c) = 1) →
    ∀ {c : k}, ¬IsSquare c → ∀ {s : L}, s ^ 2 = (algebraMap k L) c → ∀ (b : k), w (s - (algebraMap k L) b) = 1

Singularity.valuation_sum_mul_le.type:
∀ {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {R : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Ring R] (v : Valuation R Γ₀)
  {ι : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} {F : ι → R} {c C : Γ₀}, (∀ i ∈ s, v (F i) * c ≤ C) → v (∑ i ∈ s, F i) * c ≤ C

Singularity.valuation_sum_mul_lt.type:
∀ {Γ₀ : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] {R : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Ring R] (v : Valuation R Γ₀)
  {ι : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} {F : ι → R} {c C : Γ₀}, 0 < C → (∀ i ∈ s, v (F i) * c < C) → v (∑ i ∈ s, F i) * c < C

Singularity.valuation_trace_le.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} {E : Type u_3} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Field E]
  [inst_3 : Algebra K L] [inst_4 : Algebra K E] [inst_5 : Algebra L E] [IsScalarTower K L E] {Γ : Type u_4}
  [inst_7 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] [IsAlgClosed E] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K E] [FiniteDimensional K L]
  [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] (w : Valuation E Γ),
  (∀ (φ : E →ₐ[K] E) (x : E), w x ≤ 1 → w (φ x) ≤ 1) →
    ∀ (y : L), w ((algebraMap K E) ((Algebra.trace K L) y)) ≤ w ((algebraMap L E) y)

Singularity.valueGroup_adjoin_eq.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} (x : ι → Lˣ),
  (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
      Additive.ofMul
        ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
    ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
      (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
          (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
        ∀ (F : IntermediateField K L),
          F = IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range (Sum.elim (fun i => ↑(x i)) fun j => ↑(y j))) →
            (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap (↥F) L) vL)).valueGroup =
              (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup ⊔
                Subgroup.closure (Set.range fun i => (Units.map ↑vL) (x i))

Singularity.valueGroup_fg_and_residueFie.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type uL} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} {Γ₁ : Type uΓ}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vK : Valuation K Γ₀)
  (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL],
  ⊤.FG →
    Cardinal.lift.{uL, uΓ}
            (Module.rank ℤ
              (Additive
                ↥(Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup)
                    (↑vL).valueGroup))) +
          Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL}
            (Algebra.trdeg (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
              (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vL.valuationSubring)) =
        Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL} (Algebra.trdeg K L) →
      (∃ S, (↑vL).valueGroup = (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup ⊔ Subgroup.closure ↑S) ∧ ⊤.FG

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type uL} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} {Γ₁ : Type uΓ}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vK : Valuation K Γ₀)
  (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL],
  ⊤.FG →
    Cardinal.lift.{uL, uΓ}
            (Module.rank ℚ
              (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ
                (Additive
                  ↥(Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup)
                      (↑vL).valueGroup)))) +
          Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL}
            (Algebra.trdeg (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
              (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vL.valuationSubring)) =
        Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL} (Algebra.trdeg K L) →
      (∃ S, (↑vL).valueGroup = (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup ⊔ Subgroup.closure ↑S) ∧ ⊤.FG

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_3}
  {Γ₁ : Type u_4} [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁]
  (vK : Valuation K Γ₀) (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL] {ι : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} [Fintype ι]
  [Finite κ],
  ⊤.FG →
    ∀ (x : ι → Lˣ),
      (LinearIndependent ℤ fun i =>
          Additive.ofMul
            ((QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup) ((Units.map ↑vL) (x i)))) →
        ∀ (y : κ → ↥vL.valuationSubring),
          (AlgebraicIndependent (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring) fun j =>
              (IsLocalRing.residue ↥vL.valuationSubring) (y j)) →
            Algebra.trdeg K L ≤ ↑(Nat.card ι) + ↑(Nat.card κ) →
              (∃ S, (↑vL).valueGroup = (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup ⊔ Subgroup.closure ↑S) ∧ ⊤.FG

∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type uL} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : Field L] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {Γ₀ : Type u_2} {Γ₁ : Type uΓ}
  [inst_3 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀] [inst_4 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] (vK : Valuation K Γ₀)
  (vL : Valuation L Γ₁) [inst_5 : vK.HasExtension vL],
  ⊤.FG →
    Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL} (Algebra.trdeg K L) ≤
        Cardinal.lift.{uL, uΓ}
            (Module.rank ℤ
              (Additive
                ↥(Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup)
                    (↑vL).valueGroup))) +
          Cardinal.lift.{uΓ, uL}
            (Algebra.trdeg (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vK.valuationSubring)
              (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↥vL.valuationSubring)) →
      (∃ S, (↑vL).valueGroup = (↑(Valuation.comap (algebraMap K L) vL)).valueGroup ⊔ Subgroup.closure ↑S) ∧ ⊤.FG

Singularity.vertexPoly.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring k] → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → (σ →₀ ℕ) → Polynomial k

Singularity.vertexPoly_X_pow_add_C.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (F : MvPowerSeries σ k) (v : σ →₀ ℕ),
      Singularity.vertexPoly (Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C F) v =
        Polynomial.X ^ n + Polynomial.C ((MvPowerSeries.coeff (n • v)) F)

Singularity.vertexPoly_ne_X_pow.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Singularity.expToReal v ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) →
    Singularity.vertexPoly f v ≠ Polynomial.X ^ f.natDegree

Singularity.vertexPoly_taylor_monomial.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)) (v : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k),
  Singularity.vertexPoly ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial v) c)) f) v =
    (Polynomial.taylor c) (Singularity.vertexPoly f v)

Singularity.vertexPoly_taylor_of_isSolva.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ} {c : k},
  Singularity.IsSolvableVertex f v c →
    Singularity.vertexPoly ((Polynomial.taylor ((MvPowerSeries.monomial v) (-c))) f) v = Polynomial.X ^ f.natDegree

Singularity.vertexPoly_zero_eq_map.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] (f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)),

Singularity.weightInitialForm.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing k] → [Fintype σ] → (σ → ℝ) → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k) → Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)

Singularity.weightPart.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {k : Type u_2} → [CommRing k] → [Fintype σ] → (σ → ℝ) → ℝ → MvPowerSeries σ k → MvPowerSeries σ k

Singularity.weightPart_eq_monomial_of_is.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {w : σ → ℝ}
  {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)} {v : σ →₀ ℕ},
  Singularity.IsUniqueMinimizer w (Singularity.projPolyhedron f) (Singularity.expToReal v) →
    ∀ {i : ℕ},
      1 ≤ i →
        i ≤ f.natDegree →
          Singularity.weightPart w (↑i * Singularity.polyDelta w f) (f.coeff (f.natDegree - i)) =
            (MvPowerSeries.monomial (i • v)) ((MvPowerSeries.coeff (i • v)) (f.coeff (f.natDegree - i)))

Singularity.weightPart_monomial_add_mono.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {a b : σ →₀ ℕ} {w : σ → ℝ} {c : ℝ},
  Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a) ≠ c →
    Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal b) = c →
      Singularity.weightPart w c ((MvPowerSeries.monomial a) 1 + (MvPowerSeries.monomial b) 1) =
        (MvPowerSeries.monomial b) 1

Singularity.weightPart_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] {w : σ → ℝ} {c d : ℝ}
  {g g' : MvPowerSeries σ k},
  (∀ (a : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff a) g ≠ 0 → c ≤ Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a)) →
    (∀ (a : σ →₀ ℕ), (MvPowerSeries.coeff a) g' ≠ 0 → d ≤ Singularity.linWeight w (Singularity.expToReal a)) →
      Singularity.weightPart w (c + d) (g * g') = Singularity.weightPart w c g * Singularity.weightPart w d g'

Singularity.weightSpace.type:
{k : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing k] →
      [inst_1 : CommRing R] → [inst_2 : Algebra k R] → {p : ℕ} → Derivation k R R → ZMod p → Submodule k R

Singularity.weight_alongWeight.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq σ] (S : Finset σ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (Finsupp.weight (Singularity.alongWeight S)) d = ∑ i ∈ S, d i

Singularity.weight_mapDomain.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {f : σ → τ} (W : τ → ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ),

Singularity.weight_nsmul.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (n : ℕ) (w : σ → ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight (n • w)) d = n * (Finsupp.weight w) d

Singularity.weightedOrd.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → ℕ∞

Singularity.weightedOrd_eq_top_iff.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R},
  Singularity.weightedOrd w f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

Singularity.weightedOrd_le.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  f.coeff d ≠ 0 → Singularity.weightedOrd w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

Singularity.weightedOrd_mul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  Singularity.weightedOrd w (f * g) = Singularity.weightedOrd w f + Singularity.weightedOrd w g

Singularity.weightedOrd_nsmul.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (w : σ → ℕ) {g : MvPolynomial σ R},
  g ≠ 0 → Singularity.weightedOrd (n • w) g = ↑n * Singularity.weightedOrd w g

Singularity.weightedOrd_of_isWeightedHom.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {w : σ → ℕ} {P : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w P n → P ≠ 0 → Singularity.weightedOrd w P = ↑n

Singularity.weightedOrd_one.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R),

Singularity.weightedOrd_rename_some.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring K] (W : Option σ → ℕ) {g : MvPolynomial σ K},

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X1.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k], (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 1) = MvPolynomial.X 0

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X1_mul.type:

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X1_sq.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k], MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2 = (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 2)

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_X2.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing k], (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) (MvPolynomial.X 2) = MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ 2

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_eq_of_c.type:

    Ideal.comap (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) P = Ideal.comap (Singularity.whitneyNormalization k) Q → P = Q

Singularity.whitneyNormalization_equatio.type:

Singularity.wildDecomp.type: {k : Type u_1} → [inst : Field k] → Subalgebra k (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)

Singularity.wildInvariants.type: {k : Type u_1} → [inst : Field k] → Subalgebra k (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)

Singularity.wildNorm.type: {k : Type u_1} → [inst : Field k] → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k

Singularity.wildNorm_mem_wildInvariants.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k], Singularity.wildNorm ∈ Singularity.wildInvariants

Singularity.wildSigma.type: {k : Type u_1} → [inst : Field k] → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k

Singularity.wildSigma_X_one.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k], Singularity.wildSigma (MvPolynomial.X 1) = MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 0

Singularity.wildSigma_X_zero.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k], Singularity.wildSigma (MvPolynomial.X 0) = MvPolynomial.X 0

Singularity.wildSigma_eq_self_iff.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [CharP k 2] (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
  Singularity.wildSigma f = f ↔ f ∈ Singularity.wildInvariants

Singularity.wildSigma_of_mem.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [CharP k 2] {a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k},
  a ∈ Singularity.wildInvariants → Singularity.wildSigma a = a

Singularity.wildSigma_wildNorm.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [CharP k 2], Singularity.wildSigma Singularity.wildNorm = Singularity.wildNorm

Singularity.wildSigma_wildSigma.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [CharP k 2] (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
  Singularity.wildSigma (Singularity.wildSigma f) = f

Singularity.wild_add_self.type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [CharP k 2] (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k), f + f = 0

Singularity.xTranslate.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → (σ → R) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial (Option σ) R

Singularity.xTranslate_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (b : σ → R) (g : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.xTranslate b) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) g) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename some) ((MvPolynomial.aeval fun l => MvPolynomial.X l + MvPolynomial.C (b l)) g)

Singularity.xTranslate_zMonic.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (b : σ → R) (m : ℕ) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R),
  (Singularity.xTranslate b) (Singularity.zMonic m a) =
    Singularity.zMonic m fun i => (MvPolynomial.aeval fun l => MvPolynomial.X l + MvPolynomial.C (b l)) (a i)

Singularity.zMonic.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommRing R] → ℕ → (ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R) → MvPolynomial (Option σ) R

Singularity.zMonic_narasimhanCoeff.type:
∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K],
  Singularity.zMonic 2 (Singularity.narasimhanCoeff K) =
    (MvPolynomial.rename ⇑(finSuccEquiv 3)) (Singularity.Examples.narasimhanF K)

Singularity.zShift.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {k : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring k] → MvPolynomial σ k → MvPolynomial (Option σ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Option σ) k

Singularity.zShift_X_none_eq_maximalCont.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] {m : ℕ} (hm : IsUnit ↑m) (a : ℕ → MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.zShift (MvPolynomial.C ↑hm.unit⁻¹ * a (m - 1))) (MvPolynomial.X none) =
    Singularity.maximalContactCoord hm a

Singularity.zShift_purelyInseparable.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] (e : ℕ) (h F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.zShift h) (Singularity.purelyInseparable (p ^ e) F) =
    Singularity.purelyInseparable (p ^ e) (F + h ^ p ^ e)

Singularity.zShift_rename.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring k] (h F : MvPolynomial σ k),
  (Singularity.zShift h) ((MvPolynomial.rename some) F) = (MvPolynomial.rename some) F

Singularity.zShift_zero_apply.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (f : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R), (Singularity.zShift 0) f = f

Singularity.zero_mem_extremePoints_projP.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing k] {f : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries σ k)},
  0 ∈ Singularity.projPolyhedron f → 0 ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (Singularity.projPolyhedron f)
